text: C-Rank Type: Taijutsu, Rank C Chakra: 5 + X/4 Speed: +2 Tags: Link Effects This is added on to any Taijutsu Attack. During that attack your STR is increased by X, to a maximum of double your normal STR. You cannot use this while Baika no Jutsu or Cho Baika no Jutsu are active.

title: Nikudan Hari Sensha - Spiked Human Bullet Tank
text: C-Rank Type: Taijutsu, Rank C Chakra: 30 Upkeep: 4 Speed: 6 Requires: Baika no Jutsu or Chō Baika no Jutsu active; 30 prepared kunai on wire Tags: Utility, Movement Effects Enter a spiked rolling form using Human Bullet Tank’s rules, with Chakra 30 and Upkeep 4. It replaces ordinary Human Bullet Tank without interrupting Rolling. Commit the 30 prepared kunai until the form ends; they remain reusable afterward. Choose Blunt or Piercing when declaring Rolling Crush. It remains Unarmed Taijutsu for your bonuses, but its defender treats it as a Weapon Attack for Block and Parry. Your own Block reduces Weapon Attack damage by 50%. After an Unarmed Melee Attack hits you, retaliate once against its attacker for Piercing damage equal to the DR value you applied against that Attack, before penetration. This retaliation cannot Wound or trigger further retaliation. You may turn freely on a later Move Action. Each Rolling Crush still requires its own straight approach and impact. B-Rank

title: Cho Baika no Jutsu - Super Multi-Size Technique
text: B-Rank Type: Taijutsu, Rank B Chakra: 20 + X/2 Upkeep: 10 Speed: 15 Tags: Utility Effects X is your AGI/2. If used when already in Baika no Jutsu, that jutsu is ended and Cho Baika's Speed is reduced by 10 and its Chakra Cost is reduced by 10 + the X of that Jutsu. When active, the following effects are applied: Your AGI is reduced by 50% and your STR and RES are increased by 25%. This increase does not increase your Current Vitality and HP but it does increase your maximums in each. All your unarmed attacks gain Area X/5, or have their existing Area increased by that amount. You gain a damage reduction of X. You cannot Hide. You reduce the severity of any Stuns inflicted upon you by X/5, and any effects which would move you involuntarily will move you X/2 fewer yards. Your Taijutsu attacks have a reach of +5 yards. Your physical damage bonus is calculated as STR/15. You can grapple someone using only a single hand. This does allow you to, potentially, hold one person in each hand. You are immune to any environmental effect with an area of X/5 or less.

title: Chōdan Bakugeki - Butterfly Bullet Bombing
text: B-Rank Type: Taijutsu, Rank B Chakra: 40 Accuracy: +X/5 Damage: (STR/5 + RES/5 + X)d20 Speed: 25 Area: 2X Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt Effects Choose X from 15–30, or 10–30 while Butterfly Mode is active. Spend X CP as an additional cost. If you run out of CP, Calorie Conversion may fund the remainder at 4 HP each; retain at least 1 HP. CP spent here cannot also reduce Chakra or pay for Butterfly Mode’s damage bonus. Spend any CP for those purposes separately. After Move-with-Attack movement, strike a primary target within Unarmed reach and centre Area 2X on it. Use PDB + NDB as one Damage Bonus. The primary target receives the normal damage pool; other creatures in the Area receive half that pool before their own defenses and mitigation. You are excluded, but allies are not. Baika and Chō Baika must be inactive when this Attack is declared. Pay Chakra after applying Calorie Conversion, using the resulting cost for the exhaustion roll. If reduced to 0, no Chakra Exhaustion roll is required. Resolve CP recovery under Calorie Conversion normally.

title: Chō Chakra Mode - Butterfly Mode
text: B-Rank Type: Ninjutsu, Rank B Chakra: 25 Upkeep: 8 Speed: 10 Tags: Utility, Self Effects Chakra vents from your back like wings. Your movement increases by 50%, your unarmed reach increases by 2 yards, and your Physical Damage Bonus is increased by 2. When you land a damaging Taijutsu, you may spend up to 10 CP; each 2 CP spent this way increases its final damage by 5%. If activated through the Red Pill, its Chakra cost is 0.

title: Ballistic Corps
text: WEAPON TRADITION - SETTING ORIGINAL Heritage Cost: 2 UP The Ballistic Corps are Haven Ember's gunners, ammunition specialists and hunter-engineers: the people trusted with weapons that turn sealed powder, chakra coils and monster-bone machinery into portable thunder. The tradition began in the Ashen Anvil's Ballistics Annex, where recovered firearms and industrial launchers were rebuilt for Hunter combat. Their weapons are not mass-produced firearms. Every chamber is fitted, every recoil system tuned, and every load chosen for the thing the hunter expects to meet outside the walls. Ballistic Hunters maintain their own magazines, barrels and seal plates, adapting their weapons with materials recovered during hunts.

title: Ballistics Certification
text: Only characters with the Ballistic Corps Heritage may wield a weapon with the Firearm or Ballistic tag unless a rule explicitly states otherwise. This is a hard Heritage restriction. Characters without this Heritage cannot make Ballistic Attacks, Reload or Brace a firearm, benefit from Ballistic Attachments, use specialist Ballistic ammunition, or use Ballistic Modifications. They may carry, sell, transport or study the equipment, but possessing it never grants access to its combat rules. General Equipment access never overrides this restriction unless a rule explicitly names the Ballistic Corps restriction. A Ballistic Weapon is a ranged Weapon. It uses the normal Attack and ranged-defense rules, but does not add Physical Damage Bonus. Instead, Ballistic Attacks add Ballistic Damage Bonus (BDB) equal to DEX / 24, rounded as normal. When making an attack of any type with a Ballistic Weapon, instead of using a base Accuracy result, you roll a 1d20, and add your relevant Accuracy modifier to it, not including your Base 10. If you use your DEX for your BDB, use your Taijutsu Accuracy, if you use your CHA for your BDB, use your Ninjutsu Accuracy. Ballistic Weapons cannot Parry ranged attacks. They may Parry Melee Weapon or Melee Unarmed attacks using their listed Parry modifier. Forge Rating: A catalogue firearm's Forge Rating counts as its Artisan Point total for wield restrictions and any effect that checks Artisan Points. A Hunter Arm's Forge Rating is equal to the number of Modification Points currently installed on it; you may always wield your own Hunter Arm regardless of Forge Rating. Durability: Firing a Ballistic Weapon does not generate WDP by itself. It still uses normal Durability, Damage Level and WDP rules when struck, damaged or stressed by another effect. Rolled-Accuracy Ballistic Attacks do not allow Partial Defense: a failed Defense resolves the full hit. Blocking, Armor and DR still apply. Ballistic Attacks are still subject to the normal ranged-defense rules. A bullet does not become unblockable or unparryable merely because it is a bullet. Ballistic Arts are exclusive Ballistic Corps Weapon Jutsu. For requirements, XP costs and effects that care about Jutsu type, they count as Bukijutsu. Unless a technique says otherwise, a Ballistic Art requires a Ballistic Weapon and cannot be used with an ordinary weapon.

title: Controlled Fire
text: All Ballistic Corps Hunters know Controlled Fire. Before rolling an Attack, add +5 Stamina to replace its Accuracy die with a base 10, then apply its normal Accuracy modifiers. The Attack permits Partial Defense from eligible defenses, including Parries against non-AoE Attacks. AoE Parries still grant no Partial Defense. This option applies to a Basic Attack, Burst, Full Auto or Ballistic Art and is chosen once for the entire Attack. It adds no Delay and cannot be chosen after seeing a roll.

title: Omnidirectional Fire
text: Ballistic Corps Hunters are trained to fire while advancing, retreating, strafing or turning. Every Attack made with a Ballistic Weapon is Omnidirectional, including normal Attacks, Burst, Full Auto and Ballistic Arts. You may declare these Attacks in any direction regardless of the direction you are moving or facing. Normal movement, Range, line-of-sight and technique requirements apply; movement still breaks Braced or Aim.

title: The Hunter Arm
text: You begin with one custom Hunter Arm at no Ryo cost and three Standard Loads. Choose one Frame and spend 4 Modification Points on Ballistic Modifications. Your Hunter Arm is always considered a Ballistic Weapon and a Firearm. Modification Points are not Artisan Points. They do not count toward normal Weapon Crafting prerequisites or tier requirements. The modifications below may only be installed on your Hunter Arm unless another rule explicitly allows otherwise. You may redesign any number of your Hunter Arm's Modifications during a Week's Rest by spending 1 Downtime Slot at the Ballistics Annex or an equivalent workshop. You may also change its Frame during a Week's Rest by spending 1 Downtime Slot and 10,000 Ryo in replacement parts. A Frame change may include a full redesign of its Modifications as part of the same action. If your Hunter Arm is permanently lost or destroyed, a replacement chassis costs 20,000 Ryo. Its previous Modifications are restored after spending 1 Downtime Slot rebuilding the weapon.

title: Loaded for the Hunt
text: Ballistic Corps hunters are trained to treat ammunition choice and firing position as part of the attack rather than bookkeeping between attacks. Immediately after one of your Ballistic Attacks fully resolves, choose one: - Cycle - Exchange the currently loaded magazine for another compatible Load you are carrying. Preserve the remaining ammunition in both magazines. - Set - Become Braced if you have not voluntarily moved since the beginning of the triggering Attack. - Reposition - Move up to 2 yards without Speed or AP. Heavy or Siege weapons cannot choose Reposition. This movement cannot pass through creatures or ignore terrain or hazards.

title: Corps Refit
text: At Trailhand or 2,500 total XP, whichever comes first, the Ballistics Annex rebuilds your Hunter Arm around the hunter you have become. Gain 4 additional Modification Points. These points may be redesigned normally with the rest of your weapon.

title: Report
text: Unless a weapon or Modification says otherwise, firing a Ballistic Weapon immediately ends ordinary Stealth and creates an obvious report. Spent cases, darts, sabots, scorch marks and seal residue may be tracked or studied normally.

title: Magazine (X)
text: The weapon may make X normal attacks before it is empty. A normal Attack consumes 1 ammunition. Burst and specialist effects may consume more.

title: Reload (X)
text: Reloading is a Speed X Utility action with no additional Stamina cost. You must have a compatible Load available. A Load refills the weapon to its full Magazine value. Removing a partially used magazine does not destroy the remaining ammunition. Track it separately until used again.

title: Brace
text: Brace is a Speed 5 Utility action. You remain Braced until you voluntarily move or are forcibly moved. Dodging also breaks your brace. Effects may alter how easily you lose Braced.

title: Burst
text: When declaring a Ballistic Attack with a Burst weapon, you may consume 3 ammunition. The Attack gains +3 Damage Dice, +2 Stamina and +1 Base Speed. Burst remains one Attack and may only modify an Attack once.

title: Full Auto
text: When a Ballistic Weapon with the Burst property gains it again, the weapon instead gains access to this special Variable Speed Action — Full Auto: [Variable Speed, Variable Stamina, Attack, Ballistic]. When you declare it, choose a value of X between 2 and the number of complete 3-Round Bursts remaining in the Weapon’s Magazine, to a maximum of 5. Consume 3 × X Ammunition. The Action’s Speed becomes the Weapon’s Base Speed + X. The Action’s Stamina becomes the Weapon’s normal Stamina + (2 × X). Draw a cone, with you as the point of Origin, up to your Weapon’s Range in any direction. Choose up to X creatures within that cone as possible targets. Make one Attack Roll against each chosen creature with a -2 Accuracy Modifier. Each creature must defend against their Attack separately. On a hit, deal the Weapon’s normal Damage + X + ⌈X / 2⌉ Damage Dice + BDB. For the purposes of effects that care about repeated hits, such as Maintaining Handseals, Suppression, Concentration or similar effects, a creature hit by Full Auto counts as having been hit X times. These additional counted hits do not deal additional Damage, cannot independently Wound, and cannot trigger additional Damage effects. Simplification: - a = Weapon Base Speed b = Weapon Magazine Size c = Weapon Damage Dice d = Damage Bonus e = Weapon Stamina X = Chosen Value of X Ammo = 3X Speed = a + X Stamina = e + 2X Targets = X Accuracy = -2 Damage = (c + X + ⌈X / 2⌉) Dice + d Hit Count = X

title: Heavy
text: Firing a Heavy weapon while not Braced gives the Attack -1 Accuracy and +2 Stamina.

title: Siege
text: A Siege weapon must be Braced before it can declare an Attack. If its wielder is moved after declaring the Attack but before it resolves, the Attack is cancelled.

title: Scoped
text: A Scoped weapon gains the Aim action: [Speed 5, Utility]. Your next Ballistic Attack with that weapon before you move gains +1 Accuracy, then consumes the Aim bonus.

title: Scatter Frame
text: The weapon can safely chamber Scatter Loads.

title: Chakra-Driven
text: When declaring an Attack, you may increase that attack’s cost by +5 Chakra to use the higher of DEX / 24 or CHA / 24 as BDB. The Attack counts as chakra-enhanced wherever that distinction matters. Chakra-Driven weapons can safely chamber Elemental Loads.

title: Sidearm Frame
text: Type: Small, One-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 8 Stamina: 9 Damage: 4d6 Accuracy: +1 Parry: +0 Range: 12 yards Delay: 0 Durability: 30 Magazine: 6 Reload: 5 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Quickdraw - Drawing the Sidearm as part of a Ballistic Attack does not increase that Attack's Speed.

title: Light Bowgun Frame
text: Type: Medium, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 9 Stamina: 11 Damage: 6d8 Accuracy: +1 Parry: +0 Range: 20 yards Delay: 0 Durability: 40 Magazine: 6 Reload: 5 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Slicing, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Mobile Frame - After a Ballistic Attack with this weapon resolves, you may move 1 yard without Speed or AP. This cannot be combined with Reposition from Loaded for the Hunt.

title: Heavy Bowgun Frame
text: Type: Large, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing, Heavy Speed: 13 Stamina: 15 Damage: 8d10 Accuracy: +0 Parry: -1 Range: 30 yards Delay: 2 Durability: 50 Magazine: 5 Reload: 7 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Scatter, Sticky, Tranq Frame Trait: Set the Stock - While Braced, Ballistic Attacks with this weapon gain +2 Damage Dice.

title: Machine Pistol Frame
text: Type: Small, One-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 8 Stamina: 10 Damage: 4d6 Accuracy: +0 Parry: -1 Range: 10 yards Delay: 0 Durability: 28 Magazine: 9 Reload: 6 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Compact Burst - When you use Burst with this weapon, ignore Burst's +1 Base Speed. Its ammunition and Stamina costs are unchanged.

title: Carbine Frame
text: Type: Medium, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 8 Stamina: 11 Damage: 6d8 Accuracy: +1 Parry: +0 Range: 24 yards Delay: 0 Durability: 38 Magazine: 9 Reload: 5 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Slicing, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Short-Stroke Action - After you Reload this weapon, your next normal Ballistic Attack before you move gains Final Speed -1. Burst and Full Auto cannot benefit.

title: Scattergun Frame
text: Type: Medium, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing, Scatter Frame Speed: 10 Stamina: 12 Damage: 7d8 Accuracy: +0 Parry: +0 Range: 12 yards Delay: 1 Durability: 42 Magazine: 4 Reload: 6 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Scatter, Sticky, Tranq Frame Trait: Breach Pattern - When you fire Scatter ammunition at half Range or closer, add 2 additional Damage Dice.

title: Marksman Frame
text: Type: Large, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing, Scoped Speed: 12 Stamina: 13 Damage: 7d10 Accuracy: +1 Parry: -1 Range: 45 yards Delay: 1 Durability: 42 Magazine: 5 Reload: 7 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Slicing, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Cold Bore - A Ballistic Attack that consumes your Aim bonus gains +2 Damage Dice.

title: Hand Cannon Frame
text: Type: Medium, One-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing Speed: 12 Stamina: 14 Damage: 7d10 Accuracy: -1 Parry: -1 Range: 15 yards Delay: 1 Durability: 40 Magazine: 3 Reload: 7 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Sticky Frame Trait: Kickback - After an Attack with this weapon resolves while you are not Braced, move 1 yard directly away from the target. You may take +2 Stamina on the Attack instead. This movement cannot trigger another movement effect.

title: Rotary Repeater Frame
text: Type: Large, Two-Handed, Ballistic, Firearm, Piercing, Heavy Speed: 12 Stamina: 14 Damage: 4d10 Accuracy: +0 Parry: -1 Range: 22 yards Delay: 0 Durability: 55 Magazine: 18 Reload: 9 Compatible Ammo: Standard, Pierce, Tranq, Tracking Dye Frame Trait: Rotary Feed - Burst consumes 2 ammunition instead of 3 when fired from this Frame. Full Auto still consumes 3 × X ammunition normally.

title: Extended Magazine
text: Increase Magazine by 2. May be taken twice.

title: Long Barrel
text: Increase Range by 5 yards, or by 10 yards on a Heavy Bowgun. Limit 1.

title: Quick Feed
text: Reduce Reload by 1. May be taken twice, to a minimum of half the Frame's original Reload.

title: Reinforced Receiver
text: Increase Durability by 20%. Limit 1.

title: Hunter Scope
text: Gain the Scoped property. Limit 1.

title: Balanced Stock
text: Improve the weapon's Parry modifier by +1. Limit 1.

title: Specialist Feed
text: Gain compatibility with one of Pierce, Slicing, Sticky, Tranq or Tracking Dye Loads. May be taken multiple times, choosing a different Load each time. This cannot grant Scatter, Elemental or Wyvern compatibility.

title: Quick Ejector
text: When the weapon is empty, reduce its Reload by 1 after all other modifiers, to a minimum of 3. Limit 1.

title: Recoil Pad
text: If the weapon has Heavy, its unbraced Stamina surcharge is +1 instead of +2. If it does not have Heavy, reduce forced movement caused by firing your own Ballistic Arts by 1 yard. Limit 1.

title: Low-Profile Optics
text: Requires Scoped. Moving up to 1 yard after you Aim does not remove that Aim bonus. Moving farther still removes it normally. Limit 1.

title: Sealed Magazine
text: Choose one compatible ammunition type when installed. Limit 1.

title: Snap Sling
text: Drawing this weapon as part of a Ballistic Attack does not increase that Attack's Speed. Heavy and Siege weapons cannot benefit. Limit 1.

title: Blast Shroud
text: Firing still ends ordinary Stealth and creates a report, but creatures more than 20 yards away cannot determine your exact firing position from sound alone. Scatter Loads and Wyvern Shells cannot benefit. Limit 1.

title: Scatter Chamber
text: Gain the Scatter Frame property and compatibility with Scatter Loads. Limit 1.

title: Chakra Coil
text: Gain the Chakra-Driven property and compatibility with Elemental Loads. Limit 1.

title: Burst Mechanism
text: Gain the Burst property. Limit 2.

title: Recoil Brake
text: If the weapon has Heavy, remove the -1 Accuracy penalty for firing while unbraced. The additional +2 Stamina remains. If the weapon does not have Heavy, reduce forced movement caused by firing your own Ballistic Arts by 2 yards. Limit 1.

title: Tracking Assembly
text: Tracking Dye Loads fired from this weapon deal 2 Damage Dice instead of 1 and may add BDB normally. Limit 1.

title: Precision Barrel
text: Requires Scoped. A Ballistic Attack that consumes your Aim bonus gains +1 Damage Die. Limit 1.

title: Short Barrel
text: Reduce the weapon's listed Range by 25%, rounded normally, and reduce its Base Speed by 1. Cannot be combined with Long Barrel. Limit 1.

title: Overpressure Chamber
text: Increase the weapon's Damage by +1 Damage Die. All Ballistic Attacks with it gain +3 Stamina. Limit 1.

title: Choke Assembly
text: Requires Scatter Frame. Scatter Loads gain their close-range bonus at two-thirds of the weapon's listed Range or closer instead of half Range. Limit 1.

title: Gyro Stabilizer
text: While Braced, forced movement of 2 yards or less does not remove Braced from you. A Siege Attack is still cancelled if you are moved before it resolves. Limit 1.

title: Capacitor Seal
text: Requires Chakra-Driven. When you pay Chakra to use Chakra-Driven or an Elemental Load, reduce the total Chakra paid for that Attack by 2, to a minimum of 1. Limit 1.

title: Quick Brace Assembly
text: Reduce the Speed of Brace by 1, to a minimum of 3. Limit 1.

title: Braced Loader
text: While you are Braced, reduce this weapon's Reload by 1, to a minimum of 3. Limit 1.

title: Lightened Chassis
text: Reduce Base Speed by 1. Increase the Stamina of all Ballistic Attacks with this weapon by 2 and reduce its Durability by 10%. Cannot be combined with Counterweighted Chassis. Limit 1.

title: Counterweighted Chassis
text: Reduce the Stamina of all Ballistic Attacks with this weapon by 2. Increase Base Speed by 1 and increase its Durability by 10%. Cannot be combined with Lightened Chassis. Limit 1.

title: Dual Feed
text: The weapon can hold two compatible Loads at once. Each feed has its own remaining ammunition, up to the weapon's normal Magazine value. Choose which feed is used whenever you Attack. Reloading one feed does not reload the other. Limit 1.

title: Guard Plate
text: Requires Heavy Bowgun Frame. The weapon may use the normal Weapon Block action. While Braced, improve the weapon's Block reduction by 10%. Limit 1.

title: Wyvern Chamber
text: Requires Heavy Bowgun Frame. Gain compatibility with Wyvern Shells. Limit 1.

title: Rotary Action
text: Requires Burst. Burst consumes 2 ammunition instead of 3. Increase the weapon's Reload by 1. Limit 1.

title: Heavy Receiver
text: Requires a weapon without Heavy. Gain the Heavy property, +1 Damage Die and +10 Durability. Increase Base Speed by 1 and Stamina by 2. Limit 1.

title: Universal Chamber
text: Gain compatibility with Pierce, Slicing, Sticky, Tranq and Tracking Dye Loads. This does not grant Scatter, Elemental or Wyvern compatibility. Limit 1.

title: Buckler Housing
text: The weapon may use the normal Weapon Block action. This grants no additional Block reduction by itself. Limit 1.

title: Accelerator Coil
text: Requires Chakra-Driven. Whenever you activate Chakra-Driven, you may pay 2 additional Chakra. If you do, that Attack gains +1 Damage Die and +5 yards Range. Limit 1.

title: Burst Regulator
text: Requires Burst. When you use Burst, it adds +4 Damage Dice instead of +3, but its additional Stamina becomes +4 and its additional Base Speed becomes +2. Limit 1.

title: High-Capacity Drum
text: Increase Magazine by 50%, rounded up. Increase Reload by 2. Limit 1.

title: Dampened Action
text: Reduce the weapon's Delay by 1, to a minimum of 0. All Ballistic Attacks with it gain +2 Stamina. Limit 1.

title: Tripod Mount
text: Requires Heavy or Siege. Brace has Speed 3 with this weapon. While Braced, increase its listed Range by 5 yards. Limit 1.

title: 4 Modifications
text: These modifications require 2,500 total XP.

title: Siege Conversion
text: Requires Heavy Bowgun Frame. Gain the Siege property. Increase Damage by +2 Damage Dice and Range by 10 yards. Increase Base Speed by 2. Magazine becomes 1 and Reload increases by 3. Limit 1.

title: Monster Bore
text: When a Ballistic Attack from this weapon damages Armor Durability, a physical Barrier, or a destructible monster part, deal an additional 25% damage to that object's Durability. Limit 1.

title: Belt Feed
text: Requires Burst. Double the weapon's Magazine and increase Reload by 3. The weapon gains Heavy if it does not already have it. Limit 1.

title: Full-Auto Compensator
text: Requires Full Auto. Full Auto adds X Stamina instead of 2 × X Stamina. Its ammunition cost, Accuracy penalty, Speed and damage are unchanged. Limit 1.

title: Servo Brace
text: Requires Heavy or Siege. While Braced, Ballistic Attacks with this weapon gain Final Speed -1 and -2 Stamina. Limit 1.

title: Auto-Sealing Ejector
text: When an Attack leaves this weapon empty, your next Reload with it before the end of your next Action gains Final Speed -2. Limit 1.

title: Anti-Materiel Rifling
text: Pierce Loads fired from this weapon no longer reduce the Attack by 1 Damage Die. All of their other effects remain unchanged. Limit 1.

title: Elemental Resonator
text: Requires Chakra-Driven. An Elemental Load fired from this weapon gains +1 Damage Die without increasing its Chakra cost. Limit 1.

title: Self-Leveling Mount
text: Requires Heavy or Siege. Dodging does not remove Braced from you. Any movement caused by that Dodge still removes Braced normally if it moves you. Limit 1.

title: 5 Point Modifications
text: These modifications require 4,000 total XP.

title: Full-Auto Governor
text: Requires Full Auto and 4,000 total XP. Increase Full Auto's maximum X from 5 to 6. You must still possess enough ammunition to pay 3 × X. Limit 1.

title: Autoloader Core
text: Requires 4,000 total XP. When an Attack empties this weapon, you may consume one compatible Load after the Attack resolves to refill the weapon to half its Magazine, rounded up. This counts as a Reload but has no Speed. It cannot trigger from a Wyvern Shell or Wyvern Execution. Limit 1.

title: Anti-Materiel Conversion
text: Requires 4,000 total XP and a non-Small Frame. Gain Heavy and +2 Damage Dice. Increase Base Speed by 2, Stamina by 3 and Reload by 2. Reduce Magazine by 50%, rounded up. Limit 1.

title: Elemental Reactor
text: Requires 4,000 total XP and Chakra-Driven. When firing an Elemental Load, you may increase the CE cost by 3 additional Chakra to add +2 Damage Dice to the Attack. Limit 1.

title: Fortress Housing
text: Requires 4,000 total XP and Buckler Housing or Guard Plate. While Braced, improve this weapon's Block reduction by 15%. This replaces, rather than stacks with, the bonus from Guard Plate. Limit 1.

title: 6 Point Modifications
text: These modifications require 5,000 total XP.

title: Rail Conversion
text: Requires 5,000 total XP, Chakra-Driven and Scoped. When a Ballistic Attack consumes your Aim bonus, you may add +8 Chakra Cost. That Attack gains +2 Damage Dice and +10 yards Range, but also +1 Base Speed. Limit 1.

title: Cyclone Feed
text: Requires 5,000 total XP and Full Auto. For Full Auto only, each point of X consumes 2 ammunition instead of 3, and the maximum available X is determined from complete 2-round segments. Increase this weapon's Reload by 2. Limit 1.

title: Siege Stabilizer
text: Requires 5,000 total XP and Siege. If you are forcibly moved 2 yards or less after declaring a Siege Attack, the Attack is not cancelled. You lose Braced after it resolves. Voluntary movement still cancels the Attack. Limit 1.

title: Titan Receiver
text: Requires 5,000 total XP and Heavy. Increase Damage by +2 Damage Dice and Durability by 20. Increase Base Speed by 2, Stamina by 3 and Reload by 1. Limit 1. ---

title: Ballistic Ammunition
text: A weapon may only load ammunition listed in its Compatible Ammo line or granted by one of its Modifications. A Load fills one magazine regardless of the weapon's exact Magazine value; this is an abstraction for play.

title: Standard Load
text: Cost: 800 Ryo per Load Reliable jacketed shot, hardened darts, ceramic slugs or whatever the weapon was built to throw. No special modifier.

title: Pierce Load
text: Cost: 1,200 Ryo per Load Reduce the Attack by 1 Damage Die. Gain +5% Wounding and deal +50% damage to Armor Durability, physical Barriers and objects.

title: Scatter Load
text: Cost: 1,000 Ryo per Load Requires Scatter Frame. At half the weapon's listed Range or closer, add +3 Damage Dice. Beyond half Range, instead suffer -1 Accuracy. Scatter does not change the number of creatures hit.

title: Slicing Load
text: Cost: 1,500 Ryo per Load Reduce the Attack by 1 Damage Die, change its damage type to Slashing, and gain +5% Wounding.

title: Sticky Load
text: Cost: 1,800 Ryo per Load On a hit, deal no immediate weapon damage. Five IC later the lodged charge detonates for half the weapon's normal Damage Dice, rounded up, using the same die size. Sticky damage gains no BDB and cannot Wound by itself, but deals double damage to Armor Durability, objects and physical Barriers. You may have only one Sticky charge lodged in the same target at a time.

title: Elemental Load
text: Cost: 2,000 Ryo per Load Requires Chakra-Driven. Add +5 CE to the cost of your attack. Choose the elemental nature the Load was prepared for. The Attack changes to that damage type and may use CHA / 24 instead of DEX / 24 for BDB. This does not automatically apply an elemental condition.

title: Tranq Load
text: Cost: 1,000 Ryo per Load Reduce the Attack by 2 Damage Dice and make it Non-Lethal. Against a Hunt target with an explicit capture or tranquilizer condition, a successful hit counts as one valid tranquilizer application. The monster profile determines the remaining requirements.

title: Tracking Dye Load
text: Cost: 600 Ryo per Load The Attack deals only 1 Damage Die and gains no BDB. On hit, mark the target with bright alchemical dye and chakra-reactive scent for the rest of the scene. Track or Survival rolls made specifically to follow that creature gain +2 while the mark remains.

title: Wyvern Shell
text: Cost: 3,000 Ryo per Shell Requires Heavy or Siege and explicit Wyvern compatibility. The Attack gains +6 Damage Dice, +5 Base Speed, +5 Stamina and +10% Wounding. Firing a Wyvern Shell empties the current magazine regardless of remaining ammunition. The weapon cannot begin Reloading until 5 IC after the Attack resolves. ---

title: Talent: Personal Pattern
text: Personal Patterns develop through years of field notes, custom tolerances, monster materials and adjustments made for one Hunter.

title: Named Pattern
text: Type: Talent Requires: Ballistic Corps, 1,000 total XP, and at least 1 IC month using the same Hunter Arm Effects Choose one of your Hunter Arms. It becomes your Named Arm. Your Named Arm gains 2 additional Modification Points. These points follow all normal Modification rules. Only you can benefit from Modification Points or Signature Mechanisms granted by this Talent Path. In another character's hands, the weapon functions as though those Talent features were absent. You may move your Named Pattern to another Hunter Arm during a Week's Rest by spending 2 Downtime Slots rebuilding and tuning the new weapon. You may only have one Named Arm unless you possess Twin Pattern.

title: Signature Pattern
text: Type: Talent Requires: Named Pattern, 2,000 total XP Effects Choose one Signature Mechanism for your Named Arm. You gain its Tier I effect. If a Signature has a property or Frame requirement, your Named Arm must meet it to select or benefit from that Signature. Changing your Signature Mechanism requires 2 Downtime Slots during a Week's Rest.

title: Quickdraw Mechanism
text: Tier I — The first Ballistic Attack you make after drawing or Reloading your Named Arm gains Final Speed -1. Tier II — The same Attack gains Final Speed -2 instead.

title: Predator Glass
text: Requires: Scoped. Tier I — An Attack that consumes your Aim bonus also gains +5% Wounding. Tier II — You may Aim twice before firing. The second Aim grants a second +1 Accuracy. Moving removes both bonuses.

title: Three-Round Seal
text: Requires: Burst. Tier I — Burst adds +4 Damage Dice instead of +3. Tier II — If your previous Ballistic Attack was a Burst against the same target, the new Burst Attack also gains +1 Accuracy. Moving, Reloading, or changing targets breaks the pattern.

title: Fangburst Chamber
text: Requires: Scatter Frame. Tier I — At half Range or closer, Scatter ammunition adds +4 Damage Dice instead of +3, but the Attack gains +1 Delay. Tier II — Ignore that +1 Delay.

title: Breach Teeth
text: Tier I — Ballistic Attacks with the Named Arm deal +50% damage to Armor Durability, physical Barriers and objects. Tier II — Increase this bonus to +100%.

title: Anchored Spine
text: Requires: Heavy or Siege. Tier I — If you have remained Braced and have not moved for at least 10 IC, Standard and Pierce Attacks gain +1 Damage Die. Tier II — They gain +2 Damage Dice instead.

title: Stormrail Coil
text: Requires: Chakra-Driven. Tier I — Elemental Loads fired from the Named Arm cost only 3 Chakra to activate. Tier II — Choose one elemental nature you possess an Affinity for. Elemental Loads prepared for that nature may use CHA / 20 instead of CHA / 24 for BDB.

title: Master Pattern
text: Type: Talent Requires: Signature Pattern, 3,000 total XP Effects Your Named Arm gains 2 additional Modification Points. Your chosen Signature Mechanism improves to Tier II. Additionally, when your Named Arm is destroyed or permanently lost, you retain its Pattern. Rebuilding it costs the normal replacement chassis cost and one Downtime Slot, but all Talent-granted Modification Points and Signature features return with the rebuilt weapon.

title: Twin Pattern
text: Type: Talent Requires: Master Pattern, 4,000 total XP Effects You have learned to maintain two personal weapons to the same impossible tolerances. You may designate a second Hunter Arm as a Named Arm. It gains all benefits of Named Pattern and Master Pattern, including their 4 total bonus Modification Points. Choose a Signature Mechanism for the second weapon separately. It begins at Tier II and must meet its own requirements. Any once-per-scene effect granted by this Talent Path is shared between both Named Arms. Switching weapons cannot reset or duplicate that use. Twin Pattern does not reduce the normal hands, drawing, Reload, ammunition, or Multi-Attack requirements for using two weapons.

title: Gunner's Doctrine
text: Type: Ability Cost: 10 Limit: 1 Effects Choose one Doctrine. You may change Doctrine with one Downtime Slot during a Week's Rest. Skirmisher - After you use Reposition, your next Ballistic Attack before the end of your next Action gains Final Speed -1. You cannot benefit from this while Braced. Marksman - Aim has Speed 4 instead of 5. An Attack that consumes your Aim bonus also gains +5% Wounding. Artillery - Brace has Speed 3 instead of 5. Forced movement of less than 3 yards does not remove Braced from you, although a Siege Attack is still cancelled if you are moved before it resolves.

title: Fighting Withdrawal
text: Type: Ability Cost: 10 Scale: 5 Limit: 1 + AGI / 50, maximum 5 Effects Whenever you would move, if that movement takes you farther away from every enemy currently present, increase that movement’s yards-per-IC (yards/IC) rate by 0.3 per rank of this Ability. If the movement is part of an Attack, look at the result of the D20 roll made with the attack (10 for attacks that use a Static Accuracy) and increase its yards/IC rate by 0.1 per point rolled, per rank of this Ability. A roll of 20 grants +2 yards/IC per rank. The increased rate applies only while the movement continues to take you farther away from every enemy present.

title: Ammunition Savant
text: Type: Ability Cost: 10 Limit: 1 Effects When you fire a non-Standard Load, choose one benefit: ● Ignore 1 Damage Die reduction imposed by that ammunition. ● Reduce additional Stamina imposed by that ammunition by 2. ● Reduce additional Base Speed imposed by that ammunition by 1. Ammunition Savant cannot remove a restriction, compatibility requirement, ammunition cost, delayed effect or post-shot lockout.

title: Field Loader
text: Type: Ability Cost: 12 Limit: 1 Requires: Ammunition Savant Effects Whenever an Attack leaves your Ballistic Weapon empty, your next Reload with that weapon before the end of your next Action gains Final Speed -2. Additionally, Cycle from Loaded for the Hunt may exchange to a partially used magazine or a fresh Load without requiring you to declare which one until Cycle resolves.

title: Master Gunsmith
text: Type: Ability Cost: 15 Limit: 1 Requires: 2,500 total XP, Gunner's Doctrine Effects Gain 3 additional Modification Points for your Hunter Arm. Once per Week's Rest, you may redesign your Hunter Arm's Modifications without spending a Downtime Slot if you have access to the Ballistics Annex or an equivalent workshop. Changing Frame still follows its normal cost.

title: Handō no Ayumi - Recoil Step
text: D-Rank Type: Bukijutsu, Rank D Stamina: 10 Speed: +2 Tags: Link, Weapon, Movement, Ballistic Effects Link to a Ballistic Attack. After the Attack resolves, move up to AGI / 20 yards directly away from the target, maximum 5 yards. If the weapon has Heavy, halve this movement unless you were Braced when the triggering Attack was declared. This movement cannot pass through creatures or solid barriers.

title: Haya Sōten - Quick Chamber
text: D-Rank Type: Bukijutsu, Rank D Stamina: 8 Speed: 3 Tags: Utility, Weapon, Ballistic Effects Exchange your currently loaded ammunition for another compatible Load you are carrying. If the weapon was empty when Quick Chamber began, the new Load enters with ammunition equal to half the weapon's Magazine, rounded up. Otherwise, preserve both magazines' remaining ammunition normally. Quick Chamber is a Reload for effects that modify or trigger from Reloading.

title: Hakai Dan - Breaker Shot
text: C-Rank Type: Bukijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 16 Damage: As Weapon Speed: As Weapon +3 Tags: Attack, Weapon, Ballistic Effects Make a Ballistic Attack. It deals +50% damage to Armor Durability, physical Barriers, objects and destructible monster parts. If fired with Pierce ammunition, the Attack also gains +5% Wounding.

title: Engo Shageki - Covering Fire
text: C-Rank Type: Bukijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 18 Damage: As Weapon Speed: As Weapon +4 Tags: Attack, Weapon, Ballistic Requires: At least 3 ammunition remaining Effects Consume 3 ammunition and make one Ballistic Attack against one creature. Hit or miss, until the beginning of your next Action that creature suffers -2 on Attacks against creatures other than you while it remains within your weapon's Range. Covering Fire is one Attack. Burst cannot also modify it.

title: Shunsha - Snap Shot
text: C-Rank Type: Bukijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 16 Damage: As Weapon Accuracy: -2 Speed: As Weapon -2 Tags: Attack, Weapon, Ballistic Requires: Sidearm or Light Bowgun Frame Effects Make a hurried Ballistic Attack. It cannot benefit from Aim, Predator's Zero or an effect that requires you to be Braced. This Attack has no weapon Delay.

title: Mōjū no Shōjun - Predator's Zero
text: B-Rank Type: Bukijutsu, Rank B Stamina: 20 Speed: 5 Tags: Utility, Weapon, Ballistic Effects Choose one creature you can see within your Ballistic Weapon's Range. Until you voluntarily move, Reload, change weapons, choose a different target for a Ballistic Attack, or the chosen creature leaves your Range, your next Ballistic Attack against that creature gains +10% Wounding. If your weapon is Scoped, you may Aim as part of Predator's Zero without additional Speed. Predator's Zero ends after one Attack.

title: Kariudo no Dansō - Hunter's Magazine
text: B-Rank Type: Bukijutsu, Rank B Stamina: 18 Speed: 6 Tags: Utility, Weapon, Ballistic Effects Reload the weapon completely. Choose two compatible ammunition types for which you possess at least one Load. Until this magazine becomes empty or is removed, choose which of those two ammunition types is fired with each Attack. Hunter's Magazine does not allow incompatible ammunition and does not duplicate ammunition. When the magazine is removed or emptied, deduct the total shots fired from the Loads used, divided between them according to what you actually fired.

title: Hiryū Shokei - Wyvern Execution
text: A-Rank Type: Bukijutsu, Rank A Stamina: 30 Damage: As Weapon +6 Damage Dice Accuracy: +1 Speed: As Weapon +6 Tags: Attack, Weapon, Ballistic, Piercing Requires: Heavy Bowgun Frame, Braced Effects Consume all ammunition currently loaded in the weapon and make one Ballistic Attack. The Attack gains +10% Wounding. If you fire a Wyvern Shell with this technique, apply the Shell's normal Speed, Stamina and Wounding modifiers, but do not add its +6 Damage Dice a second time. If the target currently has a Major Wound, destroyed Armor, or a destroyed monster part, increase Wyvern Execution's Wounding bonus to +15% instead.

title: Futton
text: RARE KEKKEI GENKAI Boil Release mixes Fire and Water into corrosive vapour, pressure, and superheated mist. Futton users either drive that heat inward as violent pressure or turn it outward as acid capable of eating through protection. Starting Features Futton inheritors begin with Elemental Aptitude for Katon and Suiton, and Elemental Affinity: Futton, which includes Katon and Suiton.

title: Futton Conversion
text: When you declare a Katon or Suiton Jutsu, after determining its normal costs and requirements but before paying those costs, you may increase its Chakra cost by 5 to convert it to Futton. A converted technique counts as Futton instead of its original Element for effects that key off Elemental type. Native Futton Jutsu already listed as Futton do not pay this additional 5 Chakra. Converted Futton follows these rules: Damage dealt by Futton is Energy Damage unless a technique explicitly says otherwise. When converting a Katon technique, you may invest up to half of its final Chakra cost, rounded down, in gallons of battlefield water. Any gallons invested this way are boiled off and removed from the field when the technique resolves. If you invest no water in a converted Katon technique, it instead manifests as corrosive steam. After it resolves, add gallons of water equal to one-fifth of its final Chakra cost, rounded down, to the battlefield as the steam condenses. Whenever a damaging Futton technique has gallons invested in it, you may boil off up to 5 additional gallons, but no more than half the gallons already invested, rounded down. Each additional gallon boiled off increases that technique's Final Damage by 5%, to a maximum of +25%. Partial Success and Blocking reduce Futton Damage normally. When determining Wound severity from a damaging Futton Attack, halve only the reduction caused by Partial Success and Blocking, applying them in the normal mitigation order. This recalculation affects Wounding only; the Damage actually taken is unchanged. Apply all other Wound modifiers normally. When a damaging Suiton technique is converted to Futton, a hit that deals Damage inflicts Burns equal to the Jutsu's Rank: E = 1, D = 2, C = 3, B = 4, A = 5. This applies at most once per casting. Effects that boil off or destroy water only affect actual battlefield water measured in gallons. They cannot destroy Mokuton, Hyōton, or other substances merely because water was involved in creating them. If Water-Cutting Blade or Burning Spear Technique is converted to Futton, it may take the following Upgrade: Pressure Feed (1): Invest up to a number of gallons equal to your ranks in this Upgrade, maximum 10. The invested water is boiled off after the Attack resolves. For every 2 gallons invested, add 1 weapon Damage Die to the Attack, maximum +5 Damage Dice.

title: Pressure Engine
text: Your body stores the pressure generated by Futton as Steam. You gain Critical Pressure at Rank 0. Rank 0 grants its Effects and satisfies effects that require Critical Pressure, but it does not count as a rank, does not count against the Ability's Limit, and does not increase its base Steam Capacity. You may purchase ranks normally. Increase your Steam Capacity by 3. You begin each combat with 0 Steam unless another effect states otherwise. After you resolve a Futton Jutsu, gain 1 Steam. When a Physical Attack deals Damage to you equal to at least 10% of your maximum Vitality, gain 1 Steam. A single declaration can grant at most 1 Steam from each of these two triggers. Steam cannot exceed your Steam Capacity. Excess Steam is lost. All remaining Steam is lost when combat ends.

title: Two Boil Modes
text: At the start of combat, choose Pressure Mode or Corrosion Mode. Outside combat, you may choose your current Mode freely. During combat, switching Modes is a Speed 4 Action. Pressure Mode: When you declare a Futton Jutsu, you may spend 1 Steam. After that Jutsu resolves, move up to 3 yards. This movement costs no AP and does not increase the Jutsu's Speed. If the same declaration uses Critical Pressure, spend this Steam first; at least 1 Steam must remain for Critical Pressure to be linked. You may use effects that require Pressure Mode. Corrosion Mode: Damaging Futton ignores 10% Armor Absorption and deals 25% more Final Damage to created barriers. You may use effects that require Corrosion Mode.

title: Critical Pressure
text: Type: Ability Cost: 10 Limit: RES/20 Effects Your base Steam Capacity is 3 + your ranks in Critical Pressure. Pressure Engine's +3 Steam Capacity is added after this formula. When you declare an Action or Interrupt, you may increase its Speed by 4 to Link Critical Pressure to it. This Speed increase is applied before checking Defensive Interrupt validity. You cannot Link Critical Pressure while you have 0 Steam. When you do, release all Steam you currently hold. Let X equal the amount released, then choose one effect below when Critical Pressure is declared. Propulsion: After the linked declaration resolves, move up to 3X yards in any direction. This movement costs no AP. Target: The linked declaration must be a single-target damaging Futton Jutsu. If the Jutsu is not fully avoided, add Xd10 to its rolled Damage before mitigation. These dice are part of the triggering Jutsu and are affected by Partial Success, DR, Armor, Blocking, and Futton Wounding normally. Explosion: After the linked declaration resolves, other creatures within 3 yards take X × Ninjutsu Damage Bonus Energy Damage and are knocked back X yards. This is a secondary effect of Critical Pressure, not a separate Attack; it makes no Accuracy roll and does not allow a separate Defensive Interrupt. DR, Armor, and other non-Defense damage mitigation apply normally.

title: Jutsu
text: E-Rank

title: Futtō - Boil
text: E-Rank Type: Futton Ninjutsu, Rank E Chakra: 5 + X Speed: X/4 (Rounded Up) Tags: Interrupt, Utility Effects X is the number of gallons of battlefield water currently invested in the technique you are interrupting. You may use Boil as a Defensive Interrupt only against an Attack that currently has at least 1 gallon of battlefield water invested in it. Make a Ninjutsu Parry against the interrupted Attack's Accuracy with a +CHA/10 bonus. This Parry permits Partial Success against non-AoE Attacks. It cannot defend against an AoE unless another effect expressly grants that permission; an AoE Parry grants no Partial Success. On a full success, you are fully defended from the Attack and boil off X gallons before it resolves. If this leaves the Attack below its minimum Gallon Requirement, it fails for all targets. Otherwise, if its effects scale with gallons, recalculate them using the gallons that remain before resolving the Attack against any other targets. On Partial Success or failure, Boil destroys no gallons. Boil cannot erase Mokuton, Hyōton, or another advanced nature merely because Suiton helped create it. The interrupted technique must actually be using battlefield water at that moment. D-Rank

title: Fukasu Gafu - Steam Canvas
text: D-Rank Type: Futton Ninjutsu, Rank D Chakra: 15 Upkeep: 2 Speed: 6 Seal Speed: 8 Gallons Requirement: 5 Tags: Utility, Self, Environmental Effects While maintained, heated mist surrounds you. For Attacks and Awareness checks made against you, other creatures suffer an additional -2 Visibility Penalty. This penalty stacks with other Visibility penalties, to the normal maximum. You ignore the Visibility Penalty created by this Jutsu. After a Melee Attack made against you resolves, the attacker takes CHA/2 Energy Damage that ignores DR. After one of your Melee Attacks against another creature resolves, that creature takes the same Damage whether or not the Attack hit. A creature can take this scald Damage at most once per Action. This is a separate automatic damage effect: it makes no Accuracy roll, does not allow a separate Defensive Interrupt, and is not reduced by the triggering Attack's Partial Success or Block. Check Wounds and Armor against it separately. If the mist is dispersed, both effects are suppressed until the start of your next Action. If you are still maintaining the Upkeep at that point, the mist returns at full strength.

title: Futton: Atsuryoku Gyakufunsha - Steam Reversal
text: D-Rank Type: Futton Ninjutsu, Rank D Chakra: 12 Speed: 5 Tags: Utility, Interrupt Requires: Pressure Mode Effects Use Steam Reversal as a Defensive Interrupt against a Melee Attack. Spend 1 to 3 Steam, then move up to 3 yards per Steam spent in any direction before making your Defensive Roll. If this movement takes you outside the space affected by the Attack, the Attack misses you and no Defensive Roll is required. Otherwise, make a Dodge roll with +1 per Steam spent, applying all normal penalties, including AoE Dodge penalties. Partial Success applies normally. C-Rank

title: Futton: Kairiki Musō - Unrivalled Strength
text: C-Rank Type: Futton Ninjutsu, Rank C Chakra: 24 Upkeep: 5 Speed: 8 Tags: Utility, Self Requires: Pressure Mode Effects Choose X, up to your current Steam and a maximum of 5, and spend X Steam when this Jutsu resolves. While maintained, gain +2X STR, +X DEX, and +5X% Movement. Once per Action, after a damaging Taijutsu Attack is not fully avoided but before rolling its Damage, you may vent 1 additional Steam. If you do, calculate Wound severity from that Attack as though its Damage were 10% higher. This does not increase the Damage actually dealt. B-Rank

title: Futton: Fushoku Kiri - Corrosive Mist Prison
text: B-Rank Type: Futton Ninjutsu, Rank B Chakra: 36 Upkeep: 8 Speed: 18 Area: 12 Tags: Attack, AoE, Environmental, Energy Requires: Corrosion Mode Effects Fill the Area with acidic vapour. When this Jutsu resolves, other creatures in the Area defend against it normally as an AoE Attack. A creature that is not fully defended takes 5d10 Energy Damage, reduced by Partial Success as normal. A successful Defense prevents only this initial Damage; the mist remains in the Area. While the Upkeep is maintained, another creature that enters the Area or begins an Action inside it takes 5d10 Energy Damage, to a maximum of once per Action. This recurring Environmental Damage makes no Accuracy roll and does not allow a separate Defensive Interrupt. Whenever Armor absorbs Damage from this Jutsu, double the Durability lost from that Absorption. Damage this Jutsu deals directly to Armor or created barriers is also doubled. Each time Armor absorbs Damage from the mist, reduce that Armor piece's Absorption by 5%, to a maximum reduction of 25% from this Jutsu. This reduction remains while its wearer is inside the mist and until the end of their next Action after leaving it.

title: Sekai no Tokeru - Dissolving World
text: B-Rank Type: Futton Ninjutsu, Rank B Chakra: 25 + X/5 (Rounded Up) Area: Special Speed: 24 Seal Speed: 22 Tags: Attack, AoE, Energy Effects When declaring this Jutsu, choose X up to CHA/3, limited by the total gallons of battlefield water available to be destroyed. When it resolves, boil off X gallons. Remove uninvested battlefield water first, then water invested in maintained Jutsu if necessary. Dissolving World is centered on you and has an Area of X/2 yards, minimum 10 and maximum 50. Other creatures in the Area defend against this Jutsu normally. A creature that is not fully defended takes X × Ninjutsu Damage Bonus Energy Damage, reduced by Partial Success as normal. This is a Futton technique and uses Futton Conversion's Wounding rule. Unranked

title: Jōki Kikan - Steam Engine
text: Type: Futton Ninjutsu, Unranked Chakra: 5 Speed: 1 Tags: Interrupt, Utility Requires: Critical Pressure Effects After one of your Futton Jutsu that boiled off at least 1 gallon of water resolves, you may immediately use Steam Engine as an Interrupt. Gain Steam equal to one-fifth of the triggering Jutsu's final Chakra cost, rounded down, to a maximum of 3 Steam and your Steam Capacity. You cannot use Steam Engine on a Jutsu that used Critical Pressure as part of the same declaration. Steam Engine does not itself trigger Pressure Engine.

title: Hōzuki
text: CANON CLAN Hōzuki inherit the ability to turn their bodies into water. This aids escape, infiltration and aquatic combat, though electricity and dehydration remain dangerous. Starting Features Hōzuki begin with Elemental Aptitude and Elemental Affinity for Suiton.

title: Partial Hydrification
text: While not maintaining Suika no Jutsu, when hit by a non-AoE physical Attack you can spend 8 Chakra as a Speed 0 Interrupt to liquefy only the struck area. Reduce that attack's final damage by 50%. Raiton and Energy damage ignore this benefit.

title: True Hydrification
text: When Partial Hydrification or Suika no Jutsu reduces damage from a non-AoE physical Attack, the attacker can declare a Pinning Strike before damage is rolled. A Pinning Strike voluntarily reduces that Attack's final damage by 20% and prevents the movement below. If it does not, after damage resolves you can spend 1 internal gallon to flow up to 3 yards through an unoccupied path without increasing your IC. You can pass through gaps a liquid body could plausibly fit through, but not sealed barriers. Raiton and Energy damage cannot trigger this movement.

title: Water Reserve
text: Your internal reserve is 20 gallons. You recover all missing internal gallons after a Full Rest with access to drinking water, meaning usually at the end of a scene that includes rest, or after your character is able to spend at least 10 minutes fully submerged in water..

title: Abilities
text: No Heritage-specific purchasable abilities.

title: Jutsu
text: D-Rank

title: Mizudeppō no Jutsu - Water Gun
text: D-Rank Type: Ninjutsu, Rank D Chakra: 12 Damage: 5d10+G(4d10) Speed: 7 Range: 20 Accuracy: +2 Special: Knockback G2 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Piercing Gallons: 0>2 Effects Fire a compressed droplet from one fingertip. It ignores 20% Armor Absorption. If this attack is a Surprise attack, it deals 20% additional damage for the purposes of determining wounds. If this attack is a Sneak Attack it is considered speed 1+G for the purposes of determining defences.

title: Suika no Jutsu - Hydration Technique
text: D-Rank Type: Suiton Ninjutsu, Rank D Chakra: 8 Upkeep: 2 Speed: 4 Tags: Utility, Self, Interrupt Effects Become a liquid body. Your equipment is absorbed and inaccessible until you re-form. Activate normally or use the Defensive Interrupt below. Pay Chakra before starting Upkeep. You can maintain one Hydration Form. Re-form — Speed 5: end Hydration and restore your equipment. Choosing to end its Upkeep uses this Action. If another effect ends Hydration, re-form immediately without that Action; Demon Fishwave and Drowning Water Blob end with it. As a Speed 4 Defensive Interrupt against a non-AoE physical Attack, enter Hydration before it hits. This uses your one defense and makes no defensive roll. Apply the form’s damage multiplier and passive mitigation, then advance your next IC by the Interrupt’s Final Speed. Halve your movement distances and increase modified Seal Speed by 50%, rounded up. You may perform handseals with your liquid limbs. Taijutsu deals half damage, except Crashing Tsunami. Physical Grapples involving you end and cannot be established while you remain liquid. External Immobilization still applies until removed; seals and shadow possession affect you normally. Use one Hydration damage multiplier: Raiton ×1; Doton ×1.5; Katon ×0.5; Suiton ×0.25; other non-AoE Blunt, Slashing or Piercing Attacks ×0.25; all other damage ×1. If several elemental entries apply, use the highest multiplier. Apply it at the percentage-reduction step before DR. Any Paralysis inflicted by a Raiton Attack ends Hydration after that Attack resolves. Suppress Poison and Burns while Hydrated; their durations and normal expiry conditions still progress. Remove Ignite when entering the form. These statuses can be applied while liquid but have no effect until you re-form, except Ignite, which is immediately extinguished. You may fuel Suiton from Water Reserve while Hydrated. Remove all invested gallons from your internal reserve; the Jutsu consumes one quarter, rounded up, and deposits the rest at its point of resolution as battlefield water. Water Reserve recovers only through its own recovery rules. Keep these gallons separate from Demon Fishwave mass. C-Rank

title: Masakana Namiochiru - Demon Fishwave
text: C-Rank Type: Suiton Ninjutsu, Rank C Chakra: 22 Upkeep: 8 Speed: 12 Tags: Utility, Self, Transformation Requires: Suika no Jutsu active Effects Absorb up to CHA/3 available gallons within 1 yard into Hydration Form, maximum CHA held. This absorbed mass is separate from Water Reserve. Water inside your absorbed equipment remains inaccessible. Record mass as it enters or leaves your body. You may invest absorbed mass in Suiton: subtract all invested gallons before resolving the Jutsu, recalculate your bonuses, then leave its unconsumed water on the battlefield normally. Ending Fishwave deposits the remaining mass at your position. While maintained, gain +1 PDB and NDB per full 20 gallons held and DR equal to half the held gallons, rounded down. You cannot Dodge. Your available Taijutsu are Basic Unarmed Attacks and Crashing Tsunami; Ninjutsu and other legal defenses remain available. Starting Fishwave again replaces the previous form and deposits its mass before absorbing new water. A Suiton-only Attack that hits you deals no damage, but its other effects resolve normally. Absorb up to your available capacity from the water still present after that Jutsu’s normal consumption; place any remainder on the battlefield. If the Attack hits several eligible Fishwaves, divide its remaining gallons equally among them, rounding down and capping each share at its available capacity. Leave all unabsorbed water on the battlefield. Against Doton, halve Fishwave’s DR; Raiton ignores it. Mixed-element Attacks use Hydration’s damage table and do not feed Fishwave.

title: Gekitō Tsunami - Crashing Tsunami
text: C-Rank Type: Suiton Taijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 18 Damage: (CHA/10)d12 Speed: 14 Range: Melee Requires: Demon Fishwave active Tags: Attack, Melee, Blunt, Movement Effects Make one Unarmed Taijutsu Attack using PDB. Hydration does not halve this technique’s damage. Declare a legal route toward a target within reach of your movement below. Move your normal Move-with-Attack allowance, already halved by Hydration, plus CHA/5 yards. The additional distance is not halved. Along the route, absorb up to CHA/5 available battlefield gallons, within Fishwave’s cap. Recalculate its PDB before rolling damage. This movement and absorption are part of the Attack and resolve before the strike; terrain along the route applies normally. B-Rank

title: Gōsuiwan no Jutsu - Great Water Arm
text: B-Rank Type: Suiton Ninjutsu, Rank B Chakra: 20 + 3X Upkeep: X Speed: 8 Tags: Utility, Self Effects Choose X from 1 to CHA/30, rounded down, with a minimum upper limit of 1. Enlarge one arm. Attacks using it gain +X PDB, or +2X against unattended objects, barriers and structures. Use the normal bonus against creatures, Puppets, Clones and worn equipment. Unarmed and Taijutsu Attacks using this arm gain Knockback X/2, rounded down, reduced for Partial Defense normally. The arm may wield a two-handed weapon one-handed, using its two-handed profile and normal size and proficiency requirements. The enlarged arm may still form handseals. Maintain only one Great Water Arm. Hydration suppresses its benefits while its Upkeep remains payable; ending Hydration restores them. Partial Hydrification does not suppress it. Ending Great Water Arm restores the arm; if your weapon then requires a second hand, occupy that hand or drop the weapon.

title: Obomizu Katamari no Jutsu - Drowning Water Blob Technique
text: B-Rank Type: Suiton Ninjutsu, Rank B Chakra: 24 Upkeep: 10 Speed: 16 Range: 3 Special: Immobilization 6 Tags: Attack, Melee, Control Requires: Hydration or Demon Fishwave active Effects Choose one creature within 3 yards and make a Ninjutsu Attack. On a hit, surround it with body-water and apply Immobilization 6, reduced for Partial Defense. Begin Upkeep when it is caught. You remain at your own position, and the victim retains its Actions. You may maintain one Blob at a time. Every 10 IC held, add Suffocation 1 and resolve the normal Suffocation Stamina roll. Break Free — Speed 6 Utility Action: the victim rolls Athletics or Resistance against your Chakra Control roll. Success removes 3 of this Blob’s Immobilization; success by 10 removes all. Add +2 per previous failed Break Free attempt against this casting. End the Blob when its Immobilization reaches 0, the victim moves more than 3 yards from you, or you end Upkeep or Hydration. Its Immobilization then ends and Suffocation begins fading normally. The water is part of your body: Attacks directed at it target you from its location and use your defenses and Hydration. One Area Attack covering both you and the Blob damages you only once.

title: Suika Bunretsu - Liquefaction Split
text: B-Rank Type: Ninjutsu, Rank B Chakra: 30 Speed: 8 Tags: Interrupt, Utility, Movement Requires: Suika no Jutsu active Effects Choose G from 0–5 available gallons in Water Reserve and spend them with Chakra. As a Main Action, remove one external physical Immobilization and flow to a legal point within max(2, 2G) yards. As a Defensive Interrupt against one non-AoE, non-Genjutsu Attack, use the Parry below. Doton and Raiton cannot be Parried with this technique. Choose a continuous route through openings at least 1 inch wide. The listed movement distance is already adjusted for Hydration; sealed barriers stop it. Gallons spent are consumed. Removed restraints are left behind, while internal conditions, sealing effects and shadow possession remain. Make a Ninjutsu Parry with +1 per full 2 gallons spent. On full success, negate the Attack, remove one eligible restraint and move. On Partial Success, resolve the reduced Attack at your starting point, then remove the restraint and move if you remain able to act. On a full failure, remain in place. Hydration’s passive mitigation applies to damage you take. Ending Hydration during the hit cancels the escape and movement.

title: Hyūga
text: Hyūga families preserve the Byakugan and Gentle Fist. Their training combines close-range chakra strikes with the eye’s exceptional perception, while older clan customs vary between households.

title: Byakugan
text: Activating the Byakugan is a Speed 0 action; it can't be used as an interrupt. Byakugan has an Upkeep of 1. You can differentiate between people and clones (except for Kage Bunshin), and tell if someone is using Henge (though this does not allow you to see their true form). The Byakugan allows you to see through physical objects (though you're still aware of their presence). This gives you, in crude terms, "X-ray vision", except you see chakra instead of bones and dense objects. You can see everything in a CHA yard radius around you this way. This allows you to spot jutsu-based traps and effects, and detect the presence of fuinjutsu placed on a person, item, or area. Whenever someone enters Stealth within your Byakugan radius, you can perform a Search action as a Speed 0 interrupt (this includes people that begin combat in Stealth, assuming you have Byakugan active during Initiative such as from Preparation ability). And always count as if you had done 2 more search actions than you actually did for the consecutive search action bonus. Additionally, your Awareness checks have a +5 bonus (as long as vision is involved, you do not get this bonus to notice a sound during an event, for example). Your Byakugan also gives you immunity to all non-supernatural sources of Visibility penalties, such as: blindfolds, a weather condition, and smoke bombs. Notably, this does not apply to flash bombs. And you halve Chakra based sources of Visibility penalties such as the infamous “Hidden Mist” Jutsu. You are immune to Genjutsu which target an area instead of people, can automatically see through them as if they weren't there, and can tell when someone else is being affected by a Genjutsu from the disturbance in their chakra flow. Additionally, anyone with a Chakra-based Upkeep effect, even at Upkeep 0 cannot be hidden from you in any way while within your Byakugan’s range.

title: Byakugan Mastery
text: Hyūga Clan Jutsu cost 4 less Chakra while Byakugan is active, minimum 1. While active, its normal visual Awareness bonus also applies to attempts to detect feints, hidden weapons, traps, and chakra build-up. When a visible creature targets you with a non-AoE Attack, you can make a Search action against that creature as Speed 0 Interrupt as you lock onto their Chakra network, even if that creature isn’t hidden from you. On success, gain +2 to the first defensive roll you make against that attack. Normal bonuses from suceeding a Search also apply. While Byakugan is active, when a visible creature inside its radius begins a Chakra-costing Attack or movement technique, it is Telegraphing until that Action resolves. If that Action does not successfully affect you, choose one: Step Inside — move up to 2 yards toward that creature as Speed 0 interrupt after the Action resolves. Close the Gate — the next Gentle Fist hit you land on that creature before the end of your next Action applies one additional Sealed Tenketsu after normal calculations. If it breaks your line of sight before its Action resolves, it stops Telegraphing.

title: Tenketsu Pressure
text: Whenever you successfully apply Sealed Tenketsu to a target, increase the applied severity by 1 after all other calculations. Against a creature suffering Sealed Tenketsu, for each Rank that it has, reduce any DR it has by 10%, and reduce the effectiveness of blocking your attacks by 5%. Additionally, Gentle Fist attacks, or Hyuga Jutsu cast against a creature with 5 or more Tenketsu Ranks deal 1 step of increased damage, against 10 or more, they deal 2 steps of increased damage, and at 25 or more, they deal 3 steps of increased damage (d4->d6->d8->d10->d12->d20)

title: Abilities
text: No Heritage-specific purchasable abilities.

title: Jutsu
text: E-Rank

title: Jyuuken - Gentle Fist
text: E-Rank Type: Clan Unarmed Taijutsu, Rank E Chakra: 8 Damage: (CHA/8+4)d4 Speed: 6 Requires: Byakugan Active Tags: Melee, Link, Piercing, Opener Effects This uses Ninjutsu Damage Bonus, instead of your Physical Damage Bonus, but all damage dealt is reduced by 20%. This technique reduces blocking’s effectiveness by 25%. If you strike an opponent wearing armor this attack cannot wound unless it was a called shot. Every time you hit someone with Jyuuken, you inflict Sealed Tenketsu 1. Half of Jyuuken’s damage is dealt directly to an opponent’s HP while the rest is dealt to their vitality as normal (or hp is they run out of vitality. Jyuuken calculates wounding by taking the total damage and comparing it to the opponents hp wounding thresholds. This may also be added to any Unarmed Taijutsu, Melee Taijutsu Attack, Combo Attack or Finisher providing all of the above effects with the following changes: Stamina Cost is replaced with a Chakra Cost, +8 (if it has both, add them together as a singular Chakra cost, without adding the normal +8), and increasing its Speed by +4. If used as part of an Unarmed Taijutsu, reduce all damage die by 2 steps, to a minimum of d4. Momentum: The combo jutsu gains all above effects of Jyuuken with the additions below The Stamina Cost is replaced with a Chakra Cost, +5 (if it has both, add them together as a singular Chakra cost, without adding the normal +5). On hit, the Sealed Tenketsu increases by 1 per Rank of the Jutsu above E (D = +1, C = +2, etc). Each damage die of the Combo Jutsu has its size reduced by 2 steps, to a minimum of d4 (d4-d6-d8-d10-d12-d20) Sealed Tenketsu This is a Status Effect, applied on hit, that penalizes Chakra Exhaustion rolls equal to its Severity, and half that (rounding down) to Stamina rolls. If you ever fail a Chakra Exhaustion roll while you have this status, whatever technique you were trying to use fails (but you advance in Fatigue as normal), and you lose Hit Points (not Vitality) equal to the Chakra cost of that technique. Sealed Tenketsu stacks fully with itself, but the victim's body naturally tries to correct its chakra flow under pressure. Reduce Sealed Tenketsu by 1 every 10 IC. Whenever the victim advances in Fatigue, reduce its Severity by their Chakra Control Ranks/4, minimum 1. D-Rank

title: Hakke Sanjuuni Shou - Eight Trigrams Thirty-Two Palms
text: D-Rank Type: Combo Taijutsu, Rank D Stamina: 16 Damage: (CHA/8+8)d4 Speed: 12 Special: Finisher 3 Requires: Byakugan active Tags: Finisher 2, Piercing Combo Bonus: +3d4 damage, +1 Stun, +1 Sealed Tenketsu, +1 Immobilize Effects This attack uses your NDB and reduces Blocking’s effectiveness by 25%, ignores armor, and bypasses half of an opponent’s DR. This attack may not be converted with Jyuuken. The immobility from this technique ends when the target's stun condition goes away. Half of this technique’s damage is dealt directly to an opponent’s HP while the rest is dealt to their vitality as normal (or hp is they run out of vitality. This technique calculates wounding by taking the total damage and comparing it to the opponents hp wounding thresholds. C-Rank

title: Hakke Kuushou - Eight Trigrams Empty Palm
text: C-Rank Type: Taijutsu, Rank C Chakra: 8 Damage: (CHA/10+4)d4 Speed: 10 Range: CHA/3 Requires: Byakugan active Tags: Attack, Projectile, Piercing Effects This jutsu follows the same rules as Jyuuken with the following exceptions: This attack does not apply Sealed Tenketsu. The attack may be performed at a Range of CHA/3 and counts as a Ranged Ninjutsu Projectile Attack for purposes of defending. The attack applies knockback of (CHA/10) yards directly away from the user.

title: Hakke Kūshō - Vacuum Wall Palm
text: C-Rank Type: Taijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 14 Chakra: 12 Damage: (CHA/10)d10 Range: 15 Area: Line 3, 15 Speed: 10 Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt, Projectile Effects A compressed palm strike travels through the air. On hit, apply Sealed Tenketsu 1. A creature already suffering Sealed Tenketsu is knocked back a number of yards equal to half its current severity.

title: Hakke Rokujuyon Shou - Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms
text: C-Rank Type: Combo Taijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 24 Damage: (CHA/6+12)d4 Speed: 16 Special: Finisher 4 Requires: Byakugan active Tags: Finisher 4, Piercing Combo Bonus: +5d4 damage, +2 Stun, +1 Sealed Tenketsu, +1 Immobilize Effects This attack uses your NDB and inflicts Sealed Tenketsu 2, reduces Blocking’s effectiveness by 50%, ignores armor, and bypasses half of an opponent’s DR. This attack may not be converted with Jyuuken. The immobility from this technique ends when the target's stun condition goes away. Half of this technique’s damage is dealt directly to an opponent’s HP while the rest is dealt to their vitality as normal (or hp is they run out of vitality. This technique calculates wounding by taking the total damage and comparing it to the opponents hp wounding thresholds.

title: Hakkeshou Kaiten - Eight Trigrams Palm Revolving Heaven
text: C-Rank Type: Taijutsu, Rank C Stamina: 10 + X Chakra: 10 + X Speed: 6 + X Requires: Byakugan active Tags: Utility, Interrupt Effects This technique is always considered a minimum of Speed 6 for determining whether it can Interrupt a given attack, regardless of how its Speed or Base Speed is modified. If used as an Interrupt, you make a parry roll with a +X/2 bonus against the opponent's Accuracy; failure means you are hit, but activate Kaiten immediately afterwards. While spinning Kaiten automatically defends any attack with the result of your initial parry. Kaiten lasts until your next IC and you cannot take any Actions or Interrupts until then. Any time after the first 6 IC have passed, you can end spinning for free including before making an interrupt. Kaiten's radius is up to CHA/20 yards. Anyone in range when it's activated must defend against it as a Rank C AoE Taijutsu attack of its full Speed that uses NDB instead of PDB and has no base damage. Whether the defense is successful or not, anyone targeted is knocked to the edge of the radius. If Kaiten is activated inside of a persistent AoE effect (such as a cloud, or water slick), it ends that effect within its radius. This technique's only true weakness is that it is ineffective if the user cannot spin. If suffering from a -6 or greater immobilization penalty or you are prone, you cannot utilize Kaiten.

title: Juukenpo Ichigekishin - Gentle Fist Art One Blow Body
text: C-Rank Type: Taijutsu, Rank C Chakra: 15+X Speed: 14 Requires: Byakugan active Tags: Utility Effects This jutsu ends the effect of any Immobilization penalty on the Hyūga stemming from an outside source, such as Combat Acupuncture, Clay Bullet, or Attached Meteor; any other effect that restrains them with an outside force like ropes; and any other effect that prevents the Hyūga from taking actions due to an external restraint, such as Water Prison. X is equal to the total Immobilization Penalty the Hyūga is suffering plus the Upkeep cost of all hostile Jutsu that would be ended by this effect. This Jutsu does not prevent status effects from Genjutsu, Poison, or anything that doesn't require the constant presence of something outside of the Hyūga's body. If you are in a clinch you force a grapple roll against anyone currently grappling you, with you gaining +10 to your grapple TN. If you succeed, the grapple ends immediately. This does not automatically destroy walls or break Hyūga out of an area meant to confine them, such as a prison or Doton: Domu. A Hyūga may always use this jutsu if they know it, even if circumstances would otherwise prevent them from acting. B-Rank

title: Hakke Hyaku Nijuuhachi Shou - Eight Trigrams One Hundred Twenty-Eight Palms
text: B-Rank Type: Combo Taijutsu, Rank B Stamina: 34 Damage: (CHA/4+16)d4 Speed: 20 Special: Finisher 5 Requires: Byakugan active Tags: Finisher 5, Piercing Combo Bonus: +10d4 damage, +2 Stun, +2 Sealed Tenketsu, +2 Immobilize while Stunned Effects This attack uses your NDB and reduces Blocking’s effectiveness by 50%, ignores armor, and bypasses the opponent's DR. This attack may not be converted with Jyuuken. The immobility from this technique ends when the target's stun condition goes away. Half of this technique’s damage is dealt directly to an opponent’s HP while the rest is dealt to their vitality as normal (or hp is they run out of vitality. This technique calculates wounding by taking the total damage and comparing it to the opponents hp wounding thresholds.

title: Jūho Sōshiken - Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists
text: B-Rank Type: Ninjutsu, Rank B Chakra: 30 Upkeep: 6 Speed: 12 Tags: Utility, Self Effects Chakra lions form around your hands. Your Gentle Fist attacks gain +1 Accuracy and treat their final damage as 25% higher for Wounding. Whenever one hits a creature suffering Sealed Tenketsu, increase its next Chakra Exhaustion cost by that target's Sealed Tenketsu severity, maximum +6. When you fully defend against a melee attack, you can spend 4 AP to make a Gentle Fist Basic Attack against the attacker as a Speed 6 attack without moving your Initiative Count.

title: Hakke Nihyaku Gjouroku Sho - Eight Trigrams Two-Hundred Fifty-Six Palms
text: A-Rank Type: Combo Taijutsu, Rank A Stamina: 40 Damage: (CHA/4+20)d4 Speed: 30 Special: Finisher 8 Requires: Byakugan active Tags: Finisher 8, Piercing Combo Bonus: +15d4 damage, +3 Stun, +3 Immobilize while Stunned Effects This attack uses your NDB, cannot be blocked and ignores all DR. This attack may not be converted with Jyuuken. The immobility from this technique ends when the target's stun condition goes away. Half of this technique’s damage is dealt directly to an opponent’s HP while the rest is dealt to their vitality as normal (or hp is they run out of vitality. This technique calculates wounding by taking the total damage and comparing it to the opponents hp wounding thresholds. When you land a hit with this technique, you may “activate” their Tenketsu points, burning any number of Sealed Tenketsu ranks the creature has, up to a maximum of your Combo Counter. When you do, the final damage for this Jutsu is increased by 10% per rank of Sealed Tenketsu that they lose this way.

title: Inuzuka
text: Inuzuka Hunters and their ninken train together from an early age. Their partnership combines scent tracking, mobility and coordinated attacks.

title: Bestial Teamwork
text: Ninken are thoroughly trained and impeccably bred, they’re smarter, stronger, faster, and more biologically gifted than any other species of dog you could find anyplace else. This is in large part due to selective breeding making them more impressionable to the chakra of the Inuzuka, and through spending all their time together, the chakra of the Inuzuka will over the course of the Ninken’s life start to increase its gifts even further. Out of combat your ninken is assumed to have ranks and bonuses in the following skills equal to yours and anytime you make a skill roll with the associated skill, your ninken also makes a roll: Athletics Awareness Resistance Stealth Survival In addition to this, every 400 XP you can select one of the following effects to apply to your Ninken: Good Nose: Your Ninken gains +3 to awareness checks, and +1 to Survival checks Sneaky: Your Ninken gains +3 to stealth checks and +1 to Survival checks Hardy: Your Ninken gains +3 to resistance checks and +1 to Survival checks Energetic: Your Ninken gains +3 to athletics checks and +1 to Survival checks Tracker Hound: Your Ninken gains +4 to survival checks. You can take each of these multiple times.

title: Ninken
text: Your Ninken uses your Attributes and relevant Skill ranks unless a clan rule says otherwise. You and your Ninken share a single AP pool and Willpower pool. Its Physical Damage Bonus and maximum Vitality for wound calculation are 50% of yours, and its base Movement is 125% of yours. Ninken Action Economy: Your Ninken may keep its own Initiative Count, move, and use valid Defensive Interrupts normally. Whenever it declares a non-defensive Action on its own IC, spend AP from your shared pool equal to one third of that Action's final Speed, rounded up, minimum 1. If you cannot pay, the Action cannot be declared. This is a command cost, not Speed reduction, and does not itself change the Ninken's IC. A technique that replaces this command cost uses the better listed rate rather than stacking with it. Basic Attack: Speed 8, (AGI/6)d6 Grab: Same as an E-rank Grapple Grapple jutsu that you know with the Trapping and Takedown Tags. Stealth: Your Ninken hides! This is the same speed as a normal hide action, and has all the same requirements. Ninken are assumed to pass all stamina checks they have to make, but will advance in fatigue when you do (They’re empathetic like that), they don’t track a vitality pool, but if they’re hit by an attack they calculate what kind of wound they would take based on their Max Vitality Dodge, parry, block, But it can’t TTH normally.
