title: Kaeshi Uchi - Returning Swing
text: E-Rank You strike into the opening left by the opponent's attack. Rank: E Stamina: +5 Damage: +max(3, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +2 Tags: Chain 2, Club, Attack Effects: If this is your first non-Interrupt Action after resolving an Attack directed at you by the target, this Attack gains +Athletics/5 Accuracy.

title: Furioroshi - Overhead Blow
text: E-Rank You bring the weapon down on the target's head. Rank: E Stamina: +8 Damage: +max(5, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +5 Special: Stun 5 Tags: Chain 3, Club, Attack Effects: Make a Called Shot to the Head using its normal penalty. Gain +15% Wounding. There is no additional Accuracy or failed-Attack penalty.

title: Fumibari - Brace
text: E-Rank You brace the club across the incoming blow. Rank: E Stamina: 4 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Club, Utility, Interrupt Effects: Parry a Melee Attack with +2. On success, reduce Knockback from that Attack to 0. This does not defend against AoEs.

title: Nagi Harai - Wide Swing
text: E-Rank You sweep the weapon across several nearby opponents. Rank: E Stamina: +6 Damage: +max(2, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +3 Area: 2 Special: Knockback 2 Tags: Bukijutsu, Club, Attack Effects: Attack all enemies in reach. Divide Speed×PDB evenly among targets hit. Resolve the Special separately against each fully hit target.

title: Wakibara Uchi - Rib Shot
text: D-Rank You strike the target’s ribs to disrupt their breathing and posture. Rank: D Stamina: +8 Damage: +max(4, floor(STR/10))dS Speed: +1 Tags: Chain 2, Club, Attack Effects: On a full hit, choose one: Smother the Breath — the target’s next Attack takes an Accuracy penalty of Athletics/5; or Rattle the Frame — apply Stun equal to the greater of 4 or half your PDB, rounded down. Smother the Breath ends after that Attack.

title: Yoroi Wari - Armor Crack
text: D-Rank You direct the weapon’s weight into armour or a barrier. Rank: D Stamina: +12 Damage: +max(5, floor(STR/10))dS Speed: +4 Tags: Chain 3, Club, Attack Effects: After defense, deal this Attack’s damage directly to the struck armor piece, Barrier or Construct before resolving damage against its wearer. Apply structural damage-type matchups once. If that protection breaks, resolve the hit against the wearer without that protection; otherwise use its remaining protection normally. This structural strike is additional damage and does not bypass the target’s Defense.

title: Taiatari - Body Check
text: D-Rank This action is available to all Hunters as Shove. It requires no Club or Chain and does not advance Chain.

title: Saki Omori - Head-Heavy Grip
text: D-Rank Chakra and a shifted grip increase the weapon’s leverage. Rank: D Chakra: 14 Upkeep: 3 Speed: 8 Tags: Bukijutsu, Club, Utility Effects: One blunt weapon gains additional Reach equal to the greater of 2 yards or STR/10. Increase its printed Bukijutsu Knockback by 50%, rounded down, before the Status Roll. It may deal Blunt wounds even if another property would change its wound type.

title: Gedan Barai - Low Sweep
text: C-Rank You drive the club through the target’s base instead of through their centre, forcing them to choose between footing and impact. Rank: C Stamina: +9 Damage: +max(5, floor(STR/7))dS Speed: +3 Special: Knockback 4 or Prone Tags: Chain 1, Club, Attack Effects: On a full hit, choose Prone or Knockback equal to the greater of 6 or STR/5, then resolve the Special normally.

title: Mijika Mochi - Short Grip
text: C-Rank You adjust your grip to regain control of the heavy weapon. Rank: C Stamina: 6 Speed: 2 Tags: Chain X, Club, Utility Effects: For your next Club Chain Attack, halve temporary Accuracy penalties and weapon Delay, rounding the remaining values down. If neither applies, gain +15% Final Damage and you may treat it as Piercing by concentrating force into the weapon’s end. The benefit ends if your next non-Interrupt Action is not that Attack.

title: Kabe Kudaki - Wallbreaker
text: C-Rank You strike a wall or defence with the weapon’s full weight. Rank: C Stamina: +15 Damage: +max(8, floor(STR/7))dS Speed: +6 Tags: Bukijutsu, Club, Attack Effects: Against Armor, Barriers and unattended objects, this Attack deals +45% final damage and cannot have its damage reduced below 50% by Partial Success.

title: Kamae Kuzushi - Guard Rattle
text: B-Rank You hit the defending weapon or limb hard enough to shake its hold. Rank: B Stamina: +15 Damage: +max(8, floor(STR/5))dS Speed: +2 Tags: Chain 2, Club, Attack Effects: If a weapon Blocks or Parries this Attack, it suffers WDP equal to its damage-level threshold after defense, even if its wielder takes no damage. It cannot Parry your next Club Chain Attack. Otherwise, a full hit applies Stun equal to the greater of 5 or your PDB, rounded down. This is explicit weapon damage.

title: Daichi Shōgeki - Ground Shock
text: B-Rank You slam the weapon into the ground, sending an impact through nearby footing. Rank: B Stamina: 10 Speed: 4 Tags: Chain X, Club, Attack, AoE Effects: Strike the ground in an Area equal to the greater of 5 yards or STR/5, centered on you. Grounded enemies defend against your normal weapon Accuracy as an AoE; on a full hit, resolve Prone using Athletics against Resistance. No damage is dealt. Breakable ground becomes Rocky Terrain with severity equal to the greater of 2 or Athletics/10, maximum 5, until cleared or repaired. You are not affected by your own Prone effect.

title: Gekitotsu Kudaki - Collision Breaker
text: A-Rank You strike hard enough to send the opponent sprawling. Rank: A Stamina: +26 Damage: +max(13, floor(STR/3))dS Speed: +6 Special: Knockback 12 Tags: Chain 3, Club, Attack Effects: Use the greater of 12 or STR/3 as the printed Knockback. On a full hit, also apply Stun equal to the greater of 4 or your PDB, rounded down. Gain +25% Final Damage and +25% Wounding. No collision is required.

title: Mōshin - Juggernaut Rush
text: A-Rank You charge through the enemy's position and drive them out of the fight's centre. Rank: A Stamina: +22 Damage: +max(10, floor(STR/3))dS Speed: +4 Special: Knockback 12 Tags: Chain 1, Club, Attack, Movement Effects: Use the greater of 12 or STR/3 as the printed Knockback. Before the Attack, use Move with an Attack in a straight line using its full final Speed instead of half. On a full hit, resolve Prone and Knockback with one Athletics Status Roll against Resistance. You may follow the target’s actual movement, ending within Reach. Obstacles stop movement without adding collision damage. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Combo Taijutsu
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES LEARNING REQUIREMENTS ↗

title: Combo Tags
text: Opener: Starts a combo on the target when it hits. Includes the Attack tag. Most Openers are in Unarmed Taijutsu. Combo: Links to a Basic Attack, turning it into a Combo jutsu of the linked technique’s rank. Only one Combo jutsu can modify each attack. Includes the Attack tag; dD uses your unarmed attack’s die size. Finisher X: Ends a combo with a Combo Counter of at least X. Includes the Attack tag.

title: Combos
text: A combo starts with a Combo Counter (CC) of 0, tracked against one target. Each hit with a Combo-tagged jutsu increases CC by 1. Multiply the technique’s Cadence (listed as Combo Counter) by your CC and apply it to the attack. For example, +1dX damage and −1 Speed per CC grants +3dX damage and −3 Speed at CC 3, and no benefit at CC 0. An Opener’s Momentum lasts until the combo ends and applies only to Combo-tagged jutsu, not Finishers. If your CC would go below 0 your combo ends.

title: Switching Combos
text: During a combo, you may use a new Opener to change its Momentum. The new Opener receives the previous Momentum as though it were a Combo jutsu at CC 1. It does not increase your Combo Counter.

title: Breaking a Combo Sequence
text: When a Combo ends, remove its Counter and bonuses. It ends when: - You make any action without the Combo Tag, or the Wait action - You use any interrupt requiring seals. - You execute a Finisher. - You attack a new Target. - You are Stunned. Hitting a clone of your intended target does not break your combo, but it does not increase your combo counter.

title: Rendan - Combo
text: E-Rank A rapid sequence of attacks keeps the opponent under pressure. Combo Counter: +2dD damage, -1 Speed, +1/2 Stamina Tags: Combo

title: Yaburi Yashi - Smashing Palm
text: E-Rank You drive an open palm upward into the opponent’s stomach, knocking the air from their lungs. Stamina: +2 Damage: + 5dD Speed: 10 Combo Bonus: +1 to Target’s Stamina Penalty, +1 Stamina Tags: Finisher 1 Effects: This is an automatic called shot to the abdomen. If it’s blocked, the accrued Stamina Penalty is halved.

title: Hebi Rendan - Snake Combo
text: D-Rank A tricky attack designed to slip around defenses. Damage: +2d10 Speed: -2 Combo Counter: -1 to parry this jutsu, +1/2 Stamina Tags: Combo

title: Shoushitsu - Rising Knee
text: D-Rank The user gets in close and slams their knee into the midsection of their opponent. While not complex, the pain experienced is enough to make them double over in pain, leaving them vulnerable for a few seconds. Stamina: 14 Damage: Basic Unarmed Attack + 4dD Speed: 12 Combo Bonus: +1dD, +2 Stun, +1 Stamina Tags: Finisher 2

title: Asshou - Pressure Palm
text: D-Rank A downward palm strike to the stomach or lower back drives the air from the target’s lungs. Stamina: 19 Damage: (STR/5)d12 Speed: 15 Special: Stun 12 Requires: Target to be Prone. Combo Bonus: Target makes a Stamina Check of (5 Combo Counter) Tags: Finisher 3

title: Gekido Denka - Furious Charge
text: D-Rank You maintain your rhythm while chasing an opponent, keeping the combo alive as they retreat. Stamina: 15 Upkeep: 2 Speed: 6 Tags: Utility, Interrupt Effects: You may use this jutsu in response to entering a combo as a Speed 0 interrupt, increasing its Stamina by 5. You can move without breaking your combo.

title: Shishi Rendan - Lion Combo
text: C-Rank Ideally meant to be used after performing Kage Buyo, this is a series of high-speed punches and kicks. Stamina: +1 Damage: +2d10 Speed: +2 Combo Counter: +1/2 Accuracy (rounded down), +1/2 Stamina Tags: Combo

title: Reikoku Kagai - Relentless Assault
text: C-Rank You close in and hammer the target with repeated strikes, wearing down their guard. Stamina: +4 Damage: + 4d8 Accuracy: -2 Speed: +4 Combo Counter: Blocking/DR is 5% less effective, +15 damage Tags: Combo

title: Shishi Danmaku - Lion Barrage
text: C-Rank A popular way to end the similarly-named combo-assault, the Lion Barrage was often taught to students along with Lion Combo itself. Advanced taijutsu users, however, have been known to appreciate the flexibility and fluidity that comes from separating the techniques. The Lion Barrage is simply a series of fast, strong fist and knee strikes. Stamina: 22 Damage: + 6dD Speed: 14 Accuracy: +4 Combo Bonus: +2dD Tags: Finisher 3

title: Bunka-ken - Splintering Fist
text: C-Rank A powerful blow that smashes through defenses. Your attack carries an almost concussive force behind it, enough to overcome all but the most resilient of enemies. Stamina: +7 Speed: +4 Combo Bonus: Ignore 10% of DR, Enemy gains -2 DR for the rest of the fight Tags: Finisher 5, Link Effects: This is added on to a Basic Unarmed Attack. Your base unarmed dice are treated as rolling their maximum on each dice.

title: Hangeki Rendan - Counter Combo
text: C-Rank You catch a break in your opponent’s rhythm and turn their combo against them. Stamina: 20 Speed: 8 Requires: A Target with an active Combo Counter Tags: Utility Effects: You and your opponent both make Parry rolls. If your result is higher, you immediately break their Combo and can execute any Opener you know as an Interrupt, with a starting Combo Counter equal to whatever your opponent’s was when you used this technique. If you fail, your opponent may immediately use any Combo Jutsu they know against you as an Interrupt.

title: Hasu Rendan - Lotus Combo
text: B-Rank The user of this technique launches into a sequence of strikes designed to alternately wind, disorient, and daze their opponent, combining those effects to prevent their adversary from fighting back effectively for as long as possible. Speed: 4 Combo Bonus: +1dD damage, +1 Stamina, +1 Speed Tags: Combo, Interrupt Effects: This may be used as an interrupt after missing a combo jutsu. This jutsu becomes an attack gaining that attack’s Combo Bonus (On a hit it only increases your CC by a max of 1).

title: Hokuto no Ken - Fist of the North Star
text: B-Rank Delivering a precise, rapid, and powerful series of blows to vital points on an opponent’s body, this causes their blood vessels to spontaneously rupture, resulting in both internal hemorrhaging and dramatic external bleeding, sometimes even resulting in a brief spray of blood immediately after its use. Stamina: 28 Accuracy: +2 Damage: +9dD Speed: 18 Combo Bonus: +1dD, +3 Bleed Tags: Finisher 3 Effects: Even if Hokuto no Ken is parried or blocked, it still inflicts its full Bleed.

title: Shougekishou - Upwards Attacking Palm
text: B-Rank A difficult attack to connect with, the shinobi brings their palm from waist height and strikes upwards to full extension. This makes it exceptionally difficult to connect with, though if the user does hit they'll send their opponent flying away. Stamina: 30 Damage: Basic Unarmed Attack + 5d20 Speed: 16 Accuracy: -6 Combo Bonus: +2 Stun, +3 Knockback Tags: Finisher 2 Effects: If you are in a clinch, the Accuracy penalty is negated. The clinch is ended if this technique hits. After being hit the opponent is knocked back (STR/20) yards and left prone. If no enemy has acted since you executed this Finisher you may use any Finisher of Rank C against the target. This Finisher is treated as if you had 1 less CC as before using Upwards Attacking Palm.

title: Aragami no Jutsu - God of Battle Technique
text: B-Rank Repeated strikes force openings in the opponent’s guard, building momentum with each hit. Stamina: 25 Upkeep: 4 Speed: 6 Tags: Utility, Aura Effects: After your first attack in a combo you increase your CC by +1 every time you hit with a Combo jutsu, to a maximum of 6. This does not stack with the bonus from Combo Master.

title: Mouretsu Tora no Jutsu - Furious Tiger Technique
text: B-Rank You break off your combo with an abrupt transition back into more traditional taijutsu techniques, taking advantage of the momentum and rhythm you’ve built up to deliver one devastating blow. Stamina: +3 Combo Bonus: +1/2 Accuracy (rounded up), +5% damage, +2 Stamina Tags: Finisher 0, Link Effects: This is added on to any Unarmed Taijutsu granting it this jutsu’s Combo Bonuses and the Finisher Tag. This jutsu cannot be your Signature Move.

title: Nanto Rendan - South Star Combo
text: A-Rank A high-level combo rhythm built around sharp, repeated impacts to nerves and joints. Each connected strike makes the next interruption harder to time, gradually turning the target's own loss of coordination into the sequence's momentum. Tags: Combo Effects: Paralysis gained from this Combo Counter is treated as a single source and cannot exceed Paralysis 6. When the Combo ends, any remaining Paralysis from South Star Combo begins reducing by 1 every 10 IC as normal.

title: Akuma no Isoi - Devil’s Rush
text: A-Rank You force chakra through your arms or legs until they overheat, delivering burning strikes at the cost of scorching your own body. Stamina: +6 Damage: +6d6!>6 Speed: -2 Combo Counter: +2d6!>o damage, +2 Ignite Tags: Finisher 1, Link Effects: This is added on to a Basic Attack. If you hit, your target rolls Resistance against your Athletics. On a success, the severity of the Ignite is halved. You suffer Burns with a severity equal to the Ignite you inflict.

title: Taiyou Douyou no Jutsu - Solar Agitation Technique
text: A-Rank A heavy strike to the solar plexus knocks the breath from the target and disrupts their concentration. Stamina: 30 Damage: (STR/5)d20 Speed: 18 Accuracy: +2 Combo Bonus: +3 Stun, +1 to target’s Chakra penalty, +1d20 damage, +2 Stamina Tags: Finisher 5 Effects: This has an additional feature if used against an opponent who was performing handseals. If the total Stun from Solar Agitation is greater than the Speed of their Perform Handseals action, the victim automatically Aborts their Perform Handseals action (as if they had failed the Chakra Control roll against the attack’s damage dealt), and must make a Chakra Exhaustion roll against the technique aborted.

title: Senkagami no Jutsu - God of War Technique
text: A-Rank You recover from a missed finishing blow without losing the rhythm of your assault. Stamina: 10 + 5X Upkeep: 2X Speed: +3 Tags: Utility, Interrupt Effects: This is used in response to missing a Finisher with X being your CC prior to using that attack. Your combo is not broken, instead your Combo Counter is reduced by 1. When your combo is broken, Senkagami’s Upkeep ends; similarly, if you end Senkagami’s Upkeep, your combo ends automatically. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Doton · Earth
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES LEARNING REQUIREMENTS ↗

title: Doton: Earth Style
text: Earth (Doton) In the rare situation that there is no earth available (such as on a boat or space), these jutsu are very difficult to use. A few may remain usable (if, for example, they involve you regurgitating huge amounts of mud, instead of manipulating the environment), but most will not. If you are in such a situation, then you’ll need to supply enough chakra to create the earth yourself and account for this, increasing the base cost of any Doton jutsu used by +5.

title: Doton: Shindou - Earth Release: Tremor
text: E-Rank Extra earth-elemental chakra is infused with another Doton technique. When the technique hits the ground, or somebody touches the ground, it causes the earth itself to shake violently in that exact spot. The property damage potential's pretty impressive, but nothing compared to serious offensive jutsu. Chakra: +4, +X per rank Speed: +2 Seal Speed: +3 Tags: Attack, Link, AoE, Ground-Based Effects: This is added on to any damage-dealing Doton jutsu with X being the jutsu’s rank. Within an area of 3 Yards per Rank, the shaking ground imposes a Stun 2, +X per rank; if the technique Shindou was used with already inflicts a Stun, that Stun is increased by X (instead of Shindou's normal effect). Anyone not targeted by the original attack must dodge Shindou, in which case the original technique's Accuracy bonuses or penalties are ignored. This can be used on its own as Chakra 8, Speed 6, and Seal Speed 6. In this case it's Radius 10, Stun 5, centered on (but not affecting) yourself. It does also require a Defense roll in this case.

title: Ganseki Tsuppari - Rock Thrust
text: E-Rank With a stomp or palm motion, the user drives a fist-sized rock, short stone spike, or narrow column of earth toward the target. It is the basic offensive lesson of Doton: move existing ground quickly enough that it behaves like a projectile. Chakra: 8 Damage: 8d6 Range: 6 Speed: 8 Seal Speed: 6 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Projectile

title: Mimizu no Jutsu - Earthworm Technique
text: E-Rank Sending a tiny rumble through the earth ahead of you, you cause the area around your opponents to explosively sprout spikes from the ground into their ankles and shins! It's rather painful and good for catching a small group of opponents. Chakra: 10 Damage: 4d4 Range: 10 Area: 10 Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 10 Special: Rocky Terrain 1 Tags: Attack, AoE, Environmental, Ground-Based Effects: Dodging this technique allows people to avoid its initial damage, but they are still inside the field of rock spikes. Anyone inside the affected area moving by any means other than the Move action at half speed, takes 1d4+NDB(Yards move inside the Area) Piercing Damage.

title: Monosugai no Jutsu - Earth Shaping Technique
text: E-Rank Chakra softens natural stone beneath your hands into a clay-like texture, allowing you to shape it, dig into it or form handholds. Chakra: 5 Speed: 8 Seal Speed: 5 Tags: Utility, Ground-Based Effects: You can shape the surface of a rock, or mold it in your hands like clay. If you use this before climbing an earthen surface (be it a cliff face or a castle wall) you gain a +5 bonus to Athletics checks associated with climbing it, by making hand- and footholds (for yourself only). This doesn't work if you're, say, climbing up the side of a cliff face using a rope. I really shouldn't have needed to say that, but, yanno.

title: Yurokensei - Tremorsense
text: E-Rank Often placing a hand to the ground after the seals to feel the vibrations, this technique helps you find nearby creatures and enemies. Most importantly, enemies! Their steps, no matter how quiet, can be sensed by you from a great distance! Chakra: 12 Speed: 6 Range: 10 + Chakra Control Seal Speed: 8 Tags: Utility, Self, Ground-Based Effects: You can perform a free Search Action with a +5 bonus against anyone touching the ground or any rock surface (including worked stone, such as brick walls or tiled flooring. As well as those underground), using your Chakra Control in place of your Awareness. Anyone not hiding is located automatically; if you find someone you know exactly where they are the moment you use this (If you beat their TN, this will break their stealth), but do not retain 'sight' of them. This notably cannot be used for the Observe Action against Clones and, in fact, means you cannot use Observe if Tremorsense is your only way of perceiving your opponent.

title: Doki Kantsuu no Jutsu - Earthen Skewer Technique
text: D-Rank Rock Thrust, except actually meant to do serious harm to people outside of training matches. You summon a spike of earth actually capable of skewering an enemy! This can also be more of a solid hit, not as pointy, as to whatever degree they want, and can even look like a fist or some similar, stylized attack, but it's still just big rocks coming at you. Chakra: 16 Damage: 16d8 Range: 12 Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 10 Special: Stun 4 Tags: Attack, Piercing, Ground-Based

title: Doro Bunshin no Jutsu - Mud Clone Technique
text: D-Rank An advanced variation of Bunshin no Jutsu, this jutsu creates solid clones made from the earth beneath a shinobi's feet, which change their appearance to look like the user. They have many advantages over normal clones, but are significantly more difficult to create. Chakra: 12 + 3X Speed: 6 + 2X Seal Speed: 7 + 2X Tags: Utility, Clone Effects: You create X clones. These follow all the rules for regular bunshin (limitations of 3, etc), with the following exceptions. If someone strikes a mud clone with an unarmed attack, they suffer a -4 immobilization penalty, reduced by 1 every 10 IC. If they attack with a melee weapon, they roll 1d20+STR/10 against your 1d20+CHA/8; if they fail, the weapon is stuck in the clone (which is exposed as a clone), and retrieving it is a Speed 5 action that allows another check to pull it free with a +2 bonus for each previous attempt. Against ranged attacks, mud clones can take 50 points of damage before being destroyed (and revealed as clones).

title: Doton: Nebaneba Shita Karada - Earth Style: Sticky Body Technique
text: D-Rank Using the dirt around you to create a mud like substance around your torso, your arms, and your chest. It acts as a powerful medium and can be activated with chakra in order to cause people to stick to you. Chakra: 12 Upkeep: 4 Speed: 6 Seal Speed: 12 Requires: 10 Chakra Control Tags: Utility, Self, Aura Effects This gives you a +2 bonus to your Grapple Offense. When used in a grapple it gains: Control 0. When an opponent makes a melee attack against you, roll a contested Chakra control vs their Resistance. On a success they get stuck which applies the effects of a clinch (only to them). To pry their fist/weapon off they may increase the IC of the attack by 2 or as a Speed 2 action.

title: Doton: Renga no Jutsu - Earth Release: Practice Brick Technique
text: D-Rank A rudimentary defensive Earth Release used to raise a quick barricade from existing ground. The wall is not impressive by veteran standards, but it is fast, cheap, and particularly useful when several shinobi build a defensive line together. Chakra: 14 Range: 8 Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 12 Tags: Utility, Interrupt, Environmental, Ground-Based Effects: Raise a wall up to 4 yards long and 2 yards high with HP equal to 50 + (NDB×5). It lasts 50 IC or until destroyed. As an Interrupt, the wall can protect one creature from an attack originating more than 5 yards away if the wall can physically stand between source and target. If the wall is destroyed, remaining damage carries through normally. Adjacent Practice Brick walls may touch, but each keeps its own HP.

title: Iwa Funsai Buin - Rock Smashing Staff
text: D-Rank You shape nearby rock or chakra-bound earth into a heavy blunt weapon, such as a hammer or staff. Chakra: 10 + X/2 Upkeep: 1 + X/10 (Rounded Up) Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 10 Tags: Utility, Self, Creation Effects: You craft a Club upgrading it using X Artisan Points up to your Chakra Control - 2. You may choose to double the Base Speed and Upkeep of this Technique to create a second Club in your other hand during the activation of this Technique and both weapons gain the dual property. The Club(s) gains the following effects and Upgrade: The Club lasts until you let go of it or end this Technique’s Upkeep You may perform Handseals for Doton jutsu by increasing the Seal Speed by 4 per weapon The weapon has a third of its normal Durability (2) Missing an attack makes an Area 1 underneath the target that becomes Rocky Terrain 1. +2 area for every additional rank in this ability

title: Jishin Shushou - Earth Shaking Palm
text: D-Rank Harnessing a large amount of chakra into the palm of your hand, you then slam it down into the ground in front of you to blast rocks and debris up to distract your opponents, allowing you to quickly escape their field of view or capitalize on the momentary distraction. Chakra: 15 Area: 10 Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 13 Special: Stun 5 Tags: Attack, Utility, AoE, Ground-Based Effects: You may immediately Hide as part of this technique.

title: Shinjuu Zanshu no Jutsu - Double Suicide Decapitation Technique
text: D-Rank After thoroughly concealing yourself, this technique allows you to move through the ground for a short amount of time, long enough to position yourself under the enemy and pull them down under the ground. Chakra: 14 Range: 8 Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 8 Tags: Attack, Melee, Ground-Based Effects: This technique can only be used from stealth or underground, and uses your Taijutsu accuracy (rather than Ninjutsu). If you hit, you inflict them with a -1 Immobilization Penalty per point your Accuracy beats their defense, to a maximum of -6. They can dig themselves out from underground as a Speed 10 action which removes the penalty entirely. Until they get rid of the Immobilization penalty from this technique they can not move (as they are stuck to the spot), but can otherwise attack and defend themselves.

title: Tama no Nendo - Clay Bullet
text: D-Rank Pushing your chakra into the ground beneath you, you pull up a ball of earth and mud, globby and chakra filled that you then launch or literally throw sometimes at the opponent. Once on them, the mud is held semi-cohesive by the chakra lacing it, which can restrict the victim's movement. Chakra: 13 Damage: 8d10 Accuracy: +2 Range: 6 Speed: 12 Seal Speed: 10 Special: Immobilization 3, This technique receives only half your damage bonus. Tags: Attack, Projectile, Blunt Effects: The Immobilization penalty fades by 1 every 15 initiative counts. Someone affected by this mud may make a 1d20+STR/5 (theirs) vs. 1d20+CHA/5 (yours) check to break free. This is a Speed 5 action; for every point they succeed by, the penalty is reduced by 1. For every 5 points they succeed by, the action's Speed is reduced by 5 (potentially all the way down to 0). If you hit someone with this technique while they are still suffering from the Immobilization of a previous application, you do not reapply the penalty but extend its current penalty another 10 IC.

title: Deiryū no Henkō - Mud Flow Deflect
text: C-Rank As implied up there, this can be used to protect anyone in range. Chakra: 24 Range: 16 Speed: 8 Seal Speed: 8 Tags: Interrupt Effects: You parry an attack with a +3 bonus. Mud Flow Deflect may be used against any valid attack, even one not targeting you. Earth Shore Return can't be used against attacks originating 5 yards or less away from you and can only protect a single target. This works against elements that are weak to it up to A rank, elements that are strong to it up to C-rank, and all other Jutsu (including Taijutsu) up to B-rank. Fuuma Shuriken).

title: Dochuu Eigyo no Jutsu - Moving Underground as if Swimming Technique
text: C-Rank This technique reduces the consistency of earth into less than that of fine sand by channeling chakra into it, allowing the user to dig through it with ease. This affects the entire body, and the earth returns to its normal consistency after they've passed. Chakra: 14 Upkeep: 4 Speed: 2 Tags: Utility, Self, Ground-Based Effects: This may only be used while underground, such as from the effects of Moguragakure no Jutsu, or Buried to burrow through solid rock. While you maintain this technique's upkeep, you can move underground up to a yard deep (any deeper any you would begin to be crushed by the pressure of the earth around you), using CHA/2 in place of AGI for determining your movement speed.

title: Doro Nami no Jutsu - Mud Wave Technique
text: C-Rank Your chakra being applied to your legs, you turn the ground below your feet into mud which you then stand upon, riding the wave at increased speeds as you flow across the battlefield. This is a good mode of transportation, and a good way to enhance an earth attack! Chakra: 15 Upkeep: 5 Speed: 6 Seal Speed: 15 Tags: Utility, Self, Aura Effects: You increase your AGI stat for the purposes of movement by CHA/2. You may choose to end this technique at any time, or as part of a D rank or higher damage dealing Doton jutsu. If you end it as part of a jutsu, that technique gains a Stun equal to 2+(your ninjutsu damage bonus)/3, or increases its existing Stun by that much, from absorbing the mud used in this technique. This is incompatible with effects which increase your normal movement speed--such as the Runner ability, and Racing Thunder Technique. While Mud Wave is active, you do not receive their benefits.

title: Doroku Gaeshi - Earth Shore Return
text: C-Rank Slamming both hands into the ground, the user can cause a large rectangle wall of earth to pop up in front of them, covering whatever attack someone may be directing at them. Chakra: 14 + 2X Range: 16 Speed: 5+X Seal Speed: 8 + 2X Tags: Interrupt Effects: X is the rank of the Jutsu interrupted and may be used against any valid attack, even one not targeting you. Earth Shore Return can't be used against attacks originating 5 yards or less away from you and can only protect a single target. This creates a wall that absorbs X50 + NDB times the Speed of the Attack. If destroyed, any remaining damage carries on to you (in which case you cannot defend against it further) or whoever else you used this to protect (in which case, they can).

title: Doryuu Taiga - Earth Flow River
text: C-Rank You cause a long stretch of nearby ground to become mud and slide your opponents down a torrenting river of rocks and dirt, spewing them out at the end. This often leaves people hurt, and disoriented! Chakra: 22 Damage: 30d6 Line: 10, 20 Speed: 15 Seal Speed: 15 Special: Knockback CHA/8 Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt, Ground-Based Effects: Everyone receives a Stun equal to how far they are Knocked Back; the stun is divided by 3 if they block. If this is blocked by an effect which halts its progress (such as Earth Shore Return or is parried), nobody behind that effect is affected.

title: Doton: Kajūgan no Jutsu - Added-Weight Rock
text: C-Rank Earth chakra multiplies the target's effective weight until even lifting a foot feels argumentative. Chakra: 22 Accuracy: -2 Range: 15 Speed: 12 Seal Speed: 16 Special: Mass +3 Tags: Attack, Utility, Doton Effects: On a full hit, Movement is reduced by 20% and all non-Search Actions have Base Speed +1 for 20 IC. This stacks with itself, replacing the duration and increasing the severity of it’s effects. A target may spend Speed 6 and pass Resistance vs your Chakra Control to end it early. This does not stack with itself.

title: Doton: Keijūgan no Jutsu - Light-Weight Rock
text: C-Rank Weight drains from the body until movement becomes almost careless. Chakra: 20 Upkeep: 5 Range: Touch Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 16 Tags: Utility Effects: A willing target gains +20% Movement and reduces falling damage by 75%. Their PDB is reduced by 1 while this is maintained.

title: Kaigeki Chite - Crushing Earth Hand
text: C-Rank You create a huge hand of rock that you can manipulate and wield, in place of your actual hand. Though you have no physical connection to the large hand, your chakra flowing through it is controlled by an intense focus on your right hand. Or left hand, if that's your main. Chakra: 20 Range: 10 + CHA/2 Speed: 15 Seal Speed: 15 Tags: Utility, Creation Effects: You can use the giant rock hand to use any non grapple E or D rank Taijutsu technique, or simply a basic attack, as long as the ability is one that anyone could learn, utilizing your hands. No kicks or clan jutsu allowed! It may use C rank techniques, but doing so counts as 2 uses. The rock hand is good for only 2 uses, at which point it breaks apart into ordinary rocks unless you pay its Chakra cost again; doing so has no speed or seal speed, but still has its Chakra cost and preserves it for 2 more uses. The hand uses your CHA + 50 as its STR, for the purpose of determining its damage bonus.

title: Moguragakure no Jutsu - Hiding Like a Mole Technique
text: C-Rank Channeling your chakra into the ground below you, you turn the dirt or earth or rock into fine sand. It affects your entire body so you simply slide down quickly, but only making a tunnel big enough for one person. After digging your way down, you can sense everything going on above still, and can even cover the hole to make it seem like you never even burrowed away. Chakra: 18 Speed: 6 Seal Speed: 12 Tags: Interrupt, Ground-Based Effects: You dive down a yard underground, but are afflicted with Stun 6. If used as an Interrupt, this requires a dodge roll with a +5 bonus; success, even partial, will allow you to trigger the second half of this jutsu. You are hidden at Stealth 2 and your opponent is allowed an immediate Awareness roll against your Stealth TN (though this does not apply to the cumulative bonus they would get for searching for you). Anyone who fails has no idea how you escape or assumes the attack destroyed you. While underground, you have an additional +5 Stealth and attempts to Track you take a -5 penalty. You can return to the surface as a Speed 0 Action. Anyone can attack you while you are under the ground, and any defensive roll you take while submerged takes a -6 penalty. An attack which deals at least CHA + 50 damage will break through the surface of the earth above you, ending your submerged state forcefully, but the actual damage dealt to you will be reduced by half (after seeing if it does enough to break the earth above you). The Damage of Raiton Attacks is doubled before all calculations when targeting you in this manner.

title: Retsudotensho - Split Earth Turn Around Palm
text: C-Rank This technique causes the ground surrounding the enemy to spiral inwards on itself, burying them alive or crushing them. This technique is capable of causing quite a bit of damage to the area. This technique is much more damaging if used in rocky mountainous areas, or inside a cave. Chakra: 26 Damage: 20d12 Range: 25 Area: 12 Speed: 22 Seal Speed: 20 Special: Rocky Terrain 6 Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt, Ground-Based

title: Doryu Ken - Earth Style Fist
text: B-Rank By surrounding your arm or leg in a coat of solidified earth, you can attack an opponent while being protected from direct contact with them. Chakra: 18 Upkeep: 2 Speed: 6 Seal Speed: 18 Tags: Utility, Self, Aura Effects: So long as this technique is maintained, your taijutsu attacks are enhanced. You suffer no 'on-contact' effects (such as damage from punching a foe covered in spikes) from performing unarmed or combo attacks. Additionally, unarmed parries cannot be used against your attacks and any weapon parries take triple the amount of damage to their durability.

title: Doryuu Jouheki - Earth Flow Rampart
text: B-Rank The most powerful direct Doton-based defense, the user either manipulates the surrounding terrain or generates (using chakra!) and spits out an prodigious amount of flowing earth which forms a wall and solidifies. Either way, this creates a barrier coated with chakra that will stop most attacks totally. Chakra: 25 + X Speed: 20 Seal Speed: 24 Tags: Interrupt, Environmental Effects: This jutsu can only be used against attacks which originated more than 5 yards away from you. Used against area-of-effect or multi-target attacks, this may protect multiple people, as long as they can all be placed behind the same 15 yard long line. You may spend AP to reduce the Seal Speed of this jutsu up to half. You create what is basically a huge wall! It can be up to the following dimensions: Length = X, Width = X/4, Height = X/2 and has HP equal to (NDB + X)10 . It takes 50% extra damage from Raiton, but only half damage from Suiton and Katon. This lasts for 100 IC or until its HP is reduced to 0.

title: Doryuukatsu - Earth Flow Divide
text: B-Rank You force chakra through underground Dragon Veins, splitting the earth into a deep chasm. The rupture can tear through walls, camps and barricades. Chakra: 35 Damage: 64d6 Line: 5, Up to Chakra Control Yards Speed: 20 Seal Speed: 20 Tags: Attack, Blunt, AoE, Ground-Based Effects: Any damage from this technique is tripled against any structures.

title: Doton: Domu - Earth Release: Iron Skin
text: B-Rank You direct chakra to flow through the skin over all portions of your body, increasing your body's defensive power to its utmost limit. This causes your skin to darken in response to the earth-elemented chakra, taking on a dull gray-brown, almost black color. This hardening also empowers your physical attacks, making this a useful, if draining, all-purpose technique. Chakra: 26 Upkeep: 8 Speed: 12 Seal Speed: 20 Tags: Utility, Self, Aura Effects: You gain CHA/3 Damage Reduction, and increase your Physical Damage Bonus by that amount /10. Raiton bypasses all this technique’s effects.

title: Doton: Dorou Domu Kekkai - Earth Release: Earth Prison Dome of Magnificent Nothingness
text: B-Rank This creates a dome chamber around a small group of enemies, which you enlace in your own chakra to make it extra hard to escape. Chakra: 38 Upkeep: 10 Area: 20 Speed: 20 Seal Speed: 25 Tags: Attack, AoE, Environmental Effects: This creates a dome of earth directly in front of you, with you at the edge of its radius. Anyone who cannot dodge is trapped inside the dome. The dome has 300 + NDB10 HP. Every 5 IC which pass, the following effects occur: Everyone inside the dome has their Chakra penalty increased by 1. You have your Chakra penalty reduced by 1 per person inside the dome. The dome regains NDB3 HP, up to its maximum. You must keep one hand on the dome at all times; if you break contact the above effects end (and cannot be reestablished), but the dome retains any HP it had at that point.

title: Doton: Doryou Dango - Earth Release: Earth Mausoleum Dumpling
text: B-Rank Channelling chakra into your arms and the ground below you, you place your hands on the earth and lift up an incredibly large (no, really, just look at the Area on this thing!) ball of earth and rock, which is then thrown at your enemies. Chakra: 32 Damage: 25d20 Range: 50 Area: 40 Speed: 21, Delay 10 Seal Speed: 22 Special: Stun 12 Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt

title: Doton: Gōremu no Jutsu - Earth Golem
text: B-Rank Stone pulls itself into a broad-shouldered servant animated by the user's chakra. Chakra: 34 Upkeep: 8 Speed: 20 Seal Speed: 24 Tags: Utility, Creation, Ground-Based Effects: Create one golem with HP CHA×4, DR NDB×2, Movement equal to half yours, and Basic Unarmed Attack using your Ninjutsu Accuracy for 24d8 Blunt damage. The golem shares your action economy. When you take an Action you may have the golem Move, Basic Attack, Block, or Take the Hit in your place where legal. Only one Earth Golem from you may exist at a time.

title: Doton: Iwagakure no Jutsu - Earth Release: Hidden Among Rocks Technique
text: B-Rank This technique allows you to blend into rocks and remain hidden. Even the texture of your body takes on that of the stones, and it's quite possible (indeed, more than a few experienced Huntsman have embarrassing stories about it) to have an enemy physically sit on you without realizing you're there. Chakra: 28 Upkeep: 12 Speed: 16 Seal Speed: 24 Tags: Utility, Ground-Based Effects: This allows you to enter level 3 Stealth, and gives a +10 bonus to your stealth checks while it's maintained. However, it requires rocky terrain (such as the inside of a cave, a mountain path, the debris from a destroyed wall, or a large boulder), and you cannot move (blinking and breathing are okay) while it's maintained.

title: Doton: Yomi Numa - Swamp of the Underworld
text: B-Rank Solid ground liquefies into a deep adhesive bog under the target's feet. Chakra: 32 Range: 35 Area: 20 Speed: 18 Seal Speed: 24 Special: Immobilization 5 Tags: Attack, AoE, Environmental, Ground-Based Effects: On a full hit apply Immobilization 5, reduced by 1 every 15 IC after leaving the Area. The swamp persists for 40 IC. Creatures moving through it use half Movement unless an effect lets them ignore Ground-Based terrain.

title: Iwa Bunshin - Rock Clone
text: B-Rank You either gather animate rocks from you, or actually generate them with chakra and regurgitate a stream of stones (somehow, you're protected from a cut esophagus or chipped teeth during this process). Either way, the rocks then take on a human shape and appearance. Chakra: 10 + 6X Speed: 10 + 2X Seal Speed: 10 + 3X Requires: Bunshin no Jutsu Tags: Utility, Clone Effects: You create X (to a max of 3) clones that can look like yourself or anyone else present. If they look like someone else, that person may then hide amongst your clones to receive the normal benefits of having clones; these can even be added to their own clones. Rock clones can take 100+(your ninjutsu damage bonus)5 points of damage before being destroyed, or exposed as clones, and take only half damage from AoE attacks. Rock clones use your attributes, even if they're imitating someone else. They may take the following actions: [1 AP] Dodge: Usable if the clone needs to defend itself. [4 AP] Attack: The clone may perform a basic unarmed attack. This does benefit from Power Attack or Unarmed Focus, if you have those abilities. [X AP] Move: Every 3 Speed of the Move action costs 1 AP.

title: Doryuudan - Earth Dragon Blast
text: A-Rank A dragon-like head of rock, mud, and dirt rises up from the ground, its maw wide open. From said maw, it launches dozens of high-velocity projectiles of dense, chakra-infused earth! While not as visually impressive as some techniques, Doryuudan is incredibly demanding upon its user--and incredibly devastating to its victims. Chakra: 40 Damage: 64d10 Range: 60 Speed: 26 Seal Speed: 30 Special: Stun 10 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Blunt Effects: Blocking reduces this technique's damage by only 25%.

title: Doton: Chidoukaku - Earth Release: Moving Earth Core
text: A-Rank The user lowers or raises the ground in the surrounding area at high speed, creating giant depressions or spires. Despite how this might seem, it's fairly harmless to the surrounding area. People, plants, and buildings in the affected area will be largely undisturbed. The sides of the hole or spire are quite sturdy, and it's not in danger of collapsing on its own. Chakra: 20 + 3X Speed: 28 Seal Speed: 30 Tags: Utility, Interrupt Effects: X has a max of 10. This affects everything in a square of up to 50 yards on a side, centered on its user. It moves the ground in that area XNDB yards straight up, or straight down. If you manage to use this as an interrupt (uh, yeah, good luck with that), this will allow you to avoid a technique if you move yourself out of its range. If raised, it has an HP equal to 10 its height. If lowered, projectile attacks can multiply their range by X granting a -X penalty to its accuracy.

title: Doton: Ganchūsō - Rising Stone Spears
text: A-Rank The ground answers in a forest of angled stone meant to herd as much as impale. Chakra: 42 Damage: 35d12 Range: 45 Area: 25 Speed: 22 Seal Speed: 28 Special: Rocky Terrain 4 Tags: Attack, AoE, Ground-Based, Piercing Effects: After the initial attack the Area becomes Rocky Terrain 4 for 40 IC. A creature that fully Dodges may choose to move to any edge of the Area rather than only the distance its Dodge normally permits.

title: Doton: Sando no Jutsu - Earth Release: Mountain Earth Technique
text: A-Rank The user creates two monolithic walls up from the ground, destroying the environment for several hundred yards in either direction, and sends them at one another. As they approach each other, their momentum builds, starting off slow and ending with a collision that removes the third dimension from anything unlucky enough to be caught between them. Chakra: 45 Damage: 150d6 Accuracy: -10 Range: 100 Area: 80 Speed: 30, Delay 30 Seal Speed: 26 Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt Effects: This technique cannot be parried and its damage is doubled for determining if it inflicts wounds. If (Heh, “If”) it does cause a wound, it also causes an extra wound of the next lower severity, two of the severity below that, and so forth. Thus, if it inflicted a Critical Wound, it would also inflict a Severe, two Majors, and three Minors.

title: Iwa Renda no Jutsu - Rock Barrage Technique
text: A-Rank After performing the necessary seals, the user channels chakra into the rocks and stone around them. Their chakra causes large rocks to shatter into smaller ones, which are then launched as high-velocity projectiles towards potentially dozens of targets. Chakra: 38 Damage: (10 + 2X)d20 Accuracy: +X/8 Range: 7 Base NDB Speed: 30 Seal Speed: 26 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Blunt Effects: You fire up to (base ninjutsu damage bonus) projectiles. You may target the same person multiple times with X being the number of projectiles at a single target. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Dual Bukijutsu
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Dual Bukijutsu
text: With a weapon in each hand, you can draw the guard with one strike and punish it with the next.

title: Nidan Giri - Double Cut
text: E-Rank Both weapons attack during the same entry, but they do not have to succeed together. Rank: E Stamina: +4 Speed: +2 Damage: +floor(STR/15)dS Tags: Chain 1, Dual, Attack Effects: Make one Attack with each held weapon at 55% final damage each. Roll Accuracy separately. If either hits, Chain 1 is established.

title: Hasami Ashi - Scissor Step
text: E-Rank The two weapons close like shears while the feet circle the target. Rank: E Stamina: +3 Damage: +max(2, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +0 Accuracy: +1 Tags: Chain 1, Dual, Attack Effects: Requires two weapons. Choose one to attack and use the other to threaten the defender. If the target Parries, it takes a penalty of Athletics/5. If it Dodges, double that Defense’s final Speed when advancing its next action; Interrupt validity is unchanged.

title: Kōgo Giri - Alternating Cuts
text: E-Rank The hands alternate in a broken rhythm, changing line and timing with every swing. Rank: E Stamina: +5 Damage: +max(3, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +1 Tags: Chain 2, Dual, Attack Effects: If this Attack uses a different leading weapon from your previous damaging Dual Chain Attack, gain +Athletics/5 Accuracy. Declare the leading weapon before the Defense; it supplies this Attack’s damage type and weapon properties.

title: Hasami Uchi - Closing Pair
text: E-Rank The finisher commits both hands to the same exchange. Rank: E Stamina: +8 Speed: +5 Damage: +floor(STR/15)dS Tags: Chain 3, Dual, Attack Effects: Make one Attack with each weapon at 65% Final Damage, rolling and defending separately. Combine successful hits for Wounding only. If both fully hit the same creature, resolve Prone using Athletics against Resistance. Resolve Chain progression once.

title: Soete Uke - Off-Hand Catch
text: E-Rank The off-hand weapon exists to solve the problems the leading weapon creates. Rank: E Stamina: 4 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Dual, Utility, Interrupt Effects: Parry a targeted Melee Attack with the off-hand weapon at +Athletics/5. On full success, your next Dual Chain Attack gains +15% Final Damage if it is your next non-Interrupt Action. This does not defend against AoEs.

title: Kaiten Randa - Turning Flurry
text: E-Rank The user turns both weapons through the surrounding space at once, each hand carving a separate line through the enemies close enough to be caught in the rotation. Rank: E Stamina: +6 Speed: +5 Area: 2 Damage: +floor(STR/15)dS Tags: Bukijutsu, Dual, Attack Effects: Make one Accuracy roll with each weapon against every chosen enemy in Area; each successful weapon deals 50% final damage.

title: Sayū no Kamae - Split Guard
text: D-Rank Each weapon asks a separate defensive question. Rank: D Stamina: +8 Speed: +3 Damage: +floor(STR/10)dS Tags: Chain 2, Dual, Attack Effects: Make one Attack with each weapon at 60% final damage. The target chooses and resolves a Defense against each Attack. If it uses the same broad Defense against both, its second roll takes −Athletics/5. If it uses two different broad Defenses, each successful hit gains +2dS. Chain advances if either Attack hits.

title: Jūji Todome - Cross Finish
text: D-Rank You cross both attack lines through different parts of the target, forcing the defender to contain two wound lines at once before either hand can recover. Rank: D Stamina: +12 Damage: +max(6, floor(STR/10))dS Speed: +6 Tags: Chain 3, Dual, Attack Effects: Requires two weapons. On a full hit, choose two different wound locations; if the Attack wounds, apply one wound at the normal location and a second wound one severity lower at the other location. The secondary wound cannot exceed Minor severity.

title: Te no Sasoi - Hand Feint
text: D-Rank Two visible threats are used to split attention before the attack starts. Rank: D Stamina: 5 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Dual, Utility Effects: Oppose the target’s Awareness with Espionage. On success, choose Dodge or Parry; that Defense takes a penalty of 2 plus 1 per full 5 points you won by, maximum 6, against your next Dual Chain Attack.

title: Sōryū - Paired Flow
text: D-Rank The weapons settle into a shared rhythm, one hand recovering while the other remains live. Rank: D Stamina: 9 Upkeep: 2 Speed: 7 Tags: Bukijutsu, Dual, Utility Effects: While wielding two weapons, gain +Athletics/5 Parry. When a Dual Chain Attack uses a different leading weapon from your previous Dual Chain Attack in the current Chain, reduce its final Speed by 20%, rounded down, subject to normal Speed minimums. Apply this once per Attack.

title: Nite Oi - Split Pursuit
text: C-Rank Each hand takes a different opponent, opening pressure on two fronts before the user decides which target to pursue. Rank: C Stamina: +8 Speed: +2 Damage: +floor(STR/7)dS Tags: Chain 1, Dual, Attack Effects: Make one Attack with each weapon at 60% final damage. The attacks must target different creatures. If either hits, choose one hit creature as your chained target.

title: Sente Kōtai - Changing Lead
text: C-Rank The style changes which weapon is “leading” without changing what is held. Rank: C Stamina: 5 Speed: 1 Tags: Chain X, Dual, Utility Effects: Swap which held weapon is leading. Your next Dual Chain Attack may use either weapon’s damage type and ignores temporary Accuracy penalties specific to the other hand. If it is your next non-Interrupt Action, it also gains +15% Final Damage.

title: Buki Gatame - Weapon Lock
text: B-Rank The two weapons close around the line the defender committed, trapping that weapon between them for the next exchange. Rank: B Stamina: +14 Damage: +max(6, floor(STR/5))dS Speed: +3 Tags: Chain 2, Dual, Attack Effects: Requires two weapons. On a full hit, if the target used a weapon to Block or Parry, that weapon cannot be used to Block or Parry your next Dual Chain attack.

title: Sōgeki Gaeshi - Counterpair
text: B-Rank A full parry with one hand opens the line for the other. Rank: B Stamina: 10 Speed: 4 Tags: Chain X, Dual, Attack, Interrupt Effects: After fully Parrying a targeted Melee Attack, make an off-hand Basic Weapon Attack against the attacker at full damage if it is within Reach. Pay this technique’s Stamina and Interrupt Speed instead of that Basic Attack’s costs. The counter has its own Accuracy and Defense and is Chain X.

title: Jūji Shokei - Crossed Execution
text: A-Rank One hand attacks the target while the other deliberately destroys the guard protecting them. Rank: A Stamina: +26 Speed: +6 Damage: +floor(STR/3)dS Tags: Chain 3, Dual, Attack Effects: Requires two weapons. Make one Attack with each at full damage, rolling and defending separately. One strikes the target and gains +25% Wounding; the other strikes a held weapon or worn armor piece. Resolve that structural hit as a direct attack on the item, using normal item defenses and armor matchups. It does not also damage the wielder. Chain ends after both attacks resolve.

title: Bunryū - Divergent Current
text: A-Rank Each weapon carries a different chakra treatment, letting the pair answer two different defenses in the same exchange. Rank: A Chakra: 26 Upkeep: 6 Speed: 12 Tags: Bukijutsu, Dual, Utility Effects: Maintain two different weapon-coating effects you know, one on each held weapon. Pay both activation costs and this technique’s Chakra cost. While maintained, pay this Upkeep plus only the higher coating Upkeep. Their effects apply to their respective weapons normally; ending Divergent Current ends both coatings unless their normal Upkeeps are paid. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: The Eight Gates
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Introduction
text: The Eight Gates limit chakra flow to protect the body from overexertion. Opening them temporarily increases physical performance, but can inflict serious injuries. Each Gate must be learned separately.

title: Rules
text: When the gates are opened, you have access to a special, second pool of Action Points, starting at 0 and with a maximum of half your normal AP maximum (in other words, AGI/4), called Gate Action Points Pool (GAP Pool). AP provided by the gates (listed under "AP Gain" in their respective entries) goes into your GAP pool. GAP may only be spent on the following things: - Reducing the Speed of taijutsu attacks - Abilities provided by the gates - The ability Principle of Motion - The ability Surge (though if improving Accuracy, only for unarmed attacks) Your regular AP may still be spent normally, as well as on abilities provided by the gates. Once you're able to access the gates, you gain the following two actions:

title: Open Gates
text: (Speed 5 + 3 X, Stamina 15 + 5 X) You open one or more of the eight gates. By default, this opens only a single gate; you may choose to open several at once, for a total of 1 + X gates. Doing this, however, drastically increases the strain put upon your body, causing you to immediately suffer X wounds (as described in Wounding, below). If you are in stealth this reduces your TN by 10 per gate open. For example, opening two additional Gates uses X = 1: Speed 8, Stamina 20 and one immediate self-inflicted Wound.

title: Close Gates
text: (Speed 5 + 5 X) You take several moments to calm yourself and stabilize your chakra flow before willing your chakra gates shut. This shuts all open gates, with X being the number currently opened. Unlike opening, closing them is all-or-nothing.

title: Wounding
text: Each Action with a Stamina or Chakra cost while the Gates are open has the following self-wounding chance: (5 (gate opened) + (final speed) + (AP used))% For example, with Gate 2 open, a Speed 8 unarmed attack reduced to Speed 4 by spending 4 AP gives a self-wounding chance of (5 × 2) + 4 + 4 = 18%. Roll 1d100; a result of 18 or lower inflicts a Wound. These Wounds cannot normally be prevented or reduced in severity. Perfected Release explicitly permits one reduction per battle for Gate 6 or lower. The gates inflict Blunt wounds. When you suffer one, roll for location. The first wound you suffer on a given location in a single week (real-world day) from the gates is a Minor wound. The second is a Major, the third a Severe, and the fourth a Critical. For example, if you wounded yourself using the gates six times, and rolled head three times, left arm once, right arm once, and chest once, you'd have: - A minor, major, and severe head wound - Two minor arm wounds - And a minor chest wound For a total of six different wounds. Additionally, any wound-healing abilities (such as some Medical ninjutsu, or wound-healing clan abilities) cannot be used while the gates are still open: you have to close them first.

title: How to Read
text: Each gate contains a brief description of what it does, an "AP Gain" number, and an ability. Every time the IC reaches a multiple of 10, you gain the AP listed under AP Gain, added to your GAP Pool. If that pool is full, any excess AP is simply lost. You only receive the AP Gain of the highest gate you have open. Each gate also has a listed ability, such as the first gate's Enhanced Strength and the second gate's Rejuvenation. You have access to the abilities of all opened gates. For example, with the third gate open you would be able to use Enhanced Strength (first), Rejuvenation (second), and Enhanced Power (third).

title: Restrictions
text: The eight gates work poorly with weapons, much to the woe of many shinobi. This has a great deal to do with their nature: while they grant overwhelming power, the user's technique tends to suffer as a result. Weapons simply aren't meant to be used by a body tearing itself apart, or swung with that sort of speed and force. Accordingly, some of the abilities granted by the gates do not work with weapons as well as they do with unarmed attacks. Specifically... Enhanced Strength: Cannot be used with weapons. Enhanced Power: Cannot be used with weapons. Enhanced Speed: Does not increase weapon Accuracy. Extreme Speed: May not be used to raise weapon Accuracy. Additionally, members of the Hozuki clan cannot access the gates when using their Hydration Technique--their body has no bones, muscles, or circulatory system to enhance. Activating the technique will not close any open gates, but will suspend all their effects (including AP generation, ability to spend GAP, access to the Gates’ abilities, self wounding, etc) until they have completely reformed.

title: The First Gate - Kaimon - Gate of Opening
text: Located in the brain, opening this gate removes the body's ability to limit the output of its muscles. AP Gain: 5 Enhanced Strength You can spend AP to increase your Physical Damage Bonus for a single attack, at the rate of 1 AP per 0.4. You may spend up to STR/10 AP this way.

title: The Second Gate- Kyuumon - Gate of Healing
text: Also located in the brain, the second regulates the body's breakdown of stored energy. By opening it, the body gains the ability to access its energy reserves faster than would normally be physically possible. AP Gain: 10 Rejuvenation You may spend AP at any time to reduce your Stamina penalty. Every 2 AP spent reduces your Stamina penalty by 1.

title: The Third Gate - Seimon - Gate of Life
text: Located on the spinal cord between the shoulders, opening the third gate results in one's blood vessels dilating, causing increased blood flow throughout the body. Opening this gate also has the effect of turning the user's skin a very marked reddish color. AP Gain: 15 Accelerated Bloodflow The increased flow of blood to all regions of your body keeps your cells oxygenated and able to perform at their peak. You reduce your Fatigue penalties by the number of gates you have open. Therefore, if you were at Fatigue 4 with the third gate open, you would have only a -1 penalty to Accuracy and a -5 penalty to defenses.

title: The Fourth Gate - Shoumon - Gate of Pain
text: Located below the Gate of Life, the fourth gate got its name for a very simple reason: beyond what's normal even for the other gates, opening causes severe pain across the entire body as the overwhelming flow of chakra begins physically tearing the user's muscle fibers. AP Gain: 20 Enhanced Power For every AP you spend reducing an attack's Speed, you may spend another AP to "buy back" the lowered damage bonus. For example, say you spent 4 AP to bring a basic unarmed attack from Speed 8 to Speed 4. Normally you would deal (damage bonus)(4) damage with this attack, because its Speed is 4. However, with Enhanced Power you could spend up to 4 AP increasing its effective Speed. Thus, if you spent 3 AP on Enhanced Power, you'd deal (damage bonus)(7) damage.

title: The Fifth Gate - Tomon - Gate of Limit
text: Located in the middle of the torso, the fifth gate is below the fourth on the spinal column (which also serves as the body's primary chakra meridian). Opening results in a marked increase in speed and power for the shinobi who does so, but begins tearing tendons away from the bones they're anchored to. AP Gain: 25 Enhanced Speed Every 5 AP you spend on attack increases its Accuracy by 1. Every 5 AP you currently have in your gate-specific AP pool gives you a +1 bonus to dodge rolls.

title: The Sixth Gate - Keimon - Gate of View
text: Placed in the lower abdomen, the gate of view is responsible for, relative to the previous five, gross regulation of chakra, with the first five gates fine-tuning its distribution to one extent or another. Simply opening the sixth gate results in the body blasting chakra out from every one of its tenketsu. While it's open the user will radiate a strong artificial 'wind'; trees will bend away, and water will rise to form vortexes around them. AP Gain: 30 Extreme Speed After making an attack or attempting to dodge and seeing if it succeeds or fails, you may spend AP to increase its result by 1 for every 10 points of AP spent. Additionally, you may use Enhanced Strength or Enhanced Power after determining if your attack hits.

title: The Seventh Gate- Kyoumon - Gate of Wonder
text: Located near the base of the spine, at hip level, the seventh gate results in the most marked physical changes since the third. The user begins using glowing green sweat from their pores; the amounts of chakra rushing through the user's chakra circulatory system are becoming genuinely destructive to the body, and so it tries to vent it out the only way it can... resulting in glowing green, chakra-infused sweat. Additionally, merely having this gate open results in shredding one's muscle fibers. While chakra can make up for lost functionality, even a light touch causes severe pain to someone who's opened the seventh gate recently. AP Gain: 40 Defiance So long as the Seventh Gate remains open, you ignore the effects of all wounds you're suffering from (though they will still accumulate normally). You need to take two wounds on the same location before the wounds caused by Gates on that location increases in severity. You ignore the normal “Half your max AP” of the GAP pool. You can now practically store as much AP as you wish.

title: The Eighth Gate - Shimon - Gate of Death
text: Located near the heart, this is the final option for any user of the gates, when accomplishing their goal is more important than their life. With all eight gates opened, there's nothing to regulate the body's chakra flow, and since it's inherently tied to every major organ in the body, there's very little to regulate organ function either. Opening the eighth gate will cause the user's death, without exception. However, for those few minutes before their heart literally pumps itself to death, before their raging chakra system finishes tearing their organs into pulp, and before they convert vital portions of their body into energy, a user of the eighth gate has unrivaled power. AP Gain: 50 Last Stand When you first open the eighth gate, all wounds you are presently suffering from are removed. So long as the Eighth Gate remains open, your HP cannot be reduced below 1. AP spend on any Gate specific effect or action counts as double the AP. There are no longer any restrictions to any of the Gates effects, such First Gate’s Enhanced Strength STR/10 limitation. Every time you take a Non-Interrupt Action, you suffer a Wound. However, when you fall unconscious, close the Eighth Gate, or when you have accumulated 28 Wounds, you die ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: ABYSS RELEASE
text: Suiton → Abyss Scar: Depth Normal water moves around you. Abyssal water feels impossibly heavy, as though a few inches of black water carry the pressure of an ocean trench.

title: Feral Conversion
text: A Feralized Suiton Attack that affects an Area applies Depth equal to its Feral Intensity to that Area after resolving. A single-target Attack applies that Depth directly to the target. A persistent Suiton effect that creates or maintains water applies its Depth to the water it sustains.

title: Scarred — Depth 1–2
text: A creature affected by Depth suffers Special Upkeep equal to its Depth and has its Movement Speed reduced by 10% per Depth. Abyss Attacks gain +1 Accuracy against a creature affected by Depth 2+.

title: Feral — Depth 3–4
text: A breathing creature affected by Depth 3+ gains Suffocation 1 every 15 IC. At Depth 3, Abyss Attacks against the creature gain +10% Final Damage and +10% Wounding. At Depth 4, both bonuses become +15%.

title: Overrun — Depth 5
text: At Depth 5, the creature's Movement Speed is reduced by 50% and it gains Suffocation 1 every 10 IC. Abyss Attacks against it gain +25% Final Damage, +25% Wounding and +2 Accuracy.

title: Apex Mutation — Hadal Adaptation
text: Depth leaves you untouched. You ignore its Special Upkeep, Movement reduction and Suffocation. Whenever one of your Abyss Attacks inflicts a Wound on a creature at Depth 5, that creature gains Suffocation 1.

title: Shinenton: Kokusui no Hikishio - Abyss Release: Blackwater Undertow
text: C-Rank Black water spreads across the ground and everything caught within it begins sliding toward the centre, as though the battlefield has become the mouth of an ocean trench. Chakra 22 Damage 10d12 Range 30 Area 10 Speed 15 Seal Speed 16 Knockback 4 Tags: Attack, AoE, Energy, Environmental, Suiton, Abyss Blackwater Undertow pulls creatures towards the centre of its Area. Increase this forced movement by the highest Depth affecting each target, to a maximum increase of +5 yards. After the Attack resolves, the Area gains Depth 1.

title: Shinenton: Suibotsu Sekai - Abyss Release: Sunken World
text: B-Rank The ground disappears beneath a layer of perfectly still black water. Every few seconds it feels deeper, heavier and farther from the surface. Chakra 30 Upkeep 8 Range 30 Area 15 Speed 16 Seal Speed 22 Tags: Utility, AoE, Environmental, Suiton, Abyss On activation, the Area gains Depth 2. Sunken World Anchors the Depth in its Area while its Upkeep is maintained. Every 10 IC after activation, increase that Area's Depth by 1, to a maximum of 5. Moving or reshaping the Area through another effect carries the Anchored Depth with the water Sunken World maintains.

title: Shinenton: Shinkai no Haka - Abyss Release: Hadal Grave

Chakra 48 Damage 46d10 Range 40 Area 25 Speed 24 Delay 5 Seal Speed 27 Stun 8 Tags: Attack, AoE, Energy, Environmental, Suiton, Abyss Increase Hadal Grave against each creature based on the Depth affecting them before the Attack resolves: Depth 1–2 grants +10% Final Damage; Depth 3 grants +20% Final Damage and +10% Wounding; Depth 4 grants +30% Final Damage and +20% Wounding; Depth 5 grants +40% Final Damage and +30% Wounding. A creature hit at Depth 5 gains Suffocation 2 after the Attack. The Area then gains Depth 3. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: CINDER RELEASE
text: Katon → Cinder Scar: Ash Katon is about the flame. Cinder Release is about what survives it. Soot, embers and half-dead fire turn the battlefield into fuel for the next ignition.

title: Feral Conversion
text: After a damaging Feralized Katon Jutsu resolves, apply Ash equal to its Feral Intensity. An AoE applies that Ash to its Area. A single-target Attack can apply the Ash directly to the creature. When a Cinder Jutsu affects a creature or Area carrying Ash, consume Ash from one matching source up to the Jutsu's Feral Intensity. Each Ash consumed adds +5% Final Damage and +3 Ignite. A Jutsu with no printed Ignite gains Ignite equal to 3 × Ash consumed.

title: Scarred — Ash 1–2
text: An Area containing Ash imposes Visibility equal to half its Ash Severity, rounded up. Ash carried directly by a creature moves with them. Cinder Attacks gain +1 Accuracy against a creature affected by Ash 2+.

title: Feral — Ash 3–4
text: At Ash 3+, effects that reduce Ignite remove half as much Ignite, rounded down. Cinder Attacks against the creature gain +10% Final Damage and +1 Accuracy. Whenever a creature affected by Ash 3+ takes Ignite Damage, it takes additional Damage equal to NDB × its Ash Severity. This additional Damage does not Wound. At Ash 4, the Cinder Final Damage bonus becomes +15%.

title: Overrun — Ash 5
text: At Ash 5, the creature's Ignite holds its Severity instead of naturally reducing. Cinder Attacks against it gain +25% Final Damage and +2 Accuracy. When a Cinder Attack hits a creature at Ash 5, consume all 5 Ash to add another +25% Final Damage and immediately resolve its current Ignite once after the Attack without reducing that Ignite.

title: Apex Mutation — The Last Ember
text: Ash never interferes with your vision. Each Ash you consume adds +4 Ignite instead of +3. Consuming 5 Ash from a single creature or Area leaves Ash 1 on that source after the Action resolves.

title: Kaiton: Haien - Cinder Release: Ashen Wake
text: C-Rank A dirty wave of flame crawls across the battlefield. The fire lasts only a moment. The glowing ash left behind is the real technique. Chakra 20 Damage 10d12 Range 25 Area 12 Speed 14 Seal Speed 15 Ignite 3 Tags: Attack, AoE, Energy, Environmental, Katon, Cinder When Ashen Wake consumes Ash through Cinder Release, increase its Area by 2 per Ash consumed. The expanded Area counts as affected by the Jutsu. After the Attack resolves, the full Area gains Ash 1.

title: Kaiton: Kōkai - Cinder Release: Ashfall
text: B-Rank A slow fall of soot and ember fills the air. Every surface darkens, every breath tastes burnt and the whole field waits for a spark. Chakra 30 Upkeep 6 Range 30 Area 20 Speed 14 Seal Speed 22 Tags: Utility, AoE, Environmental, Katon, Cinder On activation, the Area gains Ash 2. Ashfall Anchors Ash in its Area while its Upkeep is maintained. Every 10 IC after activation, increase that Area's Ash by 1, to a maximum of 5. Ignite affecting creatures inside Ashfall gains +1 Severity whenever the Area's Ash increases.

title: Kaiton: Kasō - Cinder Release: Funeral Pyre
text: A-Rank Every ember and soot-covered surface lifts into the air. For one horrible instant the battlefield glows orange. Then all of it catches. Chakra 46 Damage 40d10 Range 40 Area 20 Speed 22 Seal Speed 26 Ignite 8 Tags: Attack, AoE, Energy, Environmental, Katon, Cinder Before resolving the Attack, consume up to 5 Ash from the Area. Every creature hit takes +7% Final Damage and +3 Ignite per Ash consumed. Against a creature carrying Ash directly, you can consume its Ash instead or combine it with Area Ash, to a maximum of 5 Ash used against that creature. Consuming 5 Ash for a creature immediately resolves its existing Ignite once after Funeral Pyre without reducing that Ignite. After the Attack resolves, Funeral Pyre applies Ash 1 to its Area. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: GLASS RELEASE
text: Doton → Glass Scar: Shards Doton users build things to last. Glass Release builds them to break. Earth flashes into brilliant blades and structures whose destruction is part of the technique.

title: Feral Conversion
text: Damaging Feralized Doton Jutsu inflict Slashing Wounds. A damaging Glass Jutsu affecting an Area applies Shards equal to its Feral Intensity to that Area. A single-target Glass Attack creates an Area 1 of Shards beneath the target. A Glass Barrier or Construct applies Shards equal to its Feral Intensity across its occupied Area when it ends or is destroyed.

title: Scarred — Shards 1–2
text: An Area containing Shards counts as Rocky Terrain equal to its Shards Severity and provides suitable earth for Glass and Doton Jutsu. When declaring a Glass Jutsu whose origin or affected Area overlaps Shards, consume Shards up to that Jutsu's Feral Intensity. Each Shard consumed reduces final Chakra cost by 1 and final Seal Speed by 1, minimum 0.

title: Feral — Shards 3–4
text: At Shards 3+, Glass Attacks originating inside or targeting the Area gain +1 Accuracy and +10% Wounding. Glass Barriers and Constructs created there gain +10 DR per Shards Severity present when created. At Shards 4, Glass Attacks also gain +10% Final Damage.

title: Overrun — Shards 5
text: Glass Attacks against creatures inside a Shards 5 Area gain +20% Final Damage and +2 Accuracy. Once per Action when a Glass Attack hits a creature inside the Area, consume any number of Shards from that Area. Each Shard consumed deals an additional 4d10 Slashing Damage. If all 5 Shards are consumed at once, combine that bonus Damage with the Attack's Final Damage for Wounding and add +25% Wounding.

title: Apex Mutation — Perfect Fracture
text: Shards never impede your movement. Each Shard consumed for Glass Release's Chakra cost and Seal Speed reduction reduces both by 2 instead of 1. Consuming 5 Shards in a single Action adds +10% Wounding to that Action.

title: Garasuton: Hahen no Yari - Glass Release: Splinter Lance

Chakra 20 Damage 13d10 Range 30 Area 5 Speed 14 Seal Speed 15 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Slashing, Ground-Based, Doton, Glass Splinter Lance gains +2 Accuracy against a target standing within Shards. After the Attack resolves, its Area gains Shards 1.

title: Garasuton: Kagami no Toride - Glass Release: Mirror Bastion
text: B-Rank A perfectly smooth wall of translucent glass erupts from the earth. Every impact sends another web of fractures racing through the battlefield around it. Chakra 30 Upkeep 6 Range 20 Speed 16 Seal Speed 22 Tags: Utility, Barrier, Ground-Based, Doton, Glass Create a Glass wall up to 12 yards long, 6 yards high and 1 yard wide. It has HP equal to (NDB + 20) × 8 and 15 DR. The wall remains while its Upkeep is maintained. Mirror Bastion Anchors Shards within 5 yards of the wall. Once per Action when the wall takes 50 or more Final Damage, apply Shards 1 to an Area 3 touching the wall on the attacker's side. Reducing the wall to 0 HP ends Mirror Bastion's Upkeep. When Mirror Bastion ends, apply Shards 2 within 5 yards of the wall. If the wall was destroyed, every creature within 3 yards defends against a Speed 10 Attack using your Ninjutsu Accuracy. On hit, it deals 18d10 Slashing Damage without Speed × NDB.

title: Garasuton: Yaiba no Seidō - Glass Release: Cathedral of Knives
text: A-Rank The landscape becomes transparent. Stone, rubble and earth vanish beneath rising glass spires. A heartbeat later the entire cathedral begins to crack. Chakra 48 Damage 38d10 Range 40 Area 25 Speed 24 Seal Speed 27 Immobilization 5 Tags: Attack, AoE, Slashing, Environmental, Ground-Based, Doton, Glass After the initial Attack resolves, Cathedral of Knives applies Shards 3. You may immediately Shatter any number of Shards from the Area and make one additional Attack at -2 Accuracy against every creature still inside. The Shatter deals 8d10 Slashing Damage per Shard consumed and adds no Speed × NDB. Consuming 5 Shards combines Cathedral's initial Final Damage and the Shatter's Final Damage for Wounding and adds +25% Wounding. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES
