The user is protected from this explosion; their friends, however, are not. Chakra: 45 Damage: 30d20!>11 Range: 20 Area: 5X Speed: 30, Delay 20 Seal Speed: 27 Special: Burns 15, Ignite 20, Stun 10 Tags: Attack, AoE, Energy Effects: X is your ninjutsu damage bonus. Every initiative counts in the delay, this technique gains 5% of its damage, radius, and effects. You may choose to detonate this when the delay ends. It lasts for 100 IC or until detonated. The use of any damaging Katon jutsu of C-rank or above or the presence of any person suffering from an Ignite status of 10 or greater in this area will detonate whether the delay has ended or not. If an effect is used which would disperse the gas cloud (such as the A-rank Fuuton: Kitakaze) during the Delay period, its damage, range, and effects all reset to 0%; and can be built back up by repeating the delay. Ryuujin Bakuha inflicts an Energy wound, and two Blunt wounds of the same severity. If it's used in a confined space (such as indoors, or in a cave) it does an additional 10d20!>16 damage, and its effects are raised to Burns 25, Ignite 25, and Stun 20.

title: Maru o Moyashi no Jutsu - Burning Circle Technique
text: A-Rank Popular among bounty-hunting ninja, this technique creates a circular wall of flame surrounding an area. While it's by no means impregnable, attempting to charge through a virtually solid sheet of chakra-fueled fire tends to have the expected result. It's useful both for ensuring an opponent won't run away (or making them pay for trying to do so), and for keeping an adversary isolated from the battle. Chakra: 50 Upkeep: 8 Damage: 40d20!o>6 Range: 40 Area: Up to NDB 5 Speed: 30 Seal Speed: 40 Tags: Utility, AoE, Energy, Environmental Effects: This creates a circular wall of flame where you may choose to have the circle centered at the edge of the range or have the edge at the edge of the range. If the wall intersects an area with a creature they may choose to be placed on either side of the wall. Anytime this would completely envelope a person they may defend and on a successful dodge escape the encircled zone. Dodge penalties are calculated based on the distance to the edge of the zone. The wall itself is 1 yard thick, and (ninjutsu damage bonus) 3 yards tall. Anyone who crosses the wall takes only the listed damage, as well as an Ignite equal to the user's ninjutsu damage bonus, and a Burn equal to twice the user's ninjutsu damage bonus.

title: Sunde Bakudan - Living Bomb
text: A-Rank A technique invented in the middle of the Third Shinobi World War--and, as the horrors from that era go, it's only slightly atrocious. The user molds a mass of volatile fire-elemental chakra and, rather than forming it into a jutsu, injects it directly into a foe. The chakra will last a few minutes at most, before surging through their chakra coils violently and turning them into the catalyst for a powerful explosion. It saw extensive use for taking out medics who'd rush to the battlefield to retrieve injured comrades, only to be killed or wounded in the ensuing explosion. Chakra: 25, raised to 40 if it hits Damage: 50d12!>10 Speed: 20 Seal Speed: 30 Tags: Attack, Melee, Energy Effects: Whoever you hit with this technique becomes a living bomb but it initially does not deal any damage. When you place this technique, you also set a timer, between 10 IC and (your Chakra Control skill ranks)5 IC. At that point, they will detonate. You may also perform a Speed 5, Seal Speed 20 action to detonate someone immediately. When a person is detonated, they make a Chakra 30 roll; whether they pass or fail has no effect on the technique, though as normal they might advance in Fatigue. The explosion itself is Area 25. The bomb themselves may not defend against it, though anyone else can. The technique's damage is considered 25% higher for the purposes of wounding the bomb. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Medical Ninjutsu
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Requirements
text: Medical Ninjutsu transfers chakra to heal injuries and illness. The same anatomical knowledge can also be used to harm. Unless otherwise specified in their descriptions, you may not use any medical jutsu on yourself. For the sake of quick reference, the jutsu a medic may perform on themself are: Vital Repair, Tourniquet Technique, Temporary Suture, and Mystical Palm. If any Medical Ninjutsu technique has a listed Upkeep, that Upkeep is paid by the recipient of the technique, rather than the medic; this represents the medic adjusting the flows of that person's chakra to preserve their health. This does mean that those techniques can be voluntarily (or forcibly) ended, though the "Dazed" Wound will specifically not do so. You must meet all listed requirements to learn medical ninjutsu of a given rank. D: 5 Chakra Control, 5 Medicine, Medical Training (talent) C: 10 Chakra Control, 15 Medicine, Medical Training (talent) B: 20 Chakra Control, 25 Medicine, Advanced Medical Training or Chakra Surgeon A: 30 Chakra Control, 35 Medicine, Advanced Medical Training or Surgeon of the Corps

title: Willing
text: A Willing technique fails if its recipient chooses to disrupt it; the user still pays Speed and Chakra costs. A helpless target, such as an unconscious or shadow-possessed creature, cannot disrupt it.

title: Kyuusho Shuuzen no Jutsu - Vital Repair Technique
text: D-Rank By transferring your chakra to the recipient, you can stimulate the body to begin the recovery process and help stabilize their most basic functions (like breath rate and pulse). It lacks the precision of more advanced jutsu to target specific injuries and problems, but helps to keep people alive until they can receive advanced care. Chakra: 10 + X/4 Range: Touch Speed: Variable Requires: Flawless Diagnosis, Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: For the duration of this technique, you must keep your hands on its recipient. If you are stunned, or knocked away, it is Aborted automatically. For every IC which passes, you heal 1% of the recipient's lost Hit Points. This will not restore lost Vitality, though it will restore a person in negative Hit Points to consciousness. You pay the cost of this technique after you finish healing where X is the number of IC this jutsu was active for. A single person may benefit from this only once per day, per medic. You may use this technique on yourself (though still have to be able to place a hand on yourself to do so; no hands, no healing).

title: Mukizu Shindan no Jutsu - Flawless Diagnosis Technique
text: D-Rank By touching someone and sending pulses of chakra throughout the recipient's tenketsu, the user can learn of someone's vitals and condition faster than it would be to separately evaluate them. It requires the patient to be willing to do so, however, which is the cause of most medic-nin's stress while in training. Chakra: 10 Range: Touch Speed: 10, Delay 10 Requires: Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: This gives a +5 bonus to any Medicine rolls to treat a person using mundane means (such as a First Aid kit). You also know a target's Fatigue level, percent of remaining HP and Vitality, any wounds they're suffering from, any illnesses they have, any poisons they're afflicted with, and any other health issues they may be suffering from. These are in general terms, for example from an in-character perspective a fatigue 5 would be exhausted almost to the point of running out of chakra or passing out.

title: Shiketsu no Jutsu - Tourniquet Technique
text: D-Rank A surprisingly medical technique, this throttles the flow of chakra to a specific portion of the body, and by doing so puts it in a state of near-hibernation. The entire limb becomes numb and almost unresponsive, but blood flow decreases and pains is significantly reduced. Chakra: 15 Range: Touch Upkeep: 2 per limb Speed: 15, Delay 5 Requires: Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: This jutsu can be applied to any limb. The recipient loses the use of that limb, but ignores all effects of any wounds present on it: In the case of an arm that means it cannot be used to hold weapons, the amount of weapons you can multi-throw is reduced by 25%, and you cannot use that hand to form handseals. In the case of a leg this applies a -25% to movement speed and a -2 dodge penalty.

title: Chakura Masui - Chakra Anaesthetic
text: C-Rank A controlled pulse interrupts pain signals without repairing the underlying injury. Chakra: 18 Range: Touch Speed: 8 Seal Speed: 12 Tags: Utility, Medical Effects: A willing target ignores the penalties of one Minor or Major Wound for 30 IC. The Wound still exists for all other purposes. When the effect ends, that Wound's penalties return immediately. A target may only have one Wound suppressed by this technique at a time.

title: Chakura no Mesu - Chakra Scalpel
text: C-Rank This forms one's chakra into a small, sharp blade; medics favor this for performing highly accurate incisions during surgeries and dissection, as it won't lose its edge and is always sterile (unlike a regular blade). It can even be used to make cuts inside the body without creating an opening wound, which drastically reduces the risk of infection. Chakra: 13 Upkeep: 3 Speed: 8 Tags: Utility, Self Effects: You can use this in combat. Doing so causes your unarmed taijutsu attacks to inflict Slashing wounds and ignore any damage reduction your opponent may have. However, these 'scalpel' injuries are relatively shallow. They cannot wound a location wearing armor, and armor is treated as if it has double the absorption against techniques that benefit from this. The damage from basic attacks with your scalpel is increased by (your Medicine skill ranks)%. Additionally, the damage of all unarmed attacks (including basic attack) is increased by (Medicine skill ranks)% for determining the severity of wounds it inflicts. However this bonus does not apply to any jutsu that explicitly uses your legs to attack (such as Tsutenkyaku - Painful Sky Leg). You also gain a +5 Bonus to performing Medicine Skill Checks that involve surgery or making any form of cuts or incisions on a person.

title: Kasoku Saikassei - Accelerated Revitalization
text: C-Rank You accelerate the recipient’s metabolism and draw on their reserves to keep them fighting. The strain leaves them unable to recover normally afterward. comatose afterward. Chakra: 10 + 3X Range: Touch Upkeep: 2X Speed: 12 Requires: Flawless Diagnosis, Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: This lowers the recipient's effective Fatigue level by X, with X having a maximum of their current Fatigue level. A person can only benefit from one application of this technique. To apply it again, they must first release the previous instance of it--which may, potentially, render them immediately unconscious, if their "true" Fatigue level is 6 or higher. Notably, an unconscious person cannot benefit from this technique. However, forcing one's body beyond its limits like this is costly. For the next X weeks, the recipient will not recover from Fatigue at all, even through the use of Soldier Pills (though another application of this technique would still function). If multiple instances of Kasoku Saikassei are delaying one's recovery, only the one with the longest time remaining is counted for that purpose.

title: Kizu Saishuu no Jutsu - Wound Sealing Technique
text: C-Rank This technique uses chakra to make repairs to an injured body; gashes are pulled shut, wounds sutured, damaged organs held steady by the application of chakra. This can give an injured shinobi the second wind they need to win a battle or complete a mission. However, this is only a temporary measure; before long the chakra will unravel. As such, this is considered an emergency technique among medics, to be used only when there's no other choice. Most will hesitate to apply this to their comrades, as far too many shinobi will prove willing to, using this newfound health, charge into battle, defeat their enemies, and then die hours later when their borrowed time expires. Chakra: 25 Range: Touch Speed: 30, Delay 20 Requires: Vital Repair Technique, Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: The recipient immediately regains up 3(ninjutsu damage bonus)% of their maximum Vitality, which will not take them above half their maximum. However, 3(your ranks in medicine) IC later, their wounds will reopen; they'll immediately take that much damage, +50%, which cannot be reduced or mitigated. Until this occurs, they will not heal normally (i.e. as described in the Recovery section of the Combat chapter). This can be fatal.

title: Meguri Seigyo no Jutsu - Hemostasis Technique
text: C-Rank Although this technique is fairly simple, it's not taught to amateur medics due to the danger inherent in making any sort of mistake when applying it. This temporarily adjusts the recipient's pulse and blood flow, putting their body in a more stable condition. This is mainly used to prevent someone from bleeding out, and to prevent the spread of poison. Chakra: 10 + 2X Range: Touch Speed: 6 + X, Delay X / 2 Requires: Willing Target Tags: Utility, Aura Effects: This lasts for X 5 IC. During that time, the damage the recipient takes from Bleed effects is reduced to 0, the Stamina penalties from Bleed effects are not applied, and they take damage from Poison once every 2 IC, rather than every IC. The severity of Bleed statuses is reduced normally. During this time, they have a +5 bonus to all their Resistance rolls.

title: Rinji Hougou no Jutsu - Temporary Suture Technique
text: C-Rank Weaving a network of chakra, a medic can make short-term repairs to damaged body parts. They can set wounds and hold them rigidly in place, use chakra to take the place of damage muscles and tendons, alleviate swelling and bruising, or even repair damaged blood vessels and do the job of injured nerves. The problem with this is that it's a short-term fix to a long term problem. This is itself damaging, but beyond that it prevents the body from doing anything to repair itself, and allows undue strain to be placed on these injured body parts. Chakra: 15 + 3X Range: Touch Speed: 10 + 3X, Delay 5 + X Requires: Tourniquet Technique, Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: This temporarily negates the effects of up to X wounds; it can be applied later to negate additional wounds, without disrupting previous applications. This lasts for (the medic's ninjutsu damage bonus) hours, after which time the chakra sustaining the jutsu expires--and the recipient pays the price for pushing their body beyond its limits. For each wound remedied this way, they take damage equal to 5% of their maximum Vitality, per category of the wound. Thus, if this was used to negate a Minor and a Severe wound, after it ended the person would take (5 + 15) = 20% of their maximum Vitality in damage (which could carry over to their HP), which cannot be reduced or mitigated. Additionally, the recovery times of these wounds is increases by 1 week per level of the wound (1 week for minors, 3 for severes, etc.). In the case of wounds whose penalties are reduced over time, this "extra" recovery time must be made up for first, before normal recovery can continue. This can be fatal. It cannot be used on an unwilling subject (though as with its predecessor, Tourniquet Technique, you may use it on yourself). So long as this technique is in place, natural healing (as described in the Recovery section of the Combat chapter) will not take place.

title: Dokugiri - Poison Mist
text: B-Rank You convert chakra into toxic vapour and exhale it as a drifting cloud. Chakra: 30 Range: 15 Area: 6 Speed: 18 Seal Speed: 20 Special: Poison 5 Tags: Attack, AoE, Medical, Environmental Effects: On a failed status Resistance roll, the target suffers Poison 5 for 15 IC. The mist remains in the Area for 15 IC; entering or beginning an action inside it requires a new Resistance roll if that creature is not already affected by this Poison Mist. Strong wind that would disperse smoke ends the cloud. Holding one's breath does not provide immunity after exposure, but Good Lungs and other effects that explicitly defend against inhaled hazards apply normally. A creature can only suffer one instance of this Poison Mist at a time.

title: Fukugen Ryouhou - Rejuvenating Remedy
text: B-Rank An advanced technique in which, with a touch, the user sends a pulse of chakra throughout the body of their target, which corrects disruptions in the user's chakra flow and the nerves and blood vessels which they follow throughout the body. It is widely rumored to have been developed by a Hyuuga medic nin. Chakra: 30 Range: Touch Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 10 Requires: Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: This clears the person touched of immobilization and paralysis penalties which are internal (Poison, clay bullet, etc. would not apply, but notably, Combat Acupuncture and Nervous System Derangement would). It immediately ends any stuns which are presently affecting them. It is also strong enough to disrupt weaker Genjutsu, granting another defensive roll against a single Genjutsu affecting them of C rank or lower, with a +5 bonus.

title: Gyōketsu Kekkai - Coagulation Field
text: B-Rank Medical chakra spreads through a small area, forcing open wounds to clot faster. Chakra: 28 Upkeep: 6 Area: 12 Speed: 14 Seal Speed: 18 Tags: Utility, Medical, AoE Effects: All willing creatures in the Area reduce Bleed they gain by 1, minimum 0, and gain +3 Resistance against effects that worsen an existing Wound. This does not heal Wounds or restore Vitality. A creature can benefit from only one Coagulation Field.

title: Kyouka Shohou: Chakura Chuunyuu - Strengthening Prescription: Chakra Injection
text: B-Rank Originally developed as a kinjutsu, the version used by medics today is a safer (though still by no means safe) derivative. Using medically-altered chakra, an individual can be greatly, if temporarily, strengthened. Unfortunately, they are burning their proverbial candle at both ends when under the effects of this technique. Chakra: 35 Range: Touch Speed: 25, Delay 20 Requires: Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: The recipient has their ninjutsu and physical damage bonuses increased by one half of your ninjutsu damage bonus, and receives a bonus to Stamina and Chakra Exhaustion rolls equal to your base, unmodified ninjutsu damage bonus. However, whenever they fail a Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion roll, their Fatigue is raised an additional category. Additionally, any time their Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion penalty increases, the other is increased by the same amount. These effects last until the end of the fight (or other encounter, if used out of combat for some reason). And cannot be aborted or stopped prematurely.

title: Ranshinshō - Body Pathway Derangement
text: B-Rank A precise chakra pulse scrambles the relationship between thought and muscle. Chakra: 30 Accuracy: -2 Range: Touch Speed: 14 Seal Speed: 18 Special: Confusion Tags: Attack, Medical, Melee Effects: On a full hit, for 20 IC whenever the target declares a physical Action involving movement or attack, roll 1d4: 1 no change, 2 Movement is reduced 50%, 3 Accuracy -3, 4 Action Speed +3. Beginning 6 IC after the effect is applied, and once every 6 IC thereafter while it persists, the target may spend Speed 6 to attempt to end it. Roll Medicine or Chakra Control against the user's Medicine roll; on a success, the effect ends. Each 6 IC interval grants at most one attempt, regardless of how many Actions the target takes. An unused attempt expires when the next interval begins. The attempt is a Non-Interrupt Action and remains subject to the derangement's effects.

title: Saikan Chuushutsu no Jutsu - Delicate Illness Extraction Technique
text: B-Rank A delicate and advanced technique even among medical ninjutsu, this is nonetheless exceptionally useful. The medic makes an incision on the patient's body (usually the torso, but other locations are possible) and then uses chakra to draw out any poisons, toxins, or other pathogens that may be afflicting the person. Chakra: 30 Range: Touch Speed: 18, Delay 8 Requires: Chakra Scalpel, Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: This immediately cures any poisons a person may be suffering from. Most parasites, diseases, and chemical toxins can also be excised this way.

title: Shousen no Jutsu - Mystical Palm Technique
text: B-Rank You place glowing palms against an injury and carefully direct chakra into the tissue, accelerating the patient’s natural healing. Chakra: 10 + X/2 Range: Touch Speed: 5 + X Special: Abort Requires: Vital Repair, Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: For the duration of this technique, you must keep your hands on its recipient. If you are stunned, or knocked away, it is Aborted automatically. The value of X is determined, and the Chakra cost paid, after it ends. This paragraph should seem familiar. Every IC which passes, you heal 1% of the recipient's Vitality. This will not heal lost Hit Points. You pay the cost of this technique after you finish healing, based on its actual duration. If you Abort it, or are forced to, X is reduced appropriately. A single person may benefit from this only once per day, per medic. You may use this technique on yourself, as with Vital Repair.

title: Chikatsu Saisei no Jutsu - Healing Resuscitation Regeneration Technique
text: A-Rank The pinnacle of advanced common medical jutsus, with effects that border upon miraculous, this stimulates the body's stem cells to begin dividing and recreating a lost or destroyed part of the body--such as a limb or organ. In time, full functionality will be regained. Doing so, however, is incredibly difficult, even for experienced medical nin. In the rare instance when this technique is performed, multiple medics will usually work in tandem. Chakra: 50 Speed: 100 Seal Speed: 200 Tags: Utility Effects: A medic involved in this technique makes the Chakra roll, and then spends 1 Willpower towards the regeneration process. A total of 50 Willpower must be spent this way, but the process cannot be completed in less than 10 weeks; at least 1 Willpower must be spent each week, or all progress is lost. After the last point of Willpower is added, the user regains their lost limb, organ, or body part. During this time, the recipient cannot go above Fatigue 2. If they do, at any point and for any reason, all progress is lost.

title: Kyuushou Taisha - Vital Regeneration
text: A-Rank The medic-nin focuses their chakra on a specific part of the body and, using what is left of the damaged organ or area, forces a rapid replication of specific types of cells. It is capable of mending broken bones and repairing ruptured organs with astonishing speed. Chakra: 20 + 10X Range: Touch Speed: 50, Delay 40 Requires: Mystical Palm, Willing Target Tags: Utility Effects: This completely cures one wound the recipient is suffering from. X is 1 per severity of the wound (1 for minor, 4 for critical). However, for the next X 4 weeks, the healed individual's Fatigue is considered 1 higher for all purposes; in the case of Critical wounds, their Fatigue is considered 2 higher. Multiple uses of this stack. For example, say you had a Critical wound and a Major wound cured on the same day. You would be perpetually at Fatigue 3 for the next 2 4 = 8 real-world days. After that, there would still be 8 more days (for a total of 16, for the Critical wound) of being unable to go below Fatigue 2. If you had another two Severe wounds healed this way in that time, you'd be at Fatigue 4 until the after-effects started wearing off. Although most experienced medics know this technique, they are typically reluctant to cure every individual who injures themselves in training or on a mission. Most medics believe that even if the person doesn't need to learn a lesson for their mistakes, it's better to heal naturally (with a little bit of help when necessary) than to send a weakened, but technically uninjured, ninja back into danger.

title: Mikiri Saisei - Forsaken Rebirth
text: A-Rank You transfer some of your life energy to an injured ally. Modern teaching limits the transfer to prevent the medic from sacrificing their life. Chakra: 20 Fatigue: X voluntary levels (X must be at least 1) Range: Touch Speed: 20, Delay 10 Requires: Willing Target Tags: Utility, Medical, Willing Effects: Declare X when you use this Jutsu. After paying its Chakra cost, advance your Fatigue by X; X must be at least 1 and cannot render you unconscious. You cannot use this technique on yourself. Each Fatigue level spent heals 20% of the recipient's HP and 10% of their Vitality, reduces their Fatigue level by 1, and resets their Chakra and Stamina penalties to 0. Each Fatigue level also lets the recipient ignore one existing Wound of their choice for X in-character days. They must ignore all Minor Wounds before Major and all Major before Severe. This technique cannot ignore Critical Wounds.

title: Saibō Kassei - Cellular Activation
text: A-Rank The body is ordered to repair now and worry about the metabolic bill later. Chakra: 45 Range: Touch Speed: 20 Delay: 10 Seal Speed: 28 Tags: Utility, Medical Effects: A willing target restores Vitality equal to CHA×3 and may temporarily ignore one Major Wound for 50 IC. When the effect ends, increase both Stamina and Chakra penalties by 3 and the ignored Wound returns if it has not been healed by another effect. A target can benefit from Cellular Activation only once per IC Month. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Natural Chakra & Sage Mode
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Natural Chakra
text: Natural energy exists in the surrounding world. A Sage gathers it and balances it with their own physical and spiritual energy to form senjutsu chakra. The Natural Chakra Talent grants a Sage Tradition, Gather Natural Chakra, Sage Mode and Sage techniques.

title: AT A GLANCE
text: Choose a Sage Tradition, Gather Natural Chakra, then enter Sage Mode. Use the progression and resource rules below.

title: Core Talent
text: Choose a Sage Tradition from a creature, Summon Tribe or other Source capable of teaching Natural Chakra. Gain Sage Rank 1, a maximum Sage Chakra of 4, Gather Natural Chakra, Sage Mode, your Tradition's Signature Trait, and one Sage Art or Sage Kata you meet the requirements for. Sage Chakra is a separate resource. It cannot pay normal Jutsu Chakra Costs and spending it does not cause Chakra Exhaustion unless an effect specifically says otherwise. Sage Chakra is not Chakra, Stamina, AP or Willpower for effects which restore or modify those resources.

title: Deepening Natural Chakra
text: Each time you Deepen Natural Chakra, increase your Sage Rank by 1 and learn one additional Sage Art or Sage Kata. Each Art or Kata learned this way is one Natural Chakra Development for the normal Talent rules; the Art or Kata granted by the Core Talent is not a Development. Natural Chakra may be Deepened up to four times, to a maximum Sage Rank of 5. You gain Perfect Communion after the third Development as normal; the fourth Deepening remains available after Mastery, still costs a Talent Point, and is how Sage Rank 5 is normally reached. Unless an Art or Kata says otherwise, the same one cannot be selected more than once.

title: Sage Progression
text: Sage Rank 1 — Maximum Sage Chakra 4; Sage Power 1; Sage Damage +10%; Sage Sense +5. Sage Rank 2 — Maximum Sage Chakra 5; Sage Power 1; Sage Damage +15%; Sage Sense +5. Sage Rank 3 — Maximum Sage Chakra 6; Sage Power 2; Sage Damage +20%; Sage Sense +10. Sage Rank 4 — Maximum Sage Chakra 7; Sage Power 2; Sage Damage +25%; Sage Sense +10. Sage Rank 5 — Maximum Sage Chakra 8; Sage Power 3; Sage Damage +30%; Sage Sense +15. Sage Power is used by Sage Mode and several Sage Arts. Sage Damage is the Final Damage bonus granted by Sage Mode. Sage Sense is the bonus Sage Mode grants to Awareness and Survival in the circumstances described below.

title: SAGE CHAKRA
text: Sage Chakra represents Natural Chakra that has been successfully drawn in and balanced with your own physical and spiritual energy. You cannot hold more Sage Chakra than your maximum. Excess Sage Chakra is lost. If you become Incapacitated, you immediately lose all Sage Chakra and Sage Mode ends. Outside Sage Mode, Sage Chakra is unstable. If you take a Rest, leave the scene, or spend 20 consecutive IC without successfully using Gather Natural Chakra, all Sage Chakra you are holding disperses. Entering Sage Mode suspends this dispersal. When Sage Mode ends, any Sage Chakra you still hold is lost.

title: GATHER NATURAL CHAKRA
text: [Speed 10, Delay 8, Utility, Self, Abort] You remain still and gather natural energy into your chakra network. Until this Action resolves, your Movement Speed is 0. You cannot declare another non-Interrupt Action. If you voluntarily move or use an Interrupt, Gather Natural Chakra is aborted after that movement or Interrupt resolves. If you take damage while Gathering, make a Chakra Control roll using the normal interruption TN for maintaining Handseals. On a failure, Gather Natural Chakra is aborted. When Gather Natural Chakra resolves, gain 1 Sage Chakra, up to your maximum. Gather Natural Chakra is not a Jutsu and causes no Chakra Exhaustion. Any effect which reduces Gather Natural Chakra's Speed also reduces its Delay by the same amount. AP may reduce both values in this way; this is a specific exception to the normal rules for reducing Delay. Neither value may normally be reduced below 5. If an effect specifically lowers Gather Natural Chakra's minimum Speed, it lowers its minimum Delay by the same amount. Gather's final Speed can never be lower than its current Delay; if an effect would cause this, increase its final Speed to match its Delay. You may Gather while already in Sage Mode.

title: SAGE MODE
text: [Speed 3, Utility, Self, Upkeep 2] Requires: At least 2 Sage Chakra. Balance the Natural Chakra within your body and enter Sage Mode. Entering Sage Mode does not spend Sage Chakra. While Sage Mode is active: - Gain Sage Power to Accuracy with Taijutsu and Ninjutsu Attacks. - Gain Sage Power to Dodge and Parry rolls. - Damaging Taijutsu and Ninjutsu gain Sage Damage to Final Damage. - Gain Sage Sense to Awareness rolls made to detect, Search for or track living creatures, chakra sources and Natural Chakra. - Gain Sage Sense to Survival rolls made to track creatures, navigate natural terrain or interact with hazards and environments through instinct and observation. - You may use Sage Arts and Sage Kata which require Sage Mode. - Any Attack or technique modified by a Sage Art counts as Senjutsu in addition to its normal types. Sage Mode’s Upkeep uses normal Chakra rather than Sage Chakra. Normal exhaustion, Fatigue and Stamina penalties remain. The Mode ends with the scene. If you reach 0 Sage Chakra, Sage Mode ends after the effect which spent your final Sage Chakra resolves. You may end Sage Mode at Speed 0.

title: CHOOSE YOUR SAGE
text: FIELD GUIDE / NINE TRADITIONS CHOOSE YOUR SAGE Every tradition is collected on this page. Select one below to open its full Signature Trait and Sage Arts without losing your place. ✦ 01 / SAGE TRADITION WILD SAGE An untethered path shaped by the living world. ↗ 🐸 02 / SAGE TRADITION GREAT TOAD SAGE Patience, powerful leaps and battlefield impact. ↗ 🐍 03 / SAGE TRADITION SERPENT SAGE Coils, venom and relentless pursuit. ↗ 🦅 04 / SAGE TRADITION ROC SAGE Aerial movement and mastery of the sky. ↗ 🐢 05 / SAGE TRADITION TORTOISE SAGE Endurance, protection and unyielding defence. ↗ 🦋 06 / SAGE TRADITION MOTH SAGE Powder, concealment and heightened senses. ↗ 🦅 07 / SAGE TRADITION CARRION SAGE Tracking, attrition and exploiting the wounded. ↗ 🍄 08 / SAGE TRADITION FUNGAL SAGE Spores, roots and interconnected terrain. ↗ 🦎 09 / SAGE TRADITION SALAMANDER SAGE Regeneration, resilience and survival. ↗ Natural Chakra does not look the same in every body. A Sage Tradition is the shape given to Natural Chakra by the creature, place or lineage that taught you to understand it. Most Sage Traditions are taught by Summon Tribes. Your Tradition determines the visible changes caused by Sage Mode, grants one Signature Trait, and gives access to a small list of Tradition Sage Arts. A Tradition may also alter one narrow rule for Gathering or spending Sage Chakra. Your Tradition changes what Natural Chakra rewards you for doing, but it does not replace the shared rules above. Unless the Tradition explicitly says otherwise, you still Gather Natural Chakra, use the same Sage Chakra pool, and enter Sage Mode normally.

title: BECOMING A SAGE
text: Most shinobi are taught that chakra begins inside the body. Physical and spiritual energy are mixed, shaped through the coils and forced outward into the world. Natural Chakra asks for the opposite instinct. It is already there: in roots pushing through old stone, in rainwater trapped beneath the earth, in the heat rolling over ruined roads and in every living thing stubborn enough to keep growing. Sage training begins with stillness and careful balance. Too much natural energy overwhelms the body; too little cannot sustain Sage Mode. In the wilds around the Havens, this is not an abstract philosophy. The world is saturated with things that have survived too long, grown too large or adapted too completely to their surroundings. Great Beasts, ancient Summon Tribes, living forests, fungal colonies and stranger phenomena can all develop their own ways of balancing Natural Chakra. Those methods become Sage Traditions.

title: THE SOURCE
text: A Source is more than a scroll or a teacher willing to explain the theory. Natural Chakra has to be experienced under conditions where the student cannot fall back on ordinary habits. A Tortoise Sage may be made to hold a river crossing against impossible weight. A Roc Sage may be abandoned on a cliff with no safe path down. A Serpent Sage may spend days learning to distinguish patience from hesitation. Different Sources can teach the same Tradition differently. What remains consistent is the part of that training that survives translation: the instincts, body changes and Senjutsu methods recognised practitioners eventually share.

title: THE SHAPE OF SAGE MODE
text: Sage Mode is visible. Natural Chakra does not sit politely inside a human body; it changes the way the body carries itself. Pupils alter, markings spread, skin or hair changes texture, the voice picks up an animal rasp, dust or spores trail from movement, or the air around the Sage seems to move a moment too late. These changes are cosmetic unless a Tradition or effect says otherwise. They normally fade when Sage Mode ends. The closer a Sage comes to Perfect Communion, the less the transformation resembles a disguise and the more it looks like the body remembering a shape it was always capable of taking.

title: TRADITIONS AND SUMMONS
text: A Summon Contract does not automatically teach Natural Chakra. Some tribes guard their Sage teachings more fiercely than their contracts, some have lost the practice entirely, and some creatures capable of teaching Senjutsu have never belonged to a formal tribe at all. The Source requirement represents earning access to that knowledge in character.

title: CHOOSING A SAGE TRADITION
text: When you learn Natural Chakra, choose the Sage Tradition taught by your Source. Its entry lists the physical changes caused by Sage Mode, its Signature Trait, its exclusive Sage Arts or Kata, and any special rules it uses. Sage Kata count as Sage Arts for the purpose of learning and selecting them. Whenever Natural Chakra lets you learn a Sage Art or Sage Kata, choose a General Sage Art, a General Sage Kata, or an Art or Kata from your Tradition for which you meet the requirements. You cannot normally select Arts or Kata from another Tradition unless an effect explicitly allows it. If your Source does not belong to an established Sage Tradition, use Wild Sage.

title: Wild Sage Panel
text: ✦ 01 WILD SAGE An untethered path shaped by the living world. EXPAND +

title: WILD SAGE
text: A Wild Sage learned from a place, phenomenon, solitary creature or incomplete tradition rather than an established Summon Tribe. Their Sage Mode visibly reflects the environment in which they mastered it.

title: Open Communion — Signature Trait
text: Whenever you enter Sage Mode, choose Body, Instinct or Spirit. The chosen benefit lasts until Sage Mode ends. Body — Gain Sage Power to Resistance rolls. Instinct — Increase Sage Sense by 5. Spirit — Gain Sage Power to Chakra Control rolls. Wild Sage has no exclusive list of Tradition Arts or Kata. Its strength is flexibility: a Wild Sage builds entirely from General Sage Arts and Sage Kata, reflecting a discipline learned from a place, phenomenon or solitary teacher rather than a school with generations of named techniques. The Traditions below are established examples known in the wider world. Their names are human conveniences. A cliff-dwelling bird tribe may never call its teaching "Roc Sage," and a fungal network may not think of what it does as teaching at all. The entries below are complete Traditions and may be taught by any appropriate Source.

title: Great Toad Sage Panel
text: 🐸 02 GREAT TOAD SAGE Patience, powerful leaps and battlefield impact. EXPAND +

title: GREAT TOAD SAGE
text: Great Toad teachings are built on an uncomfortable contradiction: absolute stillness followed by absolute commitment. Their students are made to sit through rain, hunger, insects and insult without breaking concentration, then expected to cross a battlefield in one explosive movement the instant the moment is right. A Toad Sage is rarely graceful in the conventional sense. They settle low, read the field through vibration and pressure, then move with enough force that the ground seems surprised to still be beneath them. Sage Mode Appearance — The stance broadens and drops, the pupils flatten horizontally, and rough markings gather around the eyes, throat and shoulders. At higher Sage Ranks, hard landings kick up rings of dust or ripple standing water even when the Sage barely seems to move.

title: Stone-Bellied Patience — Signature Trait
text: Whenever Gather Natural Chakra resolves while you are in Sage Mode, choose Steady or Springing. Steady — Until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action, gain Sage Power to Resistance rolls and reduce Knockback you suffer by 2 × Sage Power yards, minimum 0. Springing — Your next Taijutsu Attack gains Sage Power Accuracy. On a full hit, it also deals 2 × Sage Power Knockback. This benefit ends when that Attack resolves or when you begin a different non-Interrupt Action.

title: Pond-Leap — Sage Art
text: [Speed 3, Utility, Movement, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Leap up to 5 × Sage Power yards to a legal location you can perceive. You may pass over creatures, gaps, low obstacles and difficult ground without reducing this distance. You must end the movement somewhere that can support you.

title: Ripple Strike — Sage Art
text: [Speed +1, Modifier, Taijutsu] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Ripple Strike to a damaging Melee Taijutsu Attack when it is declared. On a full hit, that Attack deals 2 × Sage Power Knockback. If the target is moved at least 3 yards by this Knockback, make an Athletics Status Roll against their Resistance. On a failure, they are knocked Prone.

title: Still-Water Listening — Sage Art
text: While in Sage Mode and in contact with the ground or a continuous body of water, increase Sage Sense by 5 for Awareness rolls made to detect, Search for or track moving creatures within 10 × Sage Rank yards that are touching the same continuous surface. This does not grant line of sight or automatically defeat Stealth; hidden creatures still contest your Search normally.

title: Broad-Backed Guard — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. After you successfully use Take The Hit, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra. Reduce the Final Damage you receive from the intercepted Attack by 10% + (5% × Sage Power). Apply this reduction before Blocking.

title: Heaven-Shaking Landing — Sage Kata
text: [Speed 6, Attack, Taijutsu, Movement] Requires: Sage Rank 4. Cost: 2 Sage Chakra. Leap up to 5 × Sage Power yards, then make either a Basic Attack: Unarmed or a Basic Attack: Weapon using a melee weapon you are wielding against a legal target. Use the chosen Basic Attack under the Sage Kata rules. On a full hit, add Sage Power Damage Dice and deal 3 × Sage Power Knockback. After the Knockback resolves, make an Athletics Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, they are knocked Prone. This Attack counts as Senjutsu.

title: Serpent Sage Panel
text: 🐍 03 SERPENT SAGE Coils, venom and relentless pursuit. EXPAND +

title: SERPENT SAGE
text: Serpent teachings treat safety as a habit to be broken. Distance can be crossed. Restraints can be slipped. Skin can be shed. A patient enemy can wait longer than you can. Their Sages learn to let Natural Chakra travel through the body in long, continuous lines rather than explosive bursts. Their training favours control over spectacle. A Serpent Sage wants the opponent committed, poisoned, bound or standing exactly where the next strike expects them to be. Sage Mode Appearance — Pupils narrow, the shoulders and spine seem unnaturally loose, and scale-like markings creep along the jaw, neck, arms or back. Canines may sharpen and movement becomes disturbingly economical.

title: Coiled Reach — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, your Melee Taijutsu Attacks may originate up to Sage Power yards beyond their normal reach. This does not increase your Threatened Area. This increased origin distance stacks with other effects which explicitly extend where an Attack may originate.

title: Shed the Binding — Sage Art
text: [Speed 1, Utility, Interrupt, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Use this as a Speed 1 Utility Action while suffering physical Immobilization, or as a Speed 1 Interrupt immediately after you gain physical Immobilization from restraints, bindings, grappling effects or terrain. Reduce that Immobilization by 2 + Sage Power. Shed the Binding cannot reduce Paralysis, mental effects or Immobilization caused by a Wound.

title: Venomous Communion — Sage Art
text: When a damaging Taijutsu or Ninjutsu Attack fully hits and deals at least 1 damage after mitigation, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra and make a Chakra Control Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, the target suffers Poison equal to 1 + Sage Power for 5 + (5 × Sage Power) IC. Reapplying this Poison refreshes its duration; it does not stack with itself.

title: Constricting Coil — Sage Art
text: [Speed +1, Modifier, Taijutsu] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Constricting Coil to a Melee Taijutsu Attack when it is declared. On a full hit, make an Athletics Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, they suffer Immobilization equal to 2 + Sage Power.

title: Patient Predator — Sage Art
text: Using Gather Natural Chakra while in Sage Mode does not reduce your current Stealth TN merely for being an Action. All other Stealth rules still apply, including any rule that would reduce your Stealth level.

title: Perfect Shedding — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. Once per Sage Mode, as a Speed 3 Utility Action, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to reduce one Bleed, Burn, Immobilization, Paralysis or Poison affecting you by 2 + Sage Power. Perfect Shedding cannot remove Wounds or penalties caused directly by a Wound.

title: Roc Sage Panel
text: 🦅 04 ROC SAGE Aerial movement and mastery of the sky. EXPAND +

title: ROC SAGE
text: Roc teachings begin by rejecting the idea that the battlefield is flat. Cliffs are roads. Rooftops are footholds. Falling is movement with a deadline. Their students learn to read open air the way other hunters read tracks. Roc Sages favour sudden relocation, rescue and attacks from angles ordinary footwork cannot create. Their greatest weakness is the same thing they prize: once enclosed, grounded or denied room to move, much of their advantage disappears. Sage Mode Appearance — Hair, cloth and loose equipment lift as though caught in a constant updraft. The eyes sharpen, feather-like chakra patterns form around the shoulders and forearms, and fast turns leave brief pinion-shaped trails in the air.

title: Sky-Borne Balance — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, up to Sage Power yards of the distance you move during each Move Action may cross a gap or travel vertically through unsupported air, provided you reach a legal surface at the end of that portion. Whenever a Sage Art moves you, that movement may travel vertically and across unsupported air for its full distance. You must still end the movement in a legal location unless the Art says otherwise. If you end unsupported, you begin Falling normally.

title: Updraft Step — Sage Art
text: [Speed 3, Utility, Movement, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Move up to 5 + (5 × Sage Power) yards. Sky-Borne Balance applies to this movement, and you may change direction once during it.

title: Talon Dive — Sage Kata
text: [Speed +1, Modifier, Taijutsu] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Talon Dive to a damaging Melee Taijutsu Attack if you moved at least 5 yards downward immediately before declaring it. On a full hit, add Sage Power Damage Dice and increase Final Damage by 5% × Sage Power. The Attack counts as Senjutsu.

title: Wing Guard — Sage Art
text: [Interrupt, Defensive, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Declare after becoming the target of a Ranged Attack or Area Attack but before rolling Dodge. Gain 2 + Sage Power to that Dodge roll. If the defence succeeds, move up to Sage Power yards after the Attack resolves without spending AP. This uses the normal Speed of the Dodge and does not create a separate defence.

title: Carry on the Wind — Sage Art
text: [Speed 4, Utility, Movement] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one willing creature in Melee. Move yourself and that creature up to 3 + (3 × Sage Power) yards. Sky-Borne Balance applies. Both creatures must end in legal locations and within Melee of one another.

title: Hang Upon the Sky — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. You may use Gather Natural Chakra while unsupported in the air. While Gathering this way you remain suspended instead of Falling. Your Movement Speed is 0 unless another Sage Art specifically allows you to move while Gathering. When Gather resolves or is aborted, if you are still unsupported you immediately begin Falling.

title: Tortoise Sage Panel
text: 🐢 05 TORTOISE SAGE Endurance, protection and unyielding defence. EXPAND +

title: TORTOISE SAGE
text: Tortoise teachings are old, slow and deeply unimpressed by urgency. Their answer to danger is not always to avoid it. Sometimes the correct response is to become the place where the attack stops. Students are taught that endurance is not passive. Holding a doorway, sheltering another hunter or refusing to be moved can shape a battle as decisively as any strike. A Tortoise Sage spends Natural Chakra like masonry: layer by layer, exactly where the pressure will land. Sage Mode Appearance — The silhouette thickens, geometric or plate-like markings form across the back and limbs, breathing slows, and the feet seem to settle into the ground. At high ranks, impacts against the Sage can sound like blows against stone or old timber.

title: Ancient Carapace — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, increase Block's percentage damage reduction by 5% × Sage Power, to the normal maximum of 75%. You also gain Sage Power to Resistance rolls made against an Attack you Block.

title: Still Shell — Sage Art
text: While Gathering Natural Chakra, you are considered to be Preparing Blocking and may use Block. Block is still an Interrupt and therefore normally aborts Gather after the Block resolves.

title: Stoneback — Sage Art
text: [Speed 3, Utility, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Gain DR equal to 5 + (5 × Sage Power) until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action. Your Movement Speed is reduced by 50% while this effect lasts.

title: Root the World — Sage Art
text: Before making a Resistance roll against Knockback, Prone, Immobilization or another effect that would physically move or displace you, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to gain 5 + Sage Power to that roll. This does not create a Resistance roll where none would normally be made.

title: Sheltering Carapace — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. After you successfully use Take The Hit, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to Block the intercepted Attack even if you were not Preparing Blocking. This Block applies only to that Attack.

title: Unbroken Shell — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. Once per battle, using Block while Gathering Natural Chakra does not abort Gather. The Block still uses its normal Interrupt Speed and all other effects of the Attack resolve normally.

title: Moth Sage Panel
text: 🦋 06 MOTH SAGE Powder, concealment and heightened senses. EXPAND +

title: MOTH SAGE
text: Moth teachings treat perception as something physical. Air carries scent, dust, heat and vibration. Light reveals, but it also blinds. A battlefield is full of information before anyone makes a Search roll; most people are simply too loud inside their own heads to notice it. Moth Sages specialise in controlling that information. They obscure lines of sight, mark prey with almost invisible powder and move through confusion without surrendering their own awareness. Sage Mode Appearance — The eyes become glassy or faintly luminous, powder-fine scales drift from the skin or clothing, and wing-like patterns spread across the back, neck or temples. A motionless Moth Sage can look less asleep than intensely, unnervingly attentive.

title: Powder-Sense — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, reduce the final Visibility Penalty applied to your Awareness and Defensive rolls by Sage Power, minimum 0. Powder-Sense does not reduce Visibility Penalty on your Attacks.

title: Dust Veil — Sage Art
text: [Speed 4, Utility, Area] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Fill a radius of 2 + Sage Power yards centred on you with drifting scales. The area imposes a Visibility Penalty equal to 2 + Sage Power under the normal rules for area-based Visibility. The veil lasts until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action. Powder-Sense applies normally.

title: Powder Mark — Sage Art
text: [Speed 3, Utility, Search] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one creature you can currently detect. Until Sage Mode ends or you mark a new creature, reduce that creature's Stealth TN against your Searches by 2 + Sage Power. Powder Mark does not prevent Stealth and does not reveal the target automatically.

title: Moonwing Drift — Sage Art
text: [Speed 3, Utility, Movement, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Move up to 3 + (3 × Sage Power) yards. If you began this movement in Stealth, the movement does not reduce your Stealth level. Declaring the Action still reduces your Stealth TN by 5 normally.

title: Blinding Scales — Sage Art
text: When a damaging Taijutsu or Ninjutsu Attack fully hits and deals at least 1 damage after mitigation, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra and make a Chakra Control Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, they suffer a Visibility Penalty equal to 2 + Sage Power for 10 IC. If they are already suffering a greater Visibility Penalty, use the greater value rather than adding them together.

title: Cocooned Stillness — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. You may use Gather Natural Chakra at Stealth Level 3 without reducing your Stealth level or Stealth TN for declaring Gather. All other Actions and all other causes of losing Stealth function normally.

title: Carrion Sage Panel
text: 🦅 07 CARRION SAGE Tracking, attrition and exploiting the wounded. EXPAND +

title: CARRION SAGE
text: Carrion traditions are taught by scavengers, corpse-crows, bone-pickers and predators clever enough to understand that the cleanest kill is often the one somebody else already started. They are not necessarily cruel. They are simply honest about injury. A Carrion Sage reads blood loss, limping footwork, ragged breathing and the tiny mistakes made by a creature trying to pretend it is not hurt. Their Senjutsu is strongest once the battlefield has become messy. Sage Mode Appearance — Features sharpen, dark markings gather around the eyes and nose, the teeth become more pronounced, and the Sage's attention repeatedly catches on blood, torn cloth and uneven movement. Even fresh blood can seem unnaturally vivid to them.

title: Blood on the Wind — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode, increase Sage Sense by 5 for Awareness and Survival rolls made specifically to detect, Search for or track a creature suffering a Wound or Bleed. Against those creatures, also reduce your final Visibility Penalty by Sage Power, minimum 0. A successful detection tells you that the creature is injured, not the exact Wound or its statistics.

title: Red Trail — Sage Art
text: Requires: Nature Pulse. Nature Pulse has double its normal range when used to Search for creatures suffering a Wound or Bleed. Against those creatures, reduce the final Visibility Penalty of the Search by an additional Sage Power, minimum 0.

title: Scavenger's Claim — Sage Art
text: [Speed +1, Modifier] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Scavenger's Claim to a damaging Taijutsu or Ninjutsu Attack against a creature suffering a Wound or Bleed. That Attack gains 10% + (5% × Sage Power) Wounding. Scavenger's Claim does not increase the Attack's Final Damage.

title: Circle the Wounded — Sage Art
text: [Speed 3, Utility, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one detected creature suffering a Wound or Bleed. Until Sage Mode ends or you choose a new target with Circle the Wounded, gain Sage Power to Defensive rolls against that creature and increase the distance of Move Actions and Actions with the Movement tag made directly toward it by 25%.

title: Scavenger's Communion — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. Once per battle, when a hostile creature you can detect suffers a Major, Severe or Critical Wound, gain 1 Sage Chakra after that Wound resolves, up to your maximum.

title: Last Descent — Sage Kata
text: [Speed +2, Modifier, Taijutsu] Requires: Sage Rank 4. Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Last Descent to a damaging Taijutsu Attack against a creature at 0 Vitality or suffering a Severe or Critical Wound. On a full hit, add 1 + Sage Power Damage Dice. The Attack counts as Senjutsu.

title: Fungal Sage Panel
text: 🍄 08 FUNGAL SAGE Spores, roots and interconnected terrain. EXPAND +

title: FUNGAL SAGE
text: Fungal traditions begin with a lesson most humans dislike: the mushroom is not the organism. The visible body is temporary. The real creature is the network beneath it, spread through soil, root and rot, touching a hundred places at once. Fungal Sages are taught to think the same way. Position matters more than posture. Ground can carry information. A small patch of prepared terrain can become an extension of the Sage's senses or a trap that keeps an enemy exactly where the network wants them. Sage Mode Appearance — Pale branching lines spread beneath the skin, dust-like motes drift from movement, and the Sage may smell faintly of wet soil, bark or rain. Some develop temporary cap, lichen or shelf-like growths along hair, shoulders or clothing.

title: Rooted Communion — Signature Trait
text: While in Sage Mode and in contact with natural earth, living vegetation or an area created by your Mycelial Ground, gain Sage Power to Resistance rolls and Sage Power to Chakra Control rolls made to prevent Gather Natural Chakra from being aborted by damage.

title: Mycelial Ground — Sage Art
text: [Speed 4, Utility, Area] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose a point on solid ground within 10 yards. A radius of 2 + Sage Power yards around that point becomes Rocky Terrain with severity equal to Sage Power as mycelial growth spreads across the surface. You ignore Immobilization caused by your own Mycelial Ground. The area lasts until Sage Mode ends or you create a new Mycelial Ground.

title: Spore Veil — Sage Art
text: [Speed 4, Utility, Area] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose a point within 10 yards. A radius of 2 + Sage Power yards fills with spores and imposes a Visibility Penalty equal to 2 + Sage Power under the normal rules for area-based Visibility. The veil lasts until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action. Reduce the Visibility Penalty you personally suffer from this Art by Sage Power before applying other reductions.

title: Hyphal Snare — Sage Art
text: [Speed 5, Attack, Ninjutsu] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Range: 10 + (5 × Sage Power) yards. Make a Ninjutsu Attack against one creature standing on natural ground or within your Mycelial Ground. On a full hit, this Attack deals no damage; instead make a Chakra Control Status Roll against the target's Resistance. On a failure, they suffer Immobilization equal to 2 + Sage Power. Hyphal Snare counts as Senjutsu.

title: Deep Roots — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. While touching natural earth, living vegetation or your Mycelial Ground, reduce the base Speed of Gather Natural Chakra by 1. Its minimum Speed is unchanged.

title: The Network Listens — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4 and Nature Pulse. While touching natural earth, living vegetation or your Mycelial Ground, double the range of Nature Pulse. You also increase Sage Sense by 5 for Survival rolls made to read disturbances, tracks or recent movement through that terrain.

title: Salamander Sage Panel
text: 🦎 09 SALAMANDER SAGE Regeneration, resilience and survival. EXPAND +

title: SALAMANDER SAGE
text: Salamander teachings are about surviving the part where survival stops looking heroic. Heat, poison, exhaustion, torn muscle and choking air are treated as temporary problems to be managed long enough to reach safety or finish the fight. Their Sages are not immortal and do not regrow lost limbs or erase Wounds by wishing hard enough. What they learn is how to keep a damaged body useful: shed what can be shed, slow what can be slowed and spend Natural Chakra where the body is failing fastest. Sage Mode Appearance — Skin takes on a slick or patterned sheen, old scars darken, breath may steam in cool air, and minor cuts bead rather than run. During stronger techniques a thin translucent layer can peel away like shed skin.

title: Regenerative Balance — Signature Trait
text: Whenever a Rest successfully reduces your current Stamina Penalty while you are in Sage Mode, also reduce one Burn, Bleed or Poison affecting you by 1 + Sage Power, minimum 0. A Status reduced to 0 this way ends. Regenerative Balance cannot heal Wounds.

title: Shed Pain — Sage Art
text: [Speed 3, Utility, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Reduce one Immobilization or Paralysis effect affecting you by 2 + Sage Power, or stand from Prone. Shed Pain cannot reduce a Status or penalty caused directly by a Wound. If you use Shed Pain to stand, you may also move up to Sage Power yards.

title: Hardy Blood — Sage Art
text: While in Sage Mode, gain Sage Power to Resistance rolls made to resist Burn, Poison, Suffocation and environmental conditions caused by extreme heat, extreme cold, fumes or contaminated terrain. Hardy Blood does not create a Resistance roll where none would normally be allowed.

title: Regrowth — Sage Art
text: [Speed 5, Utility, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Restore Vitality equal to 5% × Sage Power of your maximum Vitality, up to your normal maximum. Regrowth does not restore HP, heal Wounds or remove the effects of a Wound.

title: Molt Away — Sage Art
text: [Speed 5, Utility, Self] Requires: Sage Rank 3. Cost: 2 Sage Chakra. Choose one non-Wound Bleed, Burn, Immobilization, Paralysis or Poison affecting you with severity no greater than 5 + Sage Power. End that Status. Molt Away cannot remove an effect which explicitly cannot be reduced or removed.

title: Refuse the Ash — Sage Art
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. Once per battle, when a Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion roll would advance you beyond maximum Fatigue and Incapacitate you, you may spend 2 Sage Chakra after the roll. The triggering Action resolves and you remain at maximum Fatigue instead, even if the normal Fatigue rules would cause that Action or technique to fail to activate. Refuse the Ash does not prevent Incapacitation caused by HP, Wounds or another effect, and you must have at least 2 Sage Chakra to use it. SHARED SAGE ARTS The techniques below are shared options. Your tradition-specific Arts and Kata are listed inside its expandable section above. ↑ BACK TO SAGE TRADITIONS

title: SAGE ARTS
text: Unless an Art says otherwise, you must be in Sage Mode to use it. If an Art scales using Sage Power, use your current Sage Power when the effect is declared.

title: DEEP RESERVOIR
text: [Stackable, Maximum 2] Increase your maximum Sage Chakra by 2.

title: SWIFT COMMUNION
text: Reduce the base Speed of Gather Natural Chakra by 2. Its minimum Speed remains 5.

title: STABLE BALANCE
text: Reduce Sage Mode's Upkeep by 1, minimum 0.

title: NATURE'S EYES
text: Increase Sage Sense by 5. When you Search for a living creature or active chakra source, reduce your final Visibility Penalty by Sage Power, minimum 0. This never reveals a creature which still successfully contests your Search.

title: NATURE'S UNDERSTANDING
text: Gain +5 on Chakra Control and Survival rolls made specifically to identify, understand, manipulate or endure Natural Chakra, Senjutsu, Sage creatures or environments saturated with Natural Chakra. At Sage Rank 4+, this bonus becomes +10.

title: SAGE'S CORRECTION
text: After making an Accuracy Roll, Defensive roll, Chakra Control roll, Resistance roll or other Skill roll but before its result is resolved, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to add 2 + Sage Power to the roll. Sage's Correction does not modify static Accuracy and may be used only once per roll.

title: SAGE'S BREATH
text: When you make a Chakra Exhaustion or Stamina roll caused by an Action you are taking, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra before rolling to gain +5 + Sage Power to that roll. This is a bonus, not a reroll.

title: NATURAL KATA
text: While in Sage Mode, your Melee Taijutsu Attacks may originate up to 1 + Sage Power yards beyond their normal reach as Natural Chakra follows through the strike. This does not increase your Threatened Area. When a Melee Taijutsu Attack made through this extended reach fully hits, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to add Sage Damage again to that Attack's Final Damage. This additional Sage Damage does not stack with itself.

title: SENJUTSU INFUSION
text: When declaring a damaging Ninjutsu Attack, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one: - Gain 1 + Sage Power Accuracy for that Attack; or - Increase its Final Damage by 10% + (5% × Sage Power). Choose before making the Attack roll. The technique counts as Senjutsu.

title: NATURE GUARD
text: [Interrupt, Defensive, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Declare after you become the target of an Attack but before your defence is rolled. Gain 2 + Sage Power to one Dodge or Parry roll against that Attack. Nature Guard uses the normal Speed of the Defensive Interrupt you choose; it does not create a separate defence.

title: PREDATOR'S STEP
text: When you declare a Move Action or another Action with the Movement tag, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra to increase the distance you can move by 25% × Sage Power. This changes distance, not Speed.

title: NATURE PULSE
text: [Speed 4, Utility, Search] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Make an Awareness Search for living creatures and active chakra sources within 10 × Sage Rank yards. You may Search even without line of sight, although walls, dense terrain, distance and overwhelming ambient chakra may still apply Visibility Penalty. Hidden creatures contest the Search normally with Stealth. On success, learn direction and rough distance. Nature Pulse does not reveal statistics, Jutsu, identity or other information that could not be inferred from the sensed chakra.

title: SAGE'S RECOVERY
text: When you complete a Rest while in Sage Mode, you may spend 1 Sage Chakra. Improve the Rest's reduction to your current Stamina Penalty by Sage Power.

title: STILLNESS IN MOTION
text: Requires: Sage Rank 3. When you declare Gather Natural Chakra, you may choose to remain mobile. If you do, Gather's normal Movement Speed 0 restriction is replaced: during its Delay, you may move each IC as though you were taking a Move Action, but at 25% of your normal movement rate. This movement is part of Gather, does not count as declaring another Action, and does not abort Gather. You still cannot declare another non-Interrupt Action until Gather resolves, and all other interruption rules apply.

title: FLOWING COMMUNION
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4. When Gather Natural Chakra resolves while you are in Sage Mode, you may immediately spend 1 AP. If you do, gain 1 additional Sage Chakra. You cannot gain more than 2 Sage Chakra from the same Gather Action.

title: SAGE RESERVOIR
text: Requires: Sage Rank 4 and Deep Reservoir. Once per battle, when an effect would spend your final Sage Chakra, reduce that Sage Chakra cost by 1, minimum 0. If this prevents you from reaching 0 Sage Chakra, Sage Mode continues.

title: NATURE WITHOUT THOUGHT
text: Requires: Sage Rank 5. Once per battle, the first Sage Art or Sage Kata you use after entering Sage Mode costs 1 less Sage Chakra, minimum 0.

title: SAGE KATA
text: Sage Kata are active combat techniques fuelled by Sage Chakra. For learning and selection, every Sage Kata is a Sage Art. They are not Jutsu unless their text says otherwise and require no Handseals by default. Each Kata follows the normal rules for its listed Action and Attack type. When a Sage Kata tells you to make a Basic Attack, keep that Basic Attack's normal Accuracy modifiers, Damage Dice, Damage Type, Reach, Stamina cost and applicable weapon or unarmed properties, but use the Kata's listed Speed and Delay. If the Kata lists no Delay, its Delay is 0. Calculate Damage Bonus using the Kata's final Speed as normal unless the Kata says otherwise.

title: SAGE STRIKE
text: [Speed 4, Attack, Taijutsu] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Range: Melee. Make either a Basic Attack: Unarmed or a Basic Attack: Weapon using a melee weapon you are wielding. Use the chosen Basic Attack under the Sage Kata rules above. On a full hit, add 1 + Sage Power Damage Dice and increase Final Damage by 5% × Sage Power. This Attack counts as Senjutsu.

title: SAGE REVERSAL
text: Trigger: Successful Parry of a Melee Attack. Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. After the triggering Attack resolves, move up to Sage Power yards without spending AP. Sage Reversal is part of the successful Parry; it does not create a second Interrupt or change that Parry's Speed. This movement must follow a legal path and cannot move you through occupied spaces or terrain you could not normally cross.

title: EARTHEN ROOT
text: [Speed 4, Utility, Self] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Until the beginning of your next non-Interrupt Action, gain 3 + Sage Power to Resistance rolls against forced movement, being knocked Prone, or effects which would physically displace you. Your Movement Speed is 0 while this effect lasts.

title: HUNTER'S SENSE
text: [Speed 3, Utility, Search] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Choose one creature you can currently detect. Until Sage Mode ends or you choose a new target with Hunter's Sense, gain Sage Power Accuracy against that creature and add Sage Sense to Awareness rolls made to keep track of it. You gain no benefit while you cannot detect the target by any sense.

title: NATURAL SHOCK
text: [Speed 5, Attack, Ninjutsu] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Range: 10 + (5 × Sage Power) yards. Make a Ninjutsu Attack against one creature. On a full hit, deal 2 + Sage Power Damage Dice + NDB. Natural Shock counts as Senjutsu and has no Element unless your Tradition gives it one.

title: SAGE BREAK
text: [Speed +2, Modifier] Cost: 1 Sage Chakra. Add Sage Break to a damaging Taijutsu or Ninjutsu Attack when it is declared. The Attack gains Sage Power Penetration and ignores 5% × Sage Power of Final Damage reduction applied by defensive effects, to a minimum of 0% reduction.

title: MASTERY — PERFECT COMMUNION
text: After taking three Natural Chakra Developments, your body no longer has to fight every step of the balancing process. Reduce the base Speed of Gather Natural Chakra by 1 and its minimum Speed by 1. Reduce Sage Mode's Upkeep by 1, minimum 0. The first time you enter Sage Mode in each battle, gain 1 Sage Chakra after Sage Mode resolves. This cannot take you above your maximum.

title: NATURAL IMBALANCE
text: You normally cannot Gather beyond your maximum Sage Chakra. If an effect forces more Natural Chakra into you than you can safely hold, you become Imbalanced until your Sage Chakra is at or below its maximum. While Imbalanced, you cannot Gather Natural Chakra, suffer -2 to Chakra Control rolls, and your Movement Speed is reduced by 50%. At the end of each of your non-Interrupt Actions, lose 1 Sage Chakra until you are no longer above your maximum. If an individual Tradition, monster or technique can cause petrification, mutation or another severe consequence from Natural Imbalance, that consequence is written into that effect. Permanent transformation is not a default risk of using Natural Chakra normally.

title: USING NATURAL CHAKRA
text: Chakra Exhaustion — Jutsu modified by Sage Arts make their normal Chakra Exhaustion rolls. AP — AP may reduce Gather Natural Chakra and Sage Mode normally unless an effect says otherwise. Their minimum Speeds still apply. Clones — A Clone has no Sage Chakra unless its own rules explicitly say it can hold that resource. Sage Chakra held by a Clone is separate from its creator and cannot normally be transferred. Summons — A Summon does not gain its summoner's Natural Chakra Talent. Sage creatures may possess their own Natural Chakra rules and may act as a Source for the Talent. Modes — Sage Mode may coexist with another Mode unless either effect says otherwise. Genjutsu — Sage Mode does not inherently increase Genjutsu Accuracy or damage. Sage sensory effects may help locate a Genjutsu user but do not automatically identify or break a Genjutsu. Senjutsu — Senjutsu is a tag for an effect empowered by balanced Natural Chakra. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Polearm Bukijutsu
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Polearm Bukijutsu
text: A polearm keeps enemies at the tip of the weapon. Catch an approach, hold your reach and drive through a broken guard.

title: Nuke Zuki - Passing Thrust
text: E-Rank The thrust is carried through a passing step so the point threatens beyond the weapon’s usual measure. Rank: E Stamina: +3 Damage: +max(2, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +0 Tags: Chain 1, Polearm, Attack Effects: Increase the weapon’s unmodified Reach by 50%, minimum +2 yards. On a full hit, the target cannot use Take the Hit until it completes its next non-Interrupt Action.

title: Ishizuki Uke - Butt-End Check
text: E-Rank The rear of the weapon becomes a second striking end. Rank: E Stamina: +3 Damage: +max(2, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: -1 Accuracy: +1 Special: Knockback 4 Tags: Chain 1, Polearm, Attack, Movement Effects: Treat the attack as Blunt. On a full hit, the target takes −2 to its next Attack against you before your next Action. On a successful Special, you may follow the target up to the distance it was moved, ending within your normal Reach.

title: Nui Zuki - Threading Thrust
text: E-Rank The point is threaded through a small defensive window rather than swung around the guard. Rank: E Stamina: +5 Damage: +max(3, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +1 Tags: Chain 2, Polearm, Attack Effects: Defensive Interrupts against this Attack count as +1 Base Speed for Defense Validity. Reduce the target armor’s flat DR by 20% for this Attack, after applying its damage-type matchup.

title: Oshikomi Zuki - Driving Thrust
text: E-Rank This is a committed line attack that spends the polearm’s reach aggressively. Rank: E Stamina: +8 Damage: +max(5, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +5 Tags: Chain 3, Polearm, Attack Effects: Gain additional Reach equal to half the weapon’s unmodified Reach, minimum 2 yards, and +15% Wounding.

title: Yari Gamae - Set Spear
text: E-Rank The user stops chasing the opponent and makes the opponent enter the weapon instead. Rank: E Stamina: 5 Speed: 5 Tags: Chain X, Polearm, Attack, Interrupt Effects: When a creature enters your Reach, make a Polearm Basic Weapon Attack at 85% final damage. It is Chain X.

title: Kaiten Uchi - Rotation Strike
text: E-Rank The whole polearm is rotated through a controlled arc. Rank: E Stamina: +7 Damage: +max(3, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +5 Area: 2 Tags: Bukijutsu, Polearm, Attack Effects: Attack all chosen enemies in Reach. If only one creature is targeted, gain +Athletics/5 Accuracy instead.

title: Karame Gaeshi - Catch and Turn
text: D-Rank The hook, blade, or shaft catches posture instead of simply striking it. Rank: D Stamina: +8 Damage: +max(3, floor(STR/10))dS Speed: +2 Special: Knockback 4 or Prone Tags: Chain 2, Polearm, Attack Effects: On a full hit, choose one: Turn — resolve Knockback equal to the greater of 4 or STR/8 in any legal direction; or Sweep — resolve Prone normally.

title: Nuidome Zuki - Pinning Thrust
text: D-Rank You brace the haft and drive the point through the target’s line with enough commitment that the impact itself disrupts their movement. Rank: D Stamina: +12 Damage: +max(5, floor(STR/10))dS Speed: +4 Special: Immobilization 2 Tags: Chain 3, Polearm, Attack Effects: This Attack deals Piercing wounds and gains +15% Wounding. Resolve Immobilization with severity equal to the greater of 2 or Athletics/10, maximum 6. It ends when the target spends a Speed 3 Utility Action to free the impaled clothing or equipment.

title: E no Kamae - Haft Guard
text: D-Rank You catch the incoming strike and push the opponent out along the shaft. Rank: D Stamina: 5 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Polearm, Utility, Interrupt Effects: Parry a targeted Melee Attack with +Athletics/5. On a full success, push the attacker directly away to any legal point within your Polearm Reach. This cannot pass through obstacles and does not defend against AoEs.

title: Enshin no Kamae - Extended Guard
text: D-Rank You hold the point forward and force approaching enemies to deal with it. Rank: D Stamina: 7 Upkeep: 1 Speed: 4 Tags: Bukijutsu, Polearm, Utility Effects: Increase Polearm Reach by 50%, minimum +2 yards. While maintained, when a perceived creature voluntarily moves from outside to inside that Reach, you may use Set Spear at full damage. A full hit stops that approach at contact. This does not stop teleportation or forced movement. Pay Set Spear’s normal costs and Interrupt Speed.

title: Buki Kake - Weapon Hook
text: C-Rank The head or shaft catches the opponent’s weapon and drags its line away from where they want to use it. Rank: C Stamina: +9 Damage: +max(4, floor(STR/7))dS Speed: +2 Tags: Chain 2, Polearm, Attack Effects: On a full hit, choose one held weapon. Until the target completes a Speed 3 Utility Action to free it, it cannot use that weapon to Attack or Parry. You must keep the Polearm in hand and the target within Reach; releasing the hook ends the restriction. You may continue Polearm Chain Attacks against that target while maintaining the hook.

title: E Mawashi - Shaft Pivot
text: C-Rank You move around the opponent with the shaft between you and their weapon. Rank: C Stamina: +6 Speed: +0 Tags: Link, Polearm, Attack Effects: Link to a Polearm Attack against your chained target. If the target uses a weapon to Parry, halve that weapon’s positive Parry modifiers, rounded down. On a full hit, choose that weapon: it cannot Parry your next Polearm Chain Attack. Other legal defenses remain available.

title: Tobi Bō - Leaping Pole
text: C-Rank The shaft is planted and used as a lever for the body. Rank: C Stamina: +12 Damage: +max(5, floor(STR/7))dS Speed: +3 Tags: Chain 2, Polearm, Attack, Movement Effects: Vault toward a target using Move with an Attack calculated from the Attack’s full final Speed. This movement may clear intervening difficult ground or a gap with a legal landing. On a full hit, resolve Prone using Athletics against Resistance. Against an already Prone target, gain +50% Wounding instead.

title: Yokogi Uke - Crossbar Catch
text: B-Rank You catch the projectile on the shaft and turn it aside. Rank: B Stamina: 8 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Polearm, Utility, Interrupt Effects: Parry a targeted Ranged Taijutsu or Projectile Attack with +Athletics/5. On a full success, redirect a physical projectile at its attacker if that attacker is within the projectile’s remaining Range. Use your Parry result as Accuracy and the projectile’s original damage; it defends normally. This counter adds no further cost or action time and cannot itself be redirected. This does not defend against AoEs.

title: Suri Maai - Sliding Measure
text: B-Rank You slide your grip to extend the point or put your weight behind the head. Rank: B Stamina: 7 Speed: 2 Tags: Chain X, Polearm, Utility Effects: Choose a benefit for your next non-Interrupt Action, which must be a Polearm Attack: Long Measure adds twice the weapon’s unmodified Reach; Short Measure gains +30% Final Damage and may attack at adjacency without the weapon’s minimum-Reach penalty. This does not remove other restrictions on using that weapon. Repeated uses do not stack.

title: Issen Zuki - Through-Line
text: A-Rank You carry the thrust through the chained target and keep moving with it, using the opening to either pass their body or send the point into the next threat on the same line. Rank: A Stamina: +26 Damage: +max(14, floor(STR/3))dS Speed: +5 Tags: Chain 3, Polearm, Attack Effects: Gain +30% Wounding and ignore half the target armor’s Absorption and flat DR after its damage-type matchup. On a full hit, you may strike one creature directly behind it and within Reach at full damage. The second creature defends against the same Accuracy result. Resolve Chain progression once.

title: Teko Nage - Levering Throw
text: A-Rank You catch the attack on the haft, drop your weight under it, and use the polearm as a lever to throw the attacker off their base. Rank: A Stamina: 13 Speed: 4 Special: Knockback, Prone (see Effects) Tags: Chain X, Polearm, Utility, Interrupt Effects: Parry a targeted Melee Attack with +Athletics/5. On a full success, win one Athletics Status Roll against the attacker’s Resistance to apply Prone and Knockback equal to the greater of 10 or STR/3 in any legal direction. The throw may carry it beyond your Reach. This does not defend against AoEs. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Raiton · Lightning
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES LEARNING REQUIREMENTS ↗

title: Raiton: Lightning Style
text: Lightning (Raiton) Nothing out of the ordinary here! This is chakra-based electricity, not real electricity, so it has no special ability to, say, electrocute everyone in contact with water, or anything like that (Though some specific Raiton jutsus DO have similar effects to actual electricity, that is inherent to those jutsus and not the element as a whole).

title: Rashinban no Jutsu - Compass Technique
text: E-Rank It's about what it sounds like. The user channels lightning elemental chakra into a needle, or kunai, or similar-sized and -shaped object, which will then, when laid flat (sometimes requiring a few taps to help it along) point towards magnetic north. Chakra: 5 Speed: 4 Seal Speed: 12 Tags: Utility Effects: Allows a single kunai or senbon to be used as a compass for 6 hours or until used in an attack. It's not quite perfect, but it's good enough for most uses. In combat, this jutsu allows the user to perform a Search action (that stacks and does not interrupt previous Searches) with a +2 bonus per severity of Raiton-induced Paralysis on any targets within CHA yards.

title: Seiden - Static Electricity
