If they choose to move at full speed, they must make an Athletics Check against the same TN or fall Prone (though they still move the full amount). The Prone’s penalties do apply to any Defense against the Attack this was in response to. Anybody inside the Area of Rainwater Slick suffers from Immobilization -1, as they have to put a little more thought into all of their actions.

title: Suiton: Shigure - Water Release: Drizzle
text: D-Rank The user condenses the water in the air to fire multiple blasts in unison. This allows for large crowd control or by focusing them into single targets it produces a much stronger attack. Chakra: 12 + G Damage: (3d8 + 25)(1 + 0.2X) + (G-2)5 Range: 15 Speed: 8 Seal Speed: 9 Accuracy: +X/4 Gallons Requirement: 2 > 8 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Blunt Effects: You fire G number of projectiles and can direct them at a single target or split them between any number of targets. The X for this jutsu is determined by the number of projectiles thrown at each individual target.

title: Suiton: Teppoudama - Water Release: Liquid Bullet
text: D-Rank The user kneads chakra and converts it into water inside their stomach, then spits it out in the form of a dense, chakra propelled ball. Its greatest boon to suiton users is that it can be used in an area without any preexisting water. Chakra: 13 Damage: 7d8+32 Range: 12 Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 11 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Blunt Effects: This adds 3 gallons of water to the battlefield every time it's used.

title: Takigakure Ryu, Mizukiri no Yaiba - Hidden Waterfall Style, Water-Cutting Blade
text: D-Rank Originally developed by the Hidden Waterfall village, this technique has since spread into wider use. The first half of the name is generally dropped, though some choose to keep it out of respect. The jutsu creates a blade out of water, kept as strong as most metals by the chakra infusing it. Chakra: 10 + X/2 Upkeep: 1 + X/10 (Rounded Up) Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 10 Gallons Requirement: 0 > 12 Tags: Utility, Self, Creation Effects: You craft a Sword upgrading it using X Artisan Points up to your Chakra Control - 4 + G/3. You may choose to double the Base Speed and Upkeep of this Technique to create a second Sword in your other hand during the activation of this Technique and both weapons gain the dual property. The Sword (s) gains the following effects and Upgrades: Its Sword lasts until you let go of it or end this Technique’s Upkeep You may perform Handseals for Suiton jutsu by increasing the Seal Speed by 4 per weapon The weapon has a third of its normal Durability (2) Your weapon may add Gallons up to your ranks in this ability to the attack Its Damage Dice is increased by Gallons used 5 . Max G (the G used in weapon creation)

title: Tako no Katachi - Octopus Form
text: D-Rank A body of water formed around the user’s arms into long whip-like tendrils which can be used to grasp or strike an opponent or to intercept incoming attacks. Chakra: 12 + G/2 Upkeep: 2X Speed: 6 Seal Speed: 10 Gallons Requirement: 4X Tags: Utility, Self Effects: You may create X whips to a max of Chakra Control Ranks /5. The range of all taijutsu attacks is increased by 5 + X, but used in this way converts the attack into ranged and it gains knockback equal to half the range.

title: Mizu Bunshin no Jutsu - Water Clone Technique
text: C-Rank An advanced form of the standard Bunshin no Jutsu, this creates clones out of water. Since they're solid (well, relatively) these clones can be used to perform tasks the user is unable or unwilling to do for themselves. While they're weaker than their user, they can still prove dangerous in combat. Chakra: 10 + G Speed: 6 + 2X Seal Speed: 10 + X3 Gallons Requirement: 5X Tags: Utility, Clone Effects: You create X clones following all Bushin rules with the following exceptions: A clone can be created with a Sword (From the Standard Equipment options) in hand by spending an additional 2 Gallons of Water on each clone. You may spend up to your Chakra Control - 5 Artisan Points on upgrading these swords, splitting it between all of your clones. [1 AP] Dodge, or Parry. [Variable AP] Move: The clone may move around the battlefield. This costs 1 AP per 2 IC it spends moving. [Variable AP] The clone may make any basic unarmed or weapon attack, by paying 1 AP per 2 Speed of that action. [5 + X AP] The clone can use itself to create a water prison (as per Suiton: Suirou no Jutsu) and on a success the clone is destroyed. X is the number of gallons for the jutsu’s cost and requires no actual gallons. You must pay the Chakra cost rather than the clones (though they still gain the upkeep. If you go to the prison you can take it over by assuming it’s upkeep, and from then on you are treated as having used the jutsu.

title: Mizugakure no Jutsu - Hidden in Water Technique
text: C-Rank The user sinks into a shallow pool of water, much too little to actually fit a person (it's ninja magic, don't ask questions), where they'll be able to easily lie in wait for a target to pass by, or spy on someone who might be near. Chakra: 18 Upkeep: 3 Speed: 14 Seal Speed: 14 Requires: 10 Gallons of Water on the field Tags: Utility, Ground-Based, Aura Effects: You hide, and immediately enter Stealth 3. If an opponent does not have a reason to suspect you're there (i.e. this isn't being done in-combat) you have a +5 Stealth bonus. You maintain awareness of your surroundings outside of the pool as if it's a window. The puddle being reduced below 10 gallons, results in you being harmlessly ejected.

title: Mizutamari no Jutsu - Pool of Water Technique
text: C-Rank A moderately advanced technique is the appropriately named water-walking technique; molding chakra below one's feet to 'stand' on patches of water without any actual expenditure of energy, and, once it's perfected, only minimal concentration. This technique builds upon that concept, creating a 'cushion' of static, almost-solid water beneath each foot that the ninja stands on to avoid direct contact with the ground. Chakra: 10 + G2 Upkeep: 3 Speed: 6 Seal Speed: 14 Gallons Requirement: 0 > 6 Requires: Water Walking Ability Tags: Utility, Ground-Based Effects: You reduce any immobilization penalties due to the condition of the ground you're crossing by G, and ignore any other mechanical effects (such as damage for walking across caltrops) if they're C-rank or lower; if they're B-rank or above, you instead halve them. You are considered not directly in contact with the ground (for say, the Doton jutsu Shindou).

title: Suiton: Mizuame Nabara - Water Release: Syrup Capture Field
text: C-Rank The user converts chakra into water, and infuses it with enough chakra to alter its composition, making it extremely viscous. They then spit it out in a stream of sticky, highly adhesive liquid. Chakra: 20 Upkeep: 3 Range: 25 Area: 15 Speed: 14 Seal Speed: 16 Tags: Utility, AoE, Environmental, Ground-Based Effects: If a person has the ability to walk on water, they may cross this area without difficulty. Anyone else in the area suffers a -4 immobilization penalty. This jutsu's effects persist for 50 IC even after you drop the upkeep. However, so long as the upkeep is maintained, you may control the syrup enough to have it try to 'grab' anyone using water-walking to cross it unaffected; if the attack hits, the person is stuck in the syrup as if they weren't using water-walking. This is a Speed 6 action, with a Chakra cost of 15.

title: Suiton: Mizurappa - Water Release: Violent Water Wave
text: C-Rank Inhaling a large amount of air and performing the necessary seals, the user will expel a copious amount of water from his/her mouth. The wave of water produced will slam against its opponent and can then be utilized for other techniques. Chakra: 19 Damage: 10d10+60 Range: 20 Area: 15 Speed: 12 Seal Speed: 10 Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt Effects: This technique adds 5 gallons of water to the battlefield every time it's used.

title: Suiton: Suijinheki - Water Formation Pillar
text: C-Rank A vertical wall of water rises to catch an incoming attack and collapse around it. Chakra: 22 Speed: 7 Seal Speed: 12 Tags: Interrupt, Barrier, Suiton Effects: Make a Ninjutsu Parry against a damaging Melee, Projectile, or AoE attack. On full success, protect only yourself unless the technique's Area explicitly fits behind the wall. On success, add 10 gallons of water to your location after resolution. Against Raiton, suffer -2 to the Parry.

title: Suiton: Suikoudan - Water Release: Water Shark Blast
text: C-Rank After creating the handseals, you launch water in projectile form at an opponent. Some ninja like to etch the outline of a shark's head into the end of this projectile; others, who believe that being a ninja is very serious business, prefer to omit that part of the technique. Experienced users can even use this to allow themselves to fly quickly through the water, while protecting themselves with the might of the tearing shark. Chakra: 14 + G Damage: 10d12 + (G 7) + 10 Line: 3, G2 Speed: 14 Seal Speed: 12 Gallons Requirement: 5 > 12 Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt Effects: You may move to any location along the area of this technique, unhindered by anything which would normally prevent you from moving. You may ignore other Ground-Based effects during this movement.

title: Suiton: Suirou no Jutsu - Water Release: Water Prison Technique
text: C-Rank The user gathers the chakra around their hand, and forms the required water into a sphere which encloses its victim. Due to the density of the chakra used in this technique, the water is stronger than steel. It is not, however, airtight. Yeah, don't ask how that works. We don't know either. Chakra: 15 + G Upkeep: 4 Speed: 12 Seal Speed: 16 Accuracy: -2 Gallons Requirement: 5 > 12 Requires: 12 Chakra Control Tags: Attack, Melee Effects: If this Jutsu hits, the victim is trapped inside a sphere of water. People inside cannot take actions, but they also cannot be affected by anything outside the prison; yes, that's right, the water can even stop giant swords. It makes sense, honestly, we promise, somehow. Anyone with a Chakra Control Rank of G2 or above is able to mold the chakra around them to allow themselves to siphon air through the prison, meaning they can still talk and breathe. Any target with less CC, however, suffers a Suffocation 1 status every 10 IC. To maintain the water prison, you must keep one hand on it. Dodging requires you to end the effect; if you take damage, you must make a Chakra Control check against a TN of 5+(damage taken)/10 or the prison ends. Although you can't move, you can still take most other actions that are possible one-handed while maintaining the prison's upkeep.

title: Umi no Tate no Jutsu - Ocean Shield Technique
text: C-Rank A derivative of a more advanced technique, this was created to help teach up-and-coming suiton users the foundations of that jutsu, and help keep them alive until they were skilled enough to learn it. It creates a circular barrier of water around you, which surges up to protect you from... well, whatever convinces you that you'd need to use this technique. Chakra: 6 + G1.5 Speed: 8 Seal Speed: 8 Gallons Requirement: 6 > 12 Tags: Interrupt Effects: You may Parry a Melee, Ranged or AoE Attack with a Bonus of +(G/3). This works against jutsu weak to it up to A rank, jutsu strong against it up to C-rank, and all other Jutsu (including Taijutsu) up to B-rank.

title: Benzaiten no Jutsu - River Goddess Technique
text: B-Rank Named after the deity who supposedly watches over a major river, this technique coats the user's body with a thin layer of chakra-infused water. It offers no real protection from impacts or weapons, but can be an effective supplement to one's defenses against heat and other unpleasantness. Chakra: 5 + G Upkeep: 4 Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 19 Gallons Requirement: 10 > 15 Tags: Utility, Self, Aura Effects: You end any ongoing ignites on you. So long as this is maintained you cannot gain any by Ignite or Burn statuses, and you take (10+G)% less damage from Katon Jutsu (applied after other reductions).

title: Suiton: Bakusui Shouha - Water Release: Exploding Water Shockwave
text: B-Rank The user creates an enormous amount of water by spewing it from their mouth, flooding the battlefield and potentially crushing foes in its path. Best of all, they get to look awesome while doing it! The wave rises up from beneath the user, and they can 'ride' it to its destination. Chakra: 33 Damage: 18d12+90 Area: X3 Speed: 17 Seal Speed: 24 Special: Stun X/2 Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt Effects: X is your ninjutsu damage bonus and produces that many gallons. This Technique's Speed cannot be reduced below 12 by any means and it cannot be Dodged unless you can completely escape the area. As part of this technique, you may move up to half its Area in yards, in any direction. The Area of this Technique does not move with you - it remains centered on where your movement began.

title: Suiton: Goshokuzame - Five Feeding Sharks
text: B-Rank Five chakra sharks move through water as a coordinated hunting pattern. Chakra: 34 Damage: 4d10 × 5 Range: 30 Speed: 20 Seal Speed: 20 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Suiton Effects: Requires the target to be touching a body of wat er containing at least 20 gallons. Make up to five attacks; divide the five damage groups among targets in the same connected water. A target uses one Defensive Interrupt but rolls separately against each shark. Combine damage only for Wounding after all hits.

title: Suiton: Suidanha - Water Severing Wave
text: B-Rank A thin, high-pressure stream turns water into a cutting tool. Chakra: 32 Damage: 32d10+10 Accuracy: +1 Range: 20 Speed: 14 Seal Speed: 18 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Slashing, Suiton Effects: Requires 8 gallons of available water or +5 Chakra to create it. Against unattended objects and created Barriers, treat Damage as 25% higher. It does not bypass Armor or DR against creatures.

title: Suiton: Suigadan - Water Release: Water Fang Bullet
text: B-Rank This move forms multiple pressurized, spiraling columns of water that have a drill-like ability to pierce and destroy their target. As this attack can originate from any body of water (rather than being shot directly from the attacker), in the right environments this has a 360 degree range of attack, making it incredibly difficult to defend against adequately. Chakra: 23 + G/2 Damage: 14d10 + G5 + 10 Accuracy: +2 Range: 35 Speed: 15 Seal Speed: 18 Gallons Requirement: 6 > 16 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Piercing Effects: If there are at least 10 Gallons of Water left in the Background after this Technique is used (or one is, say, over a lake, river, or other body of water such as Syrup Capture Field), this Technique is automatically a Surprise Attack.

title: Suiton: Suijinheki - Water Release: Water Encampment Wall
text: B-Rank This defensive technique creates a wall of water around you, which forms a violently churning defensive perimeter. When lacking water in the environment to use, a talented shinobi can form it in their stomach and spit it out. Chakra: 26 Upkeep: 4 Area: 5 Speed: 12 Seal Speed: 16 Requires: 16 gallons of water or +8 chakra cost Tags: Interrupt, Environmental Effects: If using Suijinheki as an interrupt: Roll a parry against the attack's accuracy, with a +6 bonus; if you succeed, this stops the attack entirely. Once Suijinheki has been deployed, it lasts for your damage bonus in initiative counts--it automatically defends all attacks using your initial parry roll. It ends early if an attack breaks through the barrier or you may also end it early, if you need to move or attack through it. This technique protects you and anyone within its area from any jutsu strong against this up to B-rank, and all other techniques (including taijutsu) up to A-rank.

title: Suiton: Suikyō - Water Mirror
text: B-Rank A flat reflective water surface creates a momentary duplicate of an incoming attack's shape. Chakra: 30 Speed: 9 Seal Speed: 16 Tags: Interrupt, Barrier, Suiton Effects: Use against a Projectile Ninjutsu up to B-rank. Make a Ninjutsu Parry at -2. On success the attack is negated and the mirror breaks. If you beat the attack by 5+, the attacker suffers NDB×5 damage of the original technique's damage type; this reflected damage cannot Wound.

title: Suiton: Suiryuudan - Water Release: Water Dragon Blast
text: B-Rank This technique shapes a large amount of water into a giant, dragon-shaped projectile which seeks out and crashes into whoever you direct it at. What it lacks for in complexity, it makes up for by being a highly effective tool in any Suiton using shinobi's arsenal. Chakra: 16 + G Damage: 20d6 + G10 + 15 Range: 50 Speed: 18 Seal Speed: 23 Gallons Requirement: 10 > 20 Special: Stun 10 Tags: Attack, Projectile, Blunt

title: Suiton: Takitsubo no Jutsu - Water Release: Waterfall Basin Technique
text: B-Rank You use existing water to drill down to an underground source, then draw it to the surface as a geyser. The resulting water can supply a camp or support other Suiton techniques. Chakra: 22 Speed: 10 Seal Speed: 20 Gallons Requirement: 10 > 25 Tags: Utility, Environmental Effects: This Technique adds (G/5) Gallons of Water onto the Background every 5 IC, for a Duration of 100 ICs.

title: Suiton: Uramiame - Water Release: Grudge Rain
text: B-Rank As a weather-manipulation jutsu, this technique is extremely taxing upon its user. Upon its completion a large storm cloud is created, which proceeds to, as storm clouds are prone to do, rain. This rain saps the chakra from anyone it comes in contact with, and transfers it through the pooling water to the technique's user. Chakra: 30 Upkeep: 4 Area: 30 Speed: 14 Seal Speed: 24 Tags: Utility, AoE, Environmental Effects: Every 10 IC, everyone other than the user and up to Chakra Control/5 people they've designated as allies has their Chakra Exhaustion penalty increased by 1, and the user has their Chakra Exhaustion penalty decreased by 1 per person present affected by the rain. If the user moves, they may cause the mist to 'follow' them; It moves at a speed of 0.5 Yards per IC until the user is back in its center.

title: Dai Bakusui Shouha - Great Exploding Water Shockwave
text: A-Rank A stronger but less directly offensive version of the B-rank Exploding Water Shockwave, the user spits out a truly prodigious amount of water. Chakra: 40 Upkeep: 5 Damage: 20d10+190 Area: 80 Speed: 22 Seal Speed: 25 Special: This technique receives only half your damage bonus. Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt, Environmental Effects: This adds 40 Gallons of Water to the Background. So long as there are at least 30 Gallons in the Background at any time while this Technique's Upkeep is maintained, any Ground-Based Techniques (Such as Earth Split Turnaround Palm or Syrup Capture Field) become impossible to use. Regardless, all Suiton Techniques treat the maximum of their Gallons Requirement as if it was 5 higher. Additionally, anyone who is standing in its Area will begin sinking even if they have the Water Walking Ability (The currents are simply too tumultuous). They can swim at half their normal movement speed (movement-increasing jutsu typically will not work), and until they've exited the area suffer Suffocation 1 every 15 IC. Alternatively, they can take a Speed 2 action to stay at the surface for the next 15 IC.

title: Suiton: Daibakufu - Water Release: Great Waterfall
text: A-Rank This is one of the most powerful water ninjutsu in existence; once the appropriate seals are formed, the user unleashes a devastating tidal wave which tears across the battlefield like a scaled-down tsunami, knocking aside people, trees, and small buildings in its path. Long ago, exceptionally skilled shinobi were able to fill their impromptu waterfall with all manner of weapons, which were propelled within the wave at incredible speeds. This had the effect of making it an almost inevitably deadly technique that would leave pools of blood mixed in with the water. However, use of that aspect of the technique was forbidden due to its unbelievable power, and as peace settled across the lands the secret of how to do that was lost. Chakra: 30 + G/2 Damage: G10 + 30 Line: 20, 80 Speed: 24 Seal Speed: 28 Special: Stun 14 Gallons Requirement: 20 > 40 Tags: Attack, AoE, Blunt Effects: This Technique pushes any targets hit with a Knockback of G.

title: Suiton: Daikoudan - Water Release: Great Shark Blast
text: A-Rank This creates an enormous shark out of water and sends it crashing across the battlefield at whichever party has offended the user sufficiently for them to feel the need to do so. Aside from impacting its primary target, the shark is massive enough to cause significant collateral damage. The technique's true secret, however, is its ability to absorb any chakra it comes in contact with and use that energy to further empower itself. Chakra: 30 + G/2 Damage: 18d20 + G8 + 20 Line: 5, 60 Speed: 20 Seal Speed: 26 Gallons Requirement: 12 > 30 Tags: Attack, Interrupt, Projectile, AoE, Blunt Effects: As an interrupt this technique's Seal Speed is reduced by 10, its Chakra cost is increased by 10 and can only target the attacker. Daikoudan may be used to Interrupt techniques so long as its Speed is equal to or less than theirs, but can only Interrupt Projectile Attacks. Compare the damage of these attacks with Jutsu weak to it reduced by 25%, and Jutsu strong against it increased by 25%. If the incoming attack does more damage, you are hit by it, but it has its damage reduced by your damage. If Daikoudan's damage is greater, it becomes an attack against the opponent with any Accuracy bonuses (but not penalties) of the attack it countered. Similarly, if a ninjutsu-based defense is used against Daikoudan, and fails to stop it completely, it does full damage (bypassing even partial defense).

title: Suiton: Suiryuuben - Water Release: Water Hydra Whip
text: A-Rank This jutsu creates a levitating orb of water which can project numerous whips and tendrils of water. These tendrils can be guided to targets by remote manipulation of the orb's chakra, even changing direction in mid-trajectory to find their targets. On top of that, they're sharp-tipped and more than capable of perforating opponents many times over. Chakra: 25 + G/5 Upkeep: 6 Damage: 10d10+50 Range: 40 + 5Ndb Speed: 20 Seal Speed: 28 Gallons Requirement: 50 > 100 Tags: Utility, Environmental Effects: When you first use this Technique, you create a levitating ball of water, and perform one Tendral Whipping Attack (mentioned below) for free. A So long as you maintain this technique, your pet giant levitating ball of water will fight for you! It acts 1 IC after it's created and can take the following Actions, by spending your AP: [X AP, Speed X] Move: It moves as if it had taken a Speed (X)5 action, using your CHA in place of its AGI. It cannot (deliberately) move outside its max range. If it does end up outside that range, it can take no actions other than moving towards you. [3 + X3 AP, Speed 12, Piercing] Tendril Whipping: You target X people within range. Your water ball makes a Projectile Attack against anyone within half this technique's max range, doing the above listed damage if it hits. This does piercing damage. Additionally, the levitating water ball receives its own pool of AP equal to (G/2) which it may spend to perform the Action mentioned above and/or lower their own Speed. This technique uses your base Accuracy at Fatigue 0 and half your NDB. Because the attacks are made by the technique, and not you, you cannot modify them further such as through Willpower or your own AP. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Sword Bukijutsu
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Sword Bukijutsu
text: Sword techniques exploit an opponent’s habits. Change your angle, catch a familiar defense and finish through the opening.

title: Kiriage - Rising Cut
text: E-Rank You cut upward beneath the target’s guard. Rank: E Stamina: +3 Damage: +max(2, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: -1 Tags: Chain 1, Sword, Attack Effects: On a full hit, note the Defense used. If the target uses that broad Defense against your next Sword Chain Attack, it takes a penalty of Athletics/5 and its final Speed is doubled when advancing its next action. This does not affect Interrupt validity.

title: Nukiuchi - Draw Cut
text: E-Rank You strike as the sword leaves its sheath. Rank: E Stamina: +4 Damage: +max(1, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +0 Accuracy: +1 Tags: Chain 1, Sword, Attack Effects: Requires a sheathed sword. Reduce this Attack’s final Speed by 2 after modifiers, subject to normal minimums. If the target has not yet attacked you this combat, gain +25% Wounding. The sword ends drawn.

title: Kirioroshi - Descending Cut
text: E-Rank You bring the blade down through the opening made by your previous strike. Rank: E Stamina: +5 Damage: +max(3, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +1 Tags: Chain 2, Sword, Attack Effects: If your previous Chain attack was Chain 1, choose one when this Attack fully hits: Drop Weight — treat this Attack as 4 Speed higher for damage only; or Smother the Guard — note the Defense used against this Attack; that same broad Defense takes −Athletics/5 against your next Sword Chain attack.

title: Todome Giri - Finishing Cut
text: E-Rank You commit to a precise cut through the exposed target. Rank: E Stamina: +8 Damage: +max(5, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: +3 Tags: Chain 3, Sword, Attack Effects: Gain +30% Wounding and reduce Called Shot penalties by Athletics/5, minimum 0. If your previous Sword Chain Attack hit through Partial Defense, use +50% Wounding instead. This exploits a weakened guard without requiring an already-broken Chain.

title: Hanpo - Half-Step
text: E-Rank You change position while keeping your blade between you and the target. Rank: E Stamina: +4 Speed: +1 Tags: Link, Sword, Attack Effects: Link to a Sword Attack. If the target Dodges, double that Defense’s final Speed when advancing its next action. This does not change whether the Defense is a valid Interrupt.

title: Iaidō - Way of the Draw
text: E-Rank You draw and strike in one motion from a still stance. Rank: E Stamina: +6 Damage: +max(3, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: -2 Tags: Bukijutsu, Sword, Attack Effects: Requires a sheathed sword. On the first use against a creature this combat, its Defensive Interrupts count as +2 Base Speed for Defense Validity. Ends drawn.

title: Kaeshi Giri - Reversing Cut
text: D-Rank You reverse the blade across the line of your previous attack. Rank: D Stamina: +8 Damage: +max(3, floor(STR/10))dS Speed: +2 Tags: Chain 2, Sword, Attack Effects: Read the Defense used against your previous Chain Attack. If the target repeats that broad Defense, it takes a penalty of Athletics/5. If it changes Defense, this Attack gains +25% Final Damage.

title: Sakaba - Reverse Edge
text: D-Rank You turn the blade’s recovery into a second cut. Rank: D Stamina: +10 Damage: +max(5, floor(STR/10))dS Speed: -1 Tags: Chain 3, Sword, Attack Effects: If the previous Chain Attack was partially defended, impose a penalty of Athletics/5 on the target’s Defense against this Attack.

title: Karame Modoshi - Bind and Recover
text: D-Rank You catch the attacking weapon and guide it aside. Rank: D Stamina: 6 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Sword, Utility, Interrupt Effects: Parry a targeted Melee Attack with +Athletics/5. On a full success, your next Sword Chain Attack against that attacker gains +Athletics/5 Accuracy if it is your next non-Interrupt Action. This does not defend against AoEs.

title: Tanren no Ha - Tempered Edge
text: D-Rank Chakra is run along the cutting geometry of the weapon, tightening the edge and keeping it from skidding or twisting on hard contact. Rank: D Chakra: 12 Upkeep: 2 Speed: 7 Tags: Bukijutsu, Sword, Utility Effects: One sword gains +15% Wounding, stacking with its printed Sword Bukijutsu Wounding. Its edge may cut chakra-created physical bindings as an ordinary weapon Attack against that binding, using the binding’s normal durability and destruction rules. This grants no ability to cut intangible possession or effects without a physical target.

title: Hantō Zuki - Half-Sword Thrust
text: C-Rank You shorten the sword and drive the point through a seam in the target’s protection. Rank: C Stamina: +9 Damage: +max(5, floor(STR/7))dS Speed: +2 Accuracy: +1 Tags: Chain 1, Sword, Attack Effects: Treat this Attack as Piercing. Reduce the target armor’s Absorption and flat DR by 25% for this Attack, after applying its damage-type matchup.

title: Hyōshi Kuzushi - Broken Rhythm
text: C-Rank You feint with your shoulders and blade before striking along another line. Rank: C Stamina: 7 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Sword, Utility Effects: Oppose your chained target’s Awareness with Espionage. On success, its next Defense against your Sword Chain Attack takes a penalty equal to 2 plus 1 per full 5 points you won by, maximum 6. The opening ends when used or when the target completes its next non-Interrupt Action.

title: Engetsu Nuki - Circular Draw
text: C-Rank You sweep the blade from its sheath in a broad arc. Rank: C Stamina: +13 Damage: +max(6, floor(STR/7))dS Speed: +4 Line: 3, 1 Tags: Bukijutsu, Sword, Attack Effects: Attack every chosen enemy in the line with one Accuracy roll; divide Speed×PDB evenly among targets hit.

title: Geigeki Nuki - Intercepting Draw
text: B-Rank You draw your sword into the path of an incoming attack. Rank: B Stamina: 12 Speed: 4 Tags: Chain X, Sword, Attack, Interrupt Effects: Requires a sheathed sword. Parry a targeted Melee Attack with +Athletics/5. On a full success, immediately make a Sword Basic Weapon Attack against the attacker at full damage if it is within Reach. The counter has its own Accuracy and Defense; its action time is included in this technique, and you pay the Basic Attack’s Stamina. End drawn. This does not defend against AoEs.

title: Nōtō - Draw Reset
text: B-Rank You sheath the sword quickly, readying another draw. Rank: B Stamina: 8 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Sword, Utility Effects: Sheathe one sword you hold without changing Chain value. If your next non-Interrupt Action is a Sword Chain 1, reduce its final Speed by 25%, rounded down, subject to normal Speed minimums, and gain +Athletics/5 Accuracy on that Attack.

title: Shūen no Maai - Final Measure
text: A-Rank You drive a decisive cut through the opponent’s exposed guard. Rank: A Stamina: +24 Damage: +max(12, floor(STR/3))dS Speed: +4 Special: Knockback (Carry Through; see Effects) Tags: Chain 3, Sword, Attack, Movement Effects: Gain +25% Final Damage and +25% Wounding. Choose Sever Guard or Carry Through when declaring. Sever Guard: if a weapon Blocks or Parries this Attack, after defense it suffers WDP equal to its damage-level threshold (Durability + wielder’s DEX/10), even if no damage reaches its wielder. Carry Through: on a full hit resolve Knockback equal to the greater of 10 or STR/3; on a successful Special, you may follow its actual movement, ending within Reach. These are explicit weapon damage and normal resisted Knockback respectively.

title: Mukyoku no Karame - Perfect Bind
text: A-Rank You catch the opposing weapon near its base and turn it aside. Rank: A Stamina: 13 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Sword, Utility, Interrupt Effects: Parry a targeted Melee Attack with +Athletics/5. On a full success, choose one: Turn the Line — win an Athletics Status Roll against Resistance to move the attacker up to STR/5 yards in any legal direction and apply Prone; or Seal the Line — the attacking weapon cannot Parry your next Sword Chain Attack if it is your next non-Interrupt Action. This does not defend against AoEs. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Thrown Bukijutsu
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Thrown Bukijutsu
text: Thrown weapons turn a handful of ninja tools into feints, traps and attacks from unexpected angles.

title: Nijū Nage - Double Cast
text: E-Rank Two compatible tools leave the hand on nearly the same line. Rank: E Stamina: +3 Speed: +2 Damage: +floor(STR/15)dS Tags: Chain 1, Thrown, Attack Effects: Throw two compatible weapons at one target and choose before its Defense: Crossed Blades — use one Accuracy roll and one Defense; each weapon contributes 55% of its damage, with its own damage type and legal payload, then apply that Defense’s result normally; or Decoy — one weapon deals no damage and distracts the guard, imposing an Athletics/5 penalty if the target Parries, while the other deals its full damage. Both weapons are spent; Chain advances once if the Attack hits.

title: Senbon no Sasoi - Needle Lead
text: E-Rank A precise throw opens a bleeding cut or catches the target as it attacks. Rank: E Stamina: +3 Damage: +max(1, floor(STR/15))dS Speed: -1 Accuracy: +1 Tags: Chain 1, Thrown, Attack Effects: Requires Kunai, Shuriken or Senbon. On a full hit choose one: Bleed — resolve Bleed equal to the greater of 2 or Athletics/10, maximum 6, using Athletics against Resistance; or Disrupt — the target takes an Accuracy penalty of Athletics/5 on its next Attack. Declare which projectile carries a poison or other payload before the Defense.

title: Sō Shuriken - Manipulated Shuriken
text: E-Rank A tug on concealed wire sends the shuriken back toward its target. Rank: E Stamina: +5 Speed: +3 Damage: +floor(STR/15)dS Tags: Chain 2, Thrown, Attack Effects: Requires Ninja Wire for the entire clear projectile route. After the target fully defends, you may redirect the weapon along a clear return path within its remaining Range and force one repeat of that Defense. Reuse its paid Stamina, Chakra, AP and Speed; it pays and advances time only once. If the repeated Defense fails, resolve its ordinary Partial Defense against an Attack dealing 75% Final Damage. The repeated result replaces the first. Keep the wire committed until the Attack finishes; then you may retrieve the weapon along that route if it is not embedded or held.

title: Fūma Rendan - Fuuma Barrage
text: E-Rank Two fuuma shuriken cross the target’s path in quick succession. Rank: E Stamina: +8 Speed: +6 Damage: +max(2, floor(STR/15))dS Tags: Chain 3, Thrown, Attack Effects: Fuuma Shuriken only. Throw two weapons in succession, rolling and defending separately. Each hit deals 65% of weapon dice plus this technique’s Damage dice plus PDB × final Speed; combine damage for Wounding only. If both fully hit the same creature, resolve Prone using Athletics against Resistance as the crossing blades break its footing.

title: Fukumi Senbon - Hidden Mouth Needle
text: E-Rank You spit a concealed senbon before the target sees you reach for a weapon. Rank: E Chakra: 6 Speed: +0 Tags: Link, Thrown, Attack Effects: Link to a Senbon Attack or Senbon Multi-Throw. Produce one concealed Senbon as part of the Attack without a Draw action; it counts toward normal ammunition and projectile limits. The first use against a creature that has not seen you use this trick is a Surprise Attack even if you were not Hidden. Other projectiles must already be readied normally.

title: Senjō Issei - Field Volley
text: E-Rank The throw widens into a spread of tools that blankets an area, the user fanning their release so several targets are threatened by the same handful. Rank: E Stamina: +6 Speed: 9 Area: 4 within normal thrown Range Damage: +floor(STR/15)dS Tags: Bukijutsu, Thrown, Attack, AoE Effects: Supply one thrown weapon per chosen creature in Area, within your normal Multi-Throw allowance. Make one Accuracy roll; each target defends separately and can be hit by one weapon. Each fully hit target takes an Accuracy penalty of Athletics/5 on its next Ranged Attack. Pay normal ammunition and add this technique’s Stamina to the normal Multi-Throw Stamina, using this technique’s printed Speed.

title: Hane Nage - Banked Throw
text: D-Rank You bounce the weapon off a hard surface or another projectile to strike from a new angle. Rank: D Stamina: +7 Damage: +max(4, floor(STR/10))dS Speed: +2 Tags: Chain 2, Thrown, Attack Effects: Choose a bank point along a clear route within total throwing Range. Use a hard surface, or throw an additional compatible weapon to create the ricochet point; that extra weapon counts toward your Multi-Throw limit and costs its normal Multi-Throw increments but deals no damage. Measure the Attack’s final approach from the bank point and reduce Visibility penalties by Athletics/5. Both segments must be clear. This changes the attack angle without automatically granting Surprise.

title: Tsukami Nage - Handful Throw
text: D-Rank The user empties a full handful in one practiced release, splitting the weapons between targets as the throw opens across the battlefield. Rank: D Stamina: +12 Speed: +6 Damage: +floor(STR/10)dS Tags: Chain 3, Thrown, Attack Effects: Multi-throw up to Athletics/5 additional weapons beyond your normal allowance, splitting them among legal targets. Use normal Multi-Throw damage and costs; distribute this technique’s extra dice once per target across its projectiles. Each target defends separately. Against a creature fully hit by at least two projectiles, you may resolve Immobilization equal to Athletics/5 using Athletics against Resistance, pinning its clothing or equipment. It can remove this Immobilization with a Speed 3 Utility Action.

title: Kaeshi Nage - Return Flick
text: D-Rank You draw your scattered weapons back into your hands with a sweep of chakra. Rank: D Stamina: 4 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Thrown, Utility, Interrupt Effects: After your Thrown Attack resolves, recover its missed or deflected weapons along clear return paths within normal throwing Range. Weapons embedded in a creature, held by someone else, destroyed or consumed cannot be recovered this way. The recovered weapons are ready in your hands or carried holders; recovering them does not grant another Attack.

title: Tōte no Kata - Throwing Form
text: D-Rank Years of throwing have stripped wasted motion from the draw, grip, and release. Rank: D Stamina: 9 Upkeep: 2 Speed: 7 Tags: Bukijutsu, Thrown, Utility Effects: Halve the Speed added by Multi-Throw, rounding the remaining added Speed up, and increase its weapon allowance by Athletics/5. Use the highest extra allowance granted by Bukijutsu, not their sum. Normal Speed minimums and ammunition costs still apply.

title: Jūji Nage - Crossfire Cast
text: C-Rank You split the throw across two opponents, using separate lines so neither target can read the whole release from one hand motion. Rank: C Stamina: +8 Speed: +2 Damage: +floor(STR/7)dS Tags: Chain 1, Thrown, Attack Effects: Throw one compatible weapon at each of two creatures at 60% Final Damage, rolling and defending separately. You may use this at Chain 0, 1 or 2. If the original chained target is hit, you may preserve your current Chain value against it. Alternatively, choose a hit creature and begin a new Chain 1 against it, ending the previous Chain and any unused Opening. This does not maintain two Chains or advance a preserved Chain.

title: Kado no Ito - Corner Wire
text: C-Rank Ninja Wire is attached or routed before the next throw so the projectile can travel farther and turn a corner the hand alone could not produce. Rank: C Stamina: 7 Speed: 3 Tags: Chain X, Thrown, Utility Effects: Route Ninja Wire from your hand or a thrown weapon you have already placed along a clear path. Your next Thrown Chain Attack gains +50% Range and may turn up to 90 degrees along that route. Supply wire for the entire route; it cannot pass through solid barriers. You may keep a placed weapon as the anchor for later uses, but each Attack needs its own use of Corner Wire. Cutting, detaching or retrieving the wire ends the setup.

title: Shikake Buki - Rigged Weapon
text: C-Rank You fix the payload to the projectile as you prepare the throw. Rank: C Stamina: +6 Speed: +2 Tags: Link, Thrown, Attack Effects: Link to a Thrown Attack. As part of readying it, apply up to two compatible attachments to one projectile, such as a paper tag, wire loop or poison coating. Pay their normal item and resource costs and make required application checks; this Link replaces preparation actions, not separate activation or detonation actions. Follow normal payload compatibility and stacking rules. No payload is copied onto other projectiles.

title: Kaeshi no En - Returning Arc
text: B-Rank The weapon continues through its first line and curves toward a second target before it loses momentum. Rank: B Stamina: +14 Damage: +max(7, floor(STR/5))dS Speed: +3 Tags: Chain 2, Thrown, Attack Effects: After the first strike resolves, direct the weapon along a clear path within its remaining Range. Choose another creature, or the original target only if it fully defended the first strike. Make a new Accuracy roll; the target defends normally against 80% Final Damage. This Attack cannot also force a Defense reroll. Resolve Chain progression once against the original chained target. If neither strike leaves the weapon embedded or held, it returns to your hand along a clear remaining route.

title: Sanpu Hashiri - Scatter Run
text: B-Rank You spread a prepared handful across the target’s guard, choosing which tools carry the real threat. Rank: B Stamina: +9 Speed: +1 Tags: Link, Thrown, Attack Effects: Link to a Multi-Throw. Gain +Athletics/5 Accuracy and up to Athletics/5 additional weapons; use the highest extra allowance granted by Bukijutsu. Pay normal ammunition and Multi-Throw costs. A creature fully hit by at least two projectiles suffers Bleed equal to Athletics/5 after a successful Athletics Status Roll against Resistance, once per target. Choose ammunition types and payloads when declaring, not after Defense.

title: Fūma no Shinigami - Fuuma Reaper
text: A-Rank You send a Fuuma Shuriken through a continuous cutting route, forcing several targets to solve the same spinning weapon from different angles. Rank: A Stamina: +26 Speed: +8 Damage: +max(4, floor(STR/3))dS Tags: Chain 3, Thrown, Attack Effects: Fuuma Shuriken only. Choose up to 3 + Athletics/10 creatures or exposed mundane bindings along one continuous clear path within Range. Roll Accuracy separately against each hostile creature; each defends normally. A hit deals weapon dice plus this technique’s Damage dice plus PDB × final Speed and gains +20% Wounding. For a binding on a willing or helpless creature, you may instead sever that ordinary rope, net or strap without damaging the creature; this does not cut chakra restraints or armor. Each target can be struck once. Resolve Chain progression once against your chained target; if it cannot legally be included, this finisher cannot be declared.

title: Ito no Ori - Wire Cage
text: A-Rank Four thrown anchors pull Ninja Wire tight around a patch of battlefield, turning movement through it into a hazard. Rank: A Stamina: 20 Speed: 10 Area: max(6, DEX/5) within normal thrown Range Tags: Bukijutsu, Thrown, Utility Effects: Requires four thrown weapons as physical anchors and enough Ninja Wire to connect the Area’s perimeter. Area is the greater of 6 yards or DEX/5, entirely within throwing Range. The cage lasts until its wire or anchors are cut, destroyed or retrieved. Creatures inside have 50% less movement. Crossing its boundary requires Athletics against your Athletics; on failure, stop at the boundary and become Prone. A creature may attack a wire or anchor using normal object rules to open a passage. Resolve one crossing check per movement Action. The cage does not prevent legal Attacks, defenses, handseals or techniques that bypass its physical boundary. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Unarmed Taijutsu
text: ← ALL JUTSU TYPES LEARNING REQUIREMENTS ↗

title: Unarmed Taijutsu
text: Not much to say here. You hit people with your fists, feet, and in all manner of other creative ways. These techniques can stand on their own but contains integral pieces for Combo and Grapple jutsu.

title: Deashi Harai - Foot Sweep
text: E-Rank You cause an opponent to fall down by knocking their legs out from under them. Calling it a 'technique' may sound generous, but there's more to unbalancing a ninja than simply wanting to; it takes timing, leverage and a little training. Stamina: 8 Speed: 4 Accuracy: +2 Special: Prone Tags: Attack, Melee Effects: If used while in a grapple its Special: is replaced by the following: Takedown, Control 8.

title: Sasoi - Feint
text: E-Rank A subtle trick that almost every ninja knows--and knows how to detect. Still, those that are particularly adept at it are often difficult to defend against properly. Stamina: +2 Speed: +2 Tags: Link Effects: This is added to any other melee-range Unarmed or Combo Attack, and increases that action's Stamina and Speed by 2 each. Make an opposed Espionage roll; if you beat their result, you've tricked them with your feint. If successful, this triples the Speed of their defensive action for the purpose of determining when they'll act next. This doesn't prevent it from being a valid Interrupt against your attack.

title: Zutsuki - Headbutt
text: E-Rank You drive your forehead into the opponent’s face at close range. Stamina: 10 Damage: STR Speed: 7 Accuracy: -1 Tags: Attack, Melee Effects: This always deals a head wound and you must take the final wounding damage, if that would cause you a wound then you gain a head wound of that severity. When used while in a grapple this jutsu gains: Pummel, Control 1

title: Dainamikku Entorii - Dynamic Entry
text: D-Rank You leap from hiding and drive a kick into an unsuspecting opponent. Stamina: 16 Damage: (STR/4)d6 Speed: 12 Special: Requires you be hidden from your target. Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: After the first time Dynamic Entry has been used in combat (by you, by someone else, it doesn't matter) it has a -6 Accuracy for the rest of that battle.

title: Shunsoku - Flash Step
text: D-Rank You make small decisive leaps allowing you to effectively close the distance between you and your enemy. Stamina: + X / 3 (rounded up) Speed: X / 3 (rounded up) Tags: Link Effects: This is used alongside a melee Taijutsu or Kenjutsu attack, increasing your move with attack by X yards to a maximum of the speed of the jutsu.

title: Irimiseme - Entering Attack
text: D-Rank Rather then a direct attack this jutsu involves stepping into close range with an opponent and deflecting a weapon or jutsu by targeting their wrist or elbow. Stamina: 8 + X3 Speed: 4 Tags: Interrupt Effects: X is the rank of the jutsu being parried. This may be used to parry any weapon attack or attack ninjutsu performed in melee range. The speed of this interrupt cannot be reduced below 2.

title: Konoha Senpū - Leaf Whirlwind
text: D-Rank A low sweep forces the guard down before a high turning kick carries the real impact. Stamina: 12 Damage: 8d8 Accuracy: +1 Range: Melee Speed: 10 Special: Stun 3 Tags: Attack, Melee, Blunt, Opener Effects: On a full hit, you may choose to apply Knockback 2 or begin a Combo with this target. If used as a Combo Opener, its Momentum grants +1 Accuracy to the next Combo Jutsu only.

title: Reppuu - Gale
text: D-Rank With alarming quickness you drop low to the ground and perform a full 360-degree sweeping kick that knocks opponents off their feet when they attempt to close in for an attack of their own. Stamina: 13 Damage: (STR/7)d10 Speed: 8 Tags: Attack, Interrupt, Opener, Blunt, Melee Effects: Gale may (but doesn’t require to) be used as an interrupt after you have successfully dodged an attack, targeting the attacker. If Gale is used after a dodge in this fashion, the dodge roll replaces Gale's accuracy. Momentum: Dodging while the Combo is not Broken is a Speed 1 Interrupt.

title: Senpuu - Whirlwind
text: D-Rank The user rotates while extending one leg, starting with a high roundhouse that's used partially as a feint. Whether it hits or misses, they continue to rotate into a second spin aimed at the lower part of the body. Stamina: 16 Damage: (STR/6)d8 Speed: 12 Area: 2 Special: Opener Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: This attack hits all enemies in range. If partial defense applies, this deals 25% damage per point you hit by, rather than 20%. Momentum: Your combo jutsu hits all enemies in range. If partial defense applies, this deals 25% damage per point you hit by, rather than 20%.

title: Teiryuu Dageki - Halting Blow
text: D-Rank In one smooth motion, the user extends their arm and pushes aside an oncoming blow, steps inward and pulls back their forearm to slam their elbow into the opponent, turning their defense into their offense. Stamina: 13 Damage: (STR/6)d4 Speed: 5 Tags: Opener, Interrupt Effects: Halting Blow may be used as an unarmed parry, with a +3 bonus. If you successfully defend, Halting Blow immediately acts as an attack at no extra cost, using the results of your parry roll as its Accuracy. Momentum: Parries performed while the Combo is not broken are Speed 1 and have a +3 bonus to their Accuracy roll. This does not apply to any Jutsu.

title: Nage - Throw
text: D-Rank You use leverage, brute force, or a combination of the two to physically throw an enemy, either by flipping them over you, hurling them into a nearby object, slamming them to the ground, or something similar. Stamina: 14 Damage: (STR/10)d20 Speed: 8 Accuracy: -2 Special: Stun 4 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: If used while in a grapple it gains the following: Takedown, Control 8

title: Tokken - Thrusting Shoulder
text: D-Rank By charging forward and turning at the last moment to bring a shoulder out front, the user slams into the enemy, knocking them back. It relies mostly on the weight of the user, with the expectation they'll be heavier than the person they're running into. Stamina: 10 Damage: (RES/5)d8 Speed: 10 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: This knocks the victim back (your RES)/10 yards.

title: Attsu Buchikomu - Pain Driver
text: C-Rank You strike the site of an existing injury to worsen the wound. Stamina: 18 Damage: (STR/5)d4 Speed: 12 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: This attack must be a called shot, and does not normally inflict wounds. Instead, if it targets a location with a Minor Blunt wound, that wound is removed and replaced with a Major Blunt wound on the same location. This only applies if the attack deals damage.

title: Bōshi Riken - Spinning Backfist
text: C-Rank With a burst of chakra to one of the user's legs, they spin around and extend an arm to knock an opponent senseless with the back of their fist. It's a powerful blow as it uses the weight and momentum of the user's entire body, but has an inherent weakness of losing sight of the enemy while spinning. Stamina: 24 Damage: (STR/7)d12 Accuracy: -3 Speed: 10 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: This technique's damage is tripled when determining the severity of wounds it inflicts.

title: Chouyaku Kage Kaihi no Jutsu - Leaping Shadow Evasion Technique
text: C-Rank You leap away from an attack, getting yourself safely out of range. However, you don't pause to regain your orientation and settle into your new position, instead keeping ready to move again. Stamina: 18 Speed: 4 Tags: Utility, Interrupt Effects: When you use Chouyaku Kage Kaihi, make a dodge roll. You may automatically attempt to dodge any incoming attacks, without having to take an action to do so, using Chouyaku Kage Kaihi's result as your effective dodge roll. This lasts until you take any action (except wait), including defensive interrupts.

title: Daisenpuu - Great Whirlwind
text: C-Rank A more complex version of Senpuu which involves three kicks to the target's body going in the reverse order as before, starting low and going high to end with an axe kick to the opponent's head. The speed and constant rotation is strong enough to actually lift the practitioner into the air during execution. Stamina: 22 Damage: (STR/6)d12 Speed: 14 Area: 3 Requires: Senpuu Special: Opener Tags: Opener, Blunt, Melee Effects: This attack hits all enemies in range. If partial defense applies, you deal 1/3 damage per point you hit by, rather than 20%. Momentum: Your Combo Jutsu have Area 3. Your Combo is not broken as long as at least one person you hit with this Jutsu is a target for the attack. If partial defense applies to your Combo Jutsu, you deal 1/3 damage per point you hit by, rather than 20%.

title: Konoha Dai Senpū - Leaf Great Whirlwind
text: C-Rank A chain of turning kicks expands the basic whirlwind into a pressure sequence. Stamina: 20 Damage: 16d8 Range: Melee Speed: 14 Special: Stun 5 Tags: Attack, Melee, Blunt Effects: If the target is Prone or suffering Immobilization 3+, gain +2 Accuracy but do not increase damage. On a full hit you may move 2 yards around the target without provoking any movement-triggered effects from that target.

title: Maboroshi Tejun - Phantom Step
text: C-Rank A sudden burst of movement carries you out of an incoming attack’s path, fast enough to seem to vanish. Stamina: 5 X Speed: +X Tags: Link Effects: X has a maximum of 5. This is used alongside a dodge attempt, increasing its Speed by X and provides it with a +X bonus. Your dodge's final speed cannot go lower than 2 + X. If combined with the C-rank Leaping Shadow Evasion this technique increases LSE's Stamina cost to (20 + 4X), which replaces Phantom Step's normal Stamina cost.

title: Munen Musō - No Design, No Conception
text: C-Rank You advance at the same moment as your opponent, disrupting their rhythm and creating an opening to grapple. Stamina: 5 + 5X Speed: + X Tags: Link Effects: X has a maximum of 5. This technique is used alongside any interrupt that requires a defensive roll against an opponent’s Accuracy whilst you are at range 0 with that opponent. You take a penalty of X to your roll, if you successfully defend, No Design, No Conception immediately acts as a Grab at no extra cost, using the results of your dodge roll for its Accuracy and Speed (minimum 3). You gain X Control in the subsequent clinch.

title: Ryuorosu - Dragon Takedown
text: C-Rank Adapted--in purpose, method, and name--from a 'normal' style of martial arts, the Dragon Takedown is a more aggressive method of initiating a grapple, often throwing an opponent to the ground in the process. Stamina: 26 Damage: (STR/8)d12 Speed: 18 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: If you hit, you initiate a clinch with your opponent but you gain a -10 to your control. Then you may immediately attempt a Submission for no cost.

title: Souji Reppuu - Sweeping Gale
text: C-Rank By flipping forward into a crouch, the user builds momentum that's used to instantly land and begin spinning on one foot, extending the other leg out while using chakra to enhance its density, rotating repeatedly to strike the knees of the enemy, simultaneously evading and tripping them. Stamina: 19 Damage: (STR/6)d8 Speed: 8 Special: Prone Requires: Deashi Harai: Foot Sweep, Reppuu Tags: Attack, Interrupt, Opener, Blunt, Melee Effects: This follows the rules for the D-rank Reppuu technique (including its Momentum).

title: Ura Nage - Suplex
text: C-Rank The user secures the opponent around the torso or hips, shifts their center of gravity, and drives them over the shoulder or backward into the ground. The technique is less about raw lifting strength than committing to the throw before the opponent can recover their footing. Stamina: 18 Damage: (STR/5)d10 Speed: 15 Accuracy: -3 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: When used while in a Grapple this jutsu gains: Pummel, Control 6. If Suplex inflicts a wound, it is dealt to the opponent's head.

title: Tsutenkyaku - Painful Sky Leg
text: C-Rank After concentrating chakra in the user's legs, they leap high into the air and come down in a destructive axe kick, using gravity to enhance the momentum behind the blow while the user's chakra is used to enhance the destructive force of the blow. Stamina: 25 Damage: (STR/20)d20 Area: 6 Speed: 16 Special: -6 Accuracy Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: Your damage bonus is doubled for this attack. Effects of partial hits for this jutsu are extended and deal 10% per amount they succeed. For example on an accuracy 20 attack a defense of: 15-Full Hit, 16-90%, 17-80%, 18-70%, 19-60%, 20-50%, 21-40%, 22-30%, 23-20%, 24-10%, 25-Fully Defended

title: Uchikudakute no Jutsu - Shattering Hand Technique
text: C-Rank You channel vibrating chakra through your hand at the moment of impact to shatter solid objects. Stamina: 22 Damage: (STR/5)d10 Speed: 13 Delay: 5 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: Before wounds or damage are calculated, this completely destroys any armor protecting the location it hits. Against objects this jutsu always does its max damage. If the object is not chakra enhanced nor made of chakra you double its speed for the purposes of dealing damage.

title: Dai Dageki - Heavy Blow
text: B-Rank One of the simplest hand to hand maneuvers at the highest of levels, this attack is straight and to the point. Sacrificing trickery or fancy techniques, you deliver a powerful blow with the full weight of your body behind it. Stamina: 35 Accuracy: -2 Damage: As Max Basic Attack Speed: 12 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: Your damage bonus is doubled for this attack, When used in a combo it gains Finisher 0.

title: Gawa-Ryuu - River Style
text: B-Rank The ultimate recourse of taijutsu fighters who are frustrated with only being able to land glancing blows on their opponents, this technique sends a surge of chakra through the attacking limb. This results in a burst of speed and strength, and also a chakra 'shockwave' along the edge of the attack that carries almost as much force as the strike itself. Chakra: 15 + X/2 Tags: Link Effects: This is activated after you partially hit with an Unarmed or Combo Taijutsu attack. X is that technique's final Stamina cost. The effects of partial hits are ignored for that attack.

title: Girochin Doroppu - Guillotine Drop
text: B-Rank A descending heel or knee commits the user's entire weight to the strike. Stamina: 30 Damage: 34d8 Accuracy: -3 Range: Melee Speed: 20 Tags: Attack, Melee, Blunt Effects: You must begin at least 2 yards above the target or have moved at least 5 yards vertically during this Attack. On a full hit against a Prone target, treat Damage as 15% higher for Wounding only. On a miss, you become Prone.

title: Gouriki Senpuu - Strong Whirlwind
text: B-Rank Taking the Whirlwind back to the basics, the shinobi no longer bothers with a series of strikes, and instead just focuses their ability into a single roundhouse with more speed and power than the previous versions. Stamina: 33 Damage: (STR/5)d12 Speed: 16 Area: STR/30 Special: Opener Requires: Daisenpuu Tags: Opener, Blunt, Melee Effects: This damages everyone in range. If partial defense applies, this technique does 50% of its normal damage per point it hits by, rather than 20%. Anyone hit is knocked back STR/20 Yards. Momentum: You designate only one target hit by this attack as your Combo Target. All Combo Jutsu gain Knockback of up to (STR/20) Yards. You can move an additional (STR/20) Yards for free as part of your “Move with an Attack” Maneuver with Combo Jutsu.

title: Kage Buyou - Shadow of the Dancing Leaf
text: B-Rank The user lowers themself to get underneath their opponent, and then knocks them into the air with a violent rising kick, leaping after them immediately after it to position themselves in the target's shadow. Stamina: 27 Damage: (STR/6)d10 Accuracy: +2 Speed: 8 Tags: Opener, Blunt, Melee Effects: You knock your opponent into the air for 10 IC and they gain the prone condition while knocked up. Momentum: If used as the Opener of a Combo, All Combo Jutsus will gain the above effect.

title: Kurokumaken - Black Bear Strength
text: B-Rank A devastating move, developed by a shinobi who claimed he had gained inspiration for it by watching the fighting tactics of wild bears. The user wraps their arms around their opponent and squeezes with incredible strength. Users of this move have been known to crack arm bones and break ribs. It was later pointed out that real bears do not actually hug people, to death or otherwise. The original inventor of the move refused to comment, and the name was in wide use by that point anyway. Stamina: 33 Damage: (STR/3)d8 Speed: 18 Accuracy: -5 Tags: Attack, Melee, Blunt Effects: If this technique deals a Wound, it applies one Wound to each Arm instead of a single Wound. When used while in a Grapple, it gains Pummel, Control 7, and its damage dice increase to d20s. Kurokumaken requires both arms to be free and usable.

title: Rensa Ketsuin - Linked Handseals
text: B-Rank The user fights with their hands already moving toward the next technique. Fingers knot between strikes, grips force the opponent's hands into position, and even blocked blows become part of a sequence of seals. By the time the exchange ends, the last seal has already been formed. Rank: B Stamina: 27 Damage: (STR/6)d10 Accuracy: +1 Speed: 10 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee, Opener Momentum: Whenever one of your Combo Jutsu hits your Combo Target and deals damage, gain 4 Seal Progress. You can gain Seal Progress only once per Combo Jutsu, regardless of how many individual hits or targets it has. You may bank a maximum amount Seal Progress equal to your Combo Counter x 4. When you execute a Finisher, you may spend your banked Seal Progress on one Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you know which requires handseals. Compare your Seal Progress to that Jutsu's modified Seal Speed. If your Seal Progress equals or exceeds its modified Seal Speed, its handseals are considered completed. After the Finisher resolves, you may immediately perform that Jutsu before the Initiative Count advances. If the Jutsu is an Attack, it must target your former Combo Target.

title: Rariatto - Lariat
text: B-Rank The user turns speed into a shoulder-and-arm collision designed to carry the victim with them. Stamina: 28 Damage: 28d8 Accuracy: -2 Range: Melee Speed: 18 Special: Knockback X Tags: Attack, Melee, Blunt Effects: X equals the number of yards you moved toward the target as part of this Attack, maximum 10. If X is at least 5, increase Wounding Damage by 10%. If X is 10, apply Stun 5 on a full hit.

title: Tora Rakka - Tiger Drop
text: B-Rank You flip your opponent over you and hurl them to the ground (or otherwise maneuver them unpleasantly if you're both already on the ground) and slam an elbow, knee, or other body part into them, using gravity to assist your momentum. Nobody really knows what this has to do with tigers. Stamina: 30 Damage: (STR/8)d20 Speed: 9 Accuracy: -5 Special: Stun 10 Tags: Attack, Melee, Blunt Effects: Your damage bonus is doubled for this attack. If Tiger Drop inflicts a wound, it is dealt to the opponent's head. This technique leaves you and your opponent prone. When used while in a grapple this jutsu gains: Pummel, Control 5, the grapple is ended. .

title: Benkei-do - Way of Benkei
text: A-Rank A mixture of folk hero and mythical character, Benkei was a warrior monk known for his peerless skill in combat and unswerving loyalty to his master. One of the popular stories about his exploits involved Benkei guarding a bridge, holding back hundreds of warriors before finally succumbing to his wounds. This technique pays homage to his exploits, focusing all a shinobi's efforts on defense. Stamina: 10 Speed: +0 Tags: Utility, Link, Variable Defensive Action Effects: This may be added on to any dodge or parry. Until your next action, your defenses have a 1+X bonus, with X being the number of times you've rolled to defend yourself since activating Way of Benkei (including the defense it was activated with). You may use other defenses, but they do not receive its bonus or increase its X value. Way of Benkei ends when your take a non-Interrupt action, at which point you pay a secondary Stamina cost of 10 + 3X, to a maximum of 40.

title: Gouken - Iron Fist
text: A-Rank Iron Fist commits the body’s full force to short punches and kicks. Its powerful blows are tiring and easier for an observant opponent to read. Stamina: +X2 Accuracy: -X/4 (round up) Speed: +X Tags: Link Effects: X has a maximum of STR/10. This supplements another Unarmed Jutsu, or Basic Attack. Your Physical Damage Bonus is also increased by X.

title: Jigokuzuki - Hell Stab
text: A-Rank Lightning-honed fingers condense a full-body charge into an impossibly narrow point. Chakra: 20 Stamina: 30 Damage: 45d8 Accuracy: -3 Range: Melee Speed: 18 Special: Piercing Tags: Attack, Melee, Piercing, Raiton Effects: Requires Raiton Aptitude. Ignore 25% Armor effectiveness and 25% DR. After use, your attacking arm suffers Stun 5 and cannot benefit from Speed reductions on its next Melee Attack.

title: Okasho - Cherry Blossom Impact
text: A-Rank Taking chakra infused muscles to the next level, the user focuses a massive amount of chakra into their fist, foot, or even fingertip. Upon striking the chakra is released into their target causing a great deal of damage. Given that the damage is dependent on the amount of chakra channeled, a truly great shinobi can even use this technique with a single fingertip. Stamina: 40 Chakra: X Damage: Xd10 Speed: 24 Requires: Chakra Strengthening, Chakra Control 30 Tags: Attack, Blunt, Melee Effects: Calculate this Attack's Damage Bonus using your Physical Damage Bonus plus half your Ninjutsu Damage Bonus, then multiply that combined bonus by Okasho's modified Speed as normal. You may give this technique an Area of X/4; if you do, its base Damage Dice become Xd6 rather than Xd10.

title: Shishi Keishi - Lion Execution
text: A-Rank A martial artist known as the Faceless Master is said to have developed this technique after surviving a lion attack. It imitates the animal’s crushing tackle and mauling strikes. Stamina: +10 Speed: +6 Requires: Dragon Takedown Tags: Link Effects: This may be added to any jutsu with the Trapping or Submission Tags. Make a Melee Taijutsu attack; if it hits, you initiate a grapple and then immediately perform the move this jutsu is linked to. ← ALL JUTSU TYPES

title: Skill Actions
text: Skill Actions

title: Skill Actions
text: These skill actions are available to every Hunter. Entries without Interrupt or Link are main Utility Actions. Roll 1d20 + the named skill. Use the listed Speed; ordinary AP reductions apply. An opposed check succeeds only when the acting Hunter beats the defender. No fatigue cost applies unless listed. A failed attempt still spends its Speed. Benefits from the same named action do not stack. A pending benefit cannot be rerolled or replaced before it is used or ends. Unused roll benefits end with the combat or scene. Information checks can be repeated when there is new evidence to examine; repeating the same examination does not reveal more information. A combat skill action is a combat roll for Specialization granted by Genius.

title: Scaling with the roll
text: On a successful check, X = floor((your total − TN) / 5). For an opposed check, subtract the defender's rolled total instead; ties still fail. Each full 5 points above the required result improves the action as listed below. Use the final totals, including modifiers. A failed check grants no benefit. For example, against TN 20, totals 20–24 give X=0, 25–29 give X=1, and 35–39 give X=3. Roll bonuses and penalties have the listed caps; movement, duration, repair and other benefits scale as stated. A Called Shot reduction cannot turn a penalty into an Accuracy bonus.

title: Interrupts and Links
text: Declare a reactive skill action before rolling the Defense, attack resolution or check it modifies. Resolve the skill check first; success applies to that triggering event, and failure still pays its Speed. Defense Links attach to your one legal Defensive Interrupt. Add their Speed to that Defense for Interrupt validity and advancing your next action. The linked Defense must be legal against the Attack, including any AoE. You may attach one skill-action Defense Link to a Defense; ordinary Jutsu Links remain subject to their own rules. Check Links attach to a required Chakra Exhaustion or status check. Pay their listed Speed by adding it to your next action’s IC, once per use; this does not change the triggering Attack’s damage or Speed. They grant no extra recovery check. Use one skill-action Check Link per check; the skill check establishing its bonus cannot itself receive that bonus or trigger another Check Link. Support and check Interrupts act at their printed trigger and add their Speed to your next action’s IC. When responding to an Attack, they must meet the normal half-Speed Interrupt limit. When responding to a check with no Attack, their explicit check trigger permits their use. They do not replace the recipient’s Defense or status check. Skill-action checks cannot trigger reactive skill actions. Misdirect is an Offensive Interrupt and follows its own attack-declaration trigger instead. Bonuses from skill actions to the same roll use the highest, including a prepared bonus and reactive assistance. Apply the same rule to penalties from skill actions.

title: Athletics
text: Vault — Speed 4, Movement. Roll Athletics against TN 15 to cross up to 5 + 2X yards of difficult ground or a gap, or climb up to 3 + X yards. You need a reachable landing or handhold. On failure you remain at your starting position. Help Up — Speed 3, Touch. Choose yourself or a willing adjacent creature that is Prone. Athletics TN 15: end Prone and move the recipient up to 2 + X yards to an unoccupied space. This does not break a Grapple or other restraint.

title: Awareness
text: Read the Windup — Speed +1, Link, Defense. Link to your Defense against an Attack from a visible creature. Roll Awareness against 10 + its Espionage. On success, gain +(2 + X), maximum +6, on that Defense. Call the Threat — Speed 4. Make a normal Search against one hidden creature with +2 Awareness. If you locate it, communicate its location to allies who can hear you; their next Search for it gains +(3 + X), maximum +7. This does not automatically remove their Stealth penalties.

title: Chakra Control
text: Settle Chakra — Speed +2, Link, Check, Self. Link to a Chakra Exhaustion roll you are required to make. Chakra Control TN 20: gain +(2 + X), maximum +6, on that roll. This does not reduce existing Chakra Penalty or Fatigue. Steady the Flow — Speed 2, Interrupt, Support, Touch. When a willing adjacent ally must make a Chakra Control status check while maintaining a technique, intervene before it rolls. Chakra Control TN 20: it gains +(3 + X), maximum +7, on that check. You cannot target yourself.

title: Ninshou
text: Read the Technique — Speed +1, Link, Defense. Link to your Defense against a visible Jutsu Attack. Ninshou TN 10 + 5 × its rank (E=1 through A=5): learn its rank, keywords and attack form, and gain +(2 + X), maximum +6, on that Defense. Alternatively, use this as a Speed 4 main Utility Action to study a Jutsu during handseals, Delay or a maintained effect; identify its rank, keywords and action type, and prepare the same bonus for your next Defense against it. Either mode identifies it for Explain the Counter. It does not reveal secret Heritage requirements. Explain the Counter — Speed 3, Interrupt, Support. When an enemy declares an Attack with a Jutsu you identified using Read the Technique before this declaration, explain its counter to allies who can hear you. Roll Ninshou against its identification TN. On success, up to 1 + X allies each gain +2 on their Defense against this Attack.

title: Lore
text: Recall the Hunt — Speed 5. Lore TN 20 against a monster you can observe: learn up to 1 + X currently relevant facts from its Tracks or Nature Intel, chosen by the GM. Success grants +(2 + X), maximum +6, on your next skill check concerning that monster. These facts do not raise your Hunt Intel level. Name the Weakness — Speed 5. Lore TN 25 against a visible monster: identify the armor category of up to 1 + X visible parts and whether each can be broken. Choose one ally who hears you; its next Called Shot to one of those parts reduces the Called Shot Accuracy penalty by 2 + X, minimum 0. Only one such benefit may apply to an Attack.

title: Espionage
text: Misdirect — Speed 3, Interrupt, Offensive. When an ally declares an Attack against a visible enemy within 10 yards of you, oppose your Espionage with that enemy’s Awareness before it rolls its Defense. On success, impose −(2 + X), maximum −5, on that Defense. The penalty is consumed by this Attack’s defense and cannot aid your own Attack. Quick Sabotage — Speed 6, Touch. Against an unattended trap or mundane mechanism, roll Espionage against its listed disarm TN, or TN 20 if none exists. On success, disable it until someone repairs or resets it. Restoring it requires a Speed 6 Utility Action and an Espionage or Artisan check against TN 15 + 5X; use the original device’s higher repair TN if it has one. Devices carried or actively operated by an unwilling creature cannot be targeted with this action.

title: Medicine
text: Stabilise — Speed 10, Touch. Requires Medicine 1 and a First Aid Kit. Medicine TN 20: end one non-Wound Bleed, or provide treatment expressly permitted by a Wound entry using its TN if higher. On success, the recipient also gains +X, maximum +4, on its next Resistance roll against a physical status. Consume the kit on the attempt. Field Diagnosis — Speed 2, Interrupt, Check, Touch. When you or a willing adjacent creature must make a Resistance roll against a physical status already affecting it, examine the condition before that roll. Medicine TN 15: identify its current Wounds and physical statuses and grant +(3 + X), maximum +7, on that Resistance roll. This grants no additional recovery roll and does not treat a Wound. For examining a creature without a pending check, use a Speed 4 main Utility Action instead and prepare the bonus for its next permitted Resistance roll against one identified status.

title: Research
text: Find the Pattern — Speed +1, Link, Defense. After observing an enemy resolve the same named Attack twice, Link to your Defense against a subsequent use. Research against 10 + its Espionage: gain +(2 + X), maximum +6, on that Defense. The two earlier observations must be complete before the current Attack is declared. Decode — Speed 6, Touch. Study an accessible inscription, control panel or written seal. Research TN 20, or its stated decoding TN if higher: discover its operating instruction, activation condition or warning, chosen by the GM. An ally acting on that information gains +(3 + X), maximum +7, on its next skill check to operate or disable that object. Decoding does not grant a missing Talent or deactivate a Jutsu.

title: Resistance
text: Brace Yourself — Speed +1, Link, Defense, Self. Link to your Defense against an Attack that can cause Knockback. Resistance TN 20: reduce Knockback you would suffer from that Attack by 5 + 2X yards, minimum 0, after its ordinary defense and Special resolution. This benefit applies even if the linked Defense fails; it does not reduce damage or other statuses. Endure — Speed +2, Link, Check, Self. Link to a required Resistance check against a physical status. First roll Resistance against TN 20; on success, gain +(3 + X), maximum +7, on the required check.

title: Stealth
text: Quiet Advance — Speed 5, Movement. If already hidden from at least one enemy, roll Stealth against 10 + the highest Awareness among those enemies. On success, move your ordinary Speed 5 movement distance plus X yards with no movement penalty to maintaining Stealth. On failure, move normally and resolve detection under the normal Stealth rules. Lay a False Trail — Speed 5. Requires loose ground, vegetation, smoke or another means of obscuring your passage. Stealth TN 20: the next Search against you suffers −(3 + X), maximum −7. The effect ends if you are located or leave the obscured passage. This does not make you Hidden or let you Hide while directly observed.

title: Survival
text: Pick a Route — Speed 4. Survival TN 15: designate a visible route up to 10 + 5X yards long. You and allies who hear you ignore up to 2 + X severity of ordinary difficult or Rocky Terrain on their next traversal of that route. The route remains usable until the terrain changes; each creature benefits once. Magical hazards, damage and restraints still apply. Bait — Speed 5. Use suitable food, scent or a sound to draw a visible non-human creature's attention within 15 yards. Roll Survival against its Awareness. On success, it suffers −(2 + X) Accuracy, maximum −5, on its next Attack if it targets anyone other than you. Its next Attack consumes the effect even if it targets you.

title: Diplomacy
text: Rally — Speed 3, Interrupt, Support. When a willing ally who can hear you declares a Defense or must make a Resistance roll, rally it before that roll. Diplomacy TN 20: it gains +(2 + X), maximum +6, on that roll. You cannot target yourself. Challenge — Speed 5. An enemy within 15 yards that understands you opposes Diplomacy with Resistance or Espionage, its choice. On success, its next Attack against anyone other than you suffers −(2 + X) Accuracy, maximum −5. Its next Attack consumes the effect even if it targets you. Challenge and Bait do not stack.

title: Artisan
text: Field Repair — Speed 8, Touch. Requires tools and access to a willing creature's weapon. Artisan TN 20: remove 10 + 5X WDP, once per weapon per scene. This cannot restore Damage Levels or repair a broken weapon. Apply your ordinary Artisan discipline restrictions. Reinforce — Speed +2, Link, Defense, Touch. Link to your Block while wearing intact armor and holding suitable tools. Artisan TN 20: that armor’s Absorption increases by 5 + 2X percentage points, maximum +15 percentage points, against this Attack at the armored location. It still loses Durability for absorbed damage. Alternatively, use a Speed 6 main Utility Action with tools to prepare the same benefit on a willing creature’s intact armor against the next Attack striking it. Apply Artisan discipline restrictions; the two modes do not stack.

title: Toxicology
text: Identify Toxin — Speed 4. Examine a toxin, secretion or affected willing creature within Reach. Toxicology against 10 + the toxin's Poison severity (TN 20 if it has no Poison severity): learn its listed status effects and duration. The next Resistance roll you or that creature makes against that toxin gains +(3 + X), maximum +7. Neutralize Residue — Speed 6, Touch. Requires clean water and an Antidote from your inventory. Toxicology against the toxin's normal application TN (TN 20 if none is listed): consume the Antidote to remove up to 1 + X unapplied Contact or Injury coatings of that toxin from a willing creature's equipment or an unattended object. This does not remove poison already affecting a creature.
