text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kodon The first Drug you take each combat has its Crash reduced by 75% instead of 25%, and beneficial Drug durations on you increase by 25%. Ignore the first ordinary interaction penalty each battle from having two different Drugs active at once. Once per combat when a Drug's Crash begins, delay the Crash by 20 IC; the Drug's benefit still ends normally.

title: Nara — Long Shadow
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Nara Increase the Range of Nara shadow techniques by CHA/5 yards and reduce their final Speed by 2. A shadow technique may bend around up to two obstacles or corners you can see, provided a continuous path of connected shadow plausibly reaches the target.

title: Yamanaka — Open Channel
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yamanaka Mind Network has no Upkeep for up to CHA/5 willing creatures, and linked creatures may communicate silently with you at conversational speed. When a linked ally declares a Defense, Search, or opposed Skill roll, spend 5 AP to grant +3 to that roll. Originate one non-damaging Yamanaka Clan Jutsu from the position of a willing linked ally within Network range; you pay all normal costs and make all rolls.

title: Kamizuru — Royal Hive
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kamizuru Increase Swarm Pool by CHA2. Clan Jutsu that spend Swarm Pool cost 8 fewer Pool, minimum 0. After the Hive fully affects a hostile creature, restore 5 Swarm Pool and move the Hive up to CHA/20 yards without increasing IC.

title: Hokori — Steady Triangle
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hokori Gain +3 Accuracy with Jinton and +5 on checks to maintain it while interrupted. When declaring Jinton, reduce either Seal Speed or Delay by 6; this cannot reduce Seal Speed below the lineage's normal minimum or Delay below 1.

title: Hoshigaki — Blood in the Water
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hoshigaki While submerged or standing in water, gain +2 Accuracy, +2 Dodge, and +30% Movement against a creature suffering Bleed or a Major+ Wound. You can sense the direction of such a creature within CHA yards through scent or taste in the water even without sight. When Feeding Pressure would grant AP after damaging such a creature in melee, gain 2 additional AP.

title: Silverhand — Headliner
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Silverhand Your Rocker Soul expression is unusually intense. Violence: after you take damage, your next qualifying Attack gains +3 Accuracy, +15% Final Damage, and -2 final Speed. Melody: when your normal trigger occurs, the ally regains 4 AP and you gain 4 AP. Once per battle, switch between Violence and Melody at Speed 0; otherwise follow the normal Rocker Soul rules.

title: Samsara — Balanced Samsara
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Samsara Switch Samsara modes as a Speed 2 Action. For 20 IC after switching, retain half of the numerical bonuses from the previous mode while gaining the new mode's normal benefits. Creation HP and Destruction damage bonuses do not stack with themselves. Use one non-ultimate numerical benefit of the opposite mode for a single Action without switching.

title: Jinrō — Leashed Hunger
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Jinrō Increase maximum Hunger to 8. Spend 1 Hunger to ignore one Bloodlust or urge restriction for the current Action and gain +3 on a Resistance or Genjutsu Defense against rage, appetite, or forced aggression involved in that Action. At Hunger 5+, Beast Form Physical Attacks gain +2 Accuracy and +15% Final Damage. Once per combat when you would be forced into uncontrolled aggression, gain 2 Hunger instead and remain self-directed until the end of your next Action.

title: Jashin Worshipper — Ritual Scar
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Jashin Worshipper Self-inflicted HP damage paid to fuel Jashin techniques is reduced by 50%, minimum 1, but counts at its original value for effects that measure the sacrifice. After willingly paying HP for a Jashin effect, your next Jashin Attack before the end of your next Action gains +2 Accuracy and +10% Final Damage. The first time each combat you willingly reduce yourself below half HP, gain 5 AP.

title: Aburame — Queen-Bred Colony
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Aburame Increase Kikaichū Swarm maximum HP by CHA × 4. When you place a female insect, restore CHA × 2 Swarm HP and move the Swarm up to CHA/15 yards at Speed 0. Once per battle when the Swarm would fall to 0 HP, it remains at CHA HP instead; this does not protect it from an effect that explicitly annihilates the colony.

title: Aburame — Silent Host
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Aburame Kikaichū used for scouting gain +5 Stealth and Awareness and may Search from their own position using your Awareness. Clan Ninjutsu originating from a Swarm in Stealth do not reveal your body unless the technique requires your visible position. Hostile Clan Jutsu originating from a Swarm in Stealth gain +3 Accuracy.

title: Akimichi — Heavyweight Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Akimichi While Baika or Cho Baika is active, every full 5 points of X grants +5% Final Damage to melee Taijutsu and +1 yard Reach, maximum +25% and +5 yards. Reduce forced movement against you by X/2 yards. After moving at least 5 yards in one direction, your next Akimichi melee Attack gains +2 Accuracy, -3 final Speed, and Knockback +2.

title: Akimichi — Pill-Hardened
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Akimichi Reduce Fatigue and Poison caused by Three-Coloured Pill drawbacks by 2, minimum 0. The first Pill you consume each mission is Speed 0. Once per Pill colour after its benefit ends, recover CP equal to RES/5, minimum 2. This cannot reduce a drawback or cost explicitly marked as unreducible.

title: Hyūga — Pure Byakugan
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hyūga While Byakugan is active, double its visual range and gain +3 Dodge against visible single-target Attacks. Ignore 3 points of penalties caused by smoke, darkness, distance, or partial visual obstruction when Byakugan can plausibly see through or around the interference. When a creature within Byakugan range becomes Hidden, make the reactive Search at Speed 0 with +4.

title: Hyūga — Gentle Fist Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hyūga Gentle Fist hits apply +2 additional Sealed Tenketsu. Against Sealed Tenketsu 4+, Gentle Fist gains +2 Accuracy. Against Sealed Tenketsu 6+, it also counts as +15% higher for Wounding and costs 2 less Chakra, minimum 1.

title: Inuzuka — Twin-Born Bond
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Inuzuka Begin combat with a shared 6 AP Bond pool. Only you or your Ninken may spend Bond AP, and only on Ninken command costs or paired Clan Jutsu. Ninken commands cost 2 fewer AP, minimum 0. When you and your Ninken both damage the same creature before your next Action, the second hit gains +2 Accuracy and +15% Final Damage.

title: Inuzuka — Alpha Scent
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Inuzuka You and your Ninken gain +6 Awareness and Survival to track by scent. A creature either of you has smelled during the current scene cannot become Hidden from both of you through mundane Stealth within AGI × 5 yards unless its scent is specifically masked. Mark Scent — Speed 2: mark a creature within 3 yards that either of you can smell. For 20 IC, you and your Ninken gain +2 Accuracy and +20% Movement when moving directly toward it.

title: Senju — Deep Roots
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Senju Your Mokuton terrain and created objects gain +50% HP and +10 DR. When a hostile creature moves at least 3 yards through Mokuton terrain you created, increase its Immobilization by 2 after the movement resolves. Root Surge — Speed 3 Interrupt: when a hostile creature enters or begins an Action inside your Mokuton terrain, move it up to 3 yards within that terrain or apply Immobilization 2. This cannot move it outside the Mokuton area.

title: Senju — Senju Vitality
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Senju Increase maximum Vitality by RES × 2 and maximum HP by RES. Gain +2 on Stamina and Chakra Exhaustion rolls. When you take the Rest action while touching Mokuton you created, recover an additional RES × 2 Vitality and reduce Stun by 3.

title: Uzumaki — Adamantine Soul
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Uzumaki Adamantine Sealing Chains gain +3 on Grapple, Restrain, and sealing rolls and +50% effective durability for barriers and defensive uses. Successful restraints with your Adamantine Sealing Chains increase Immobilization by 2 after resolving. Reduce final Speed of Chain and Fūinjutsu Actions against a creature currently restrained by your Chains by 2.

title: Uzumaki — Red-Haired Vitality
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Uzumaki Increase maximum HP by CHA × 2 and maximum Vitality by RES. Gain +2 on Chakra Exhaustion rolls. Once per combat when a Chakra Exhaustion failure would increase Fatigue, spend HP equal to CHA/2 to reduce that Fatigue increase by 1 and Chakra Exhaustion penalty increase by 1. The first time each battle you fall below half HP without being incapacitated, recover CHA HP.

title: Kazekage Clan / Jiton — Iron Sand Heir
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kazekage Clan / Jiton Increase Prepared Sand Reserve by 20 + CHA gallons. Drawing up to half your Reserve is Speed 0. When Sand successfully Parries an Attack, retain all material and gain +3 Accuracy on your next Jiton Attack against that attacker. Once per battle, if at least 5 gallons of prepared Sand are within 3 yards when an Attack is declared against you, spend 3 AP to attempt a Sand Parry even if you had not prepared one.

title: Kazekage Clan / Jiton — Polarity Savant
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kazekage Clan / Jiton Increase the maximum Magnetize severity of effects you apply to 5. Opposite charges at combined severity 4+ grant both Magnetic Pressure benefits instead of one: +3 forced movement and +10% Wounding. At combined severity 6+, improve those benefits to +5 forced movement and +15% Wounding. After charged creatures or objects interact, shift 1 severity of one charge you applied to another legal target within 5 yards.

title: Shakuton — Sun-Blooded
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Shakuton You are immune to environmental heat created by your own Shakuton. Increase maximum Scorch Orbs by 2 and begin combat with two additional Orbs. When spending an Orb, gain +3 on the associated Chakra Exhaustion roll and reduce that Action's final Speed by 1. Once per combat when you would reach 0 Orbs, regain 1 Orb after the current Action resolves.

title: Shakuton — Desert Executioner
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Shakuton Against Dehydration 3+, damaging Shakuton gains +2 Accuracy and counts as +20% higher for determining Wounds instead of the lineage's normal +10%. When you Wound a creature at Dehydration 3+, increase its Dehydration by 1 after the Wound resolves. Against Dehydration 5+, damaging Shakuton ignores 10 DR and treats Armor Absorption as 10% lower.

title: Yōton — Volcanic Body
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yōton Gain 3 additional ranks of Heat Resistance at no XP cost. While Lava Armour or another self-coating Yōton effect is active, gain +8 DR and reduce forced movement against you by 4 yards. A creature that damages you with an adjacent unarmed or melee Physical Attack takes Yōton damage equal to CHA/5 after its Attack resolves.

title: Yōton — Expression Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yōton Choose the Volcanic Expression selected by your Heritage. Magma: +15% Wounding against targets in your Magma. Quicklime: each application gains +2 Immobilization, and breaking free from your Quicklime costs +2 final Speed. Rubber: defensive barriers gain +20% effectiveness and forced movement gains +3 yards; you may redirect that forced movement by up to 90 degrees.

title: Hōzuki — Living Water
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hōzuki Suika no Jutsu reduces ordinary non-Energy Physical damage to 10% after defenses instead of 20%. While hydrated, gain +2 Dodge against non-Raiton Physical Attacks and may escape ordinary Grapples, restraints, bars, or gaps that liquid could pass through as Speed 3. Raiton retains all normal hard-counter effects.

title: Hōzuki — Water Gunner
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Hōzuki Hōzuki projectile and Water Gun-style Attacks, ignore 15 DR, and increase maximum Range by 25%. After using internal Water Reserve for an Attack, recover 3 gallons. When a Water Gun-style Attack fully hits, ricochet or split the shot toward a second legal target within 10 yards at -2 Accuracy for 50% Final Damage without paying the technique's Action Speed again.

title: Yuki — Mirror-Born
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yuki While at least two Demonic Ice Mirrors are active, gain +3 Dodge and +2 Accuracy with Hyōton and Senbon. Moving from one piece of created Ice or Mirror to another within your normal Living Ice movement allowance does not increase IC. After doing so, your next Hyōton Attack gains -3 final Speed and +25% Range.

title: Yuki — Winter Child
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Yuki Hyōton Immobilization you apply to a creature increases by 1, to the normal maximum, and your created Ice gains +25% HP. When a creature reaches Immobilization 5+ from your Ice, your next Hyōton against it gains +3 Accuracy and -2 final Speed. Against Immobilization 7+, damaging Hyōton counts as +10% higher for Wounding.

title: Futton — Pressure Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Futton Begin combat with 3 additional Steam and increase maximum Steam by 3. When you spend 3+ Steam on one declaration, regain 1 Steam after it resolves and gain +2 Accuracy or +2 on the Chakra Exhaustion roll for that declaration. Spend up to 2 Steam as though each point were 1 AP on an Futton Action or Defensive Interrupt.

title: Futton — Acid Breath
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Futton While in Corrosion Mode, damaging Futton ignores an additional 20% Armor Absorption and deals +50% damage to created barriers and equipment. After Futton damages Armor, reduce its Absorption by another 10% for 20 IC; repeated applications refresh the duration instead of stacking. When Corrosion destroys a barrier, Armor piece, or significant equipment, gain 1 Steam.

title: Jūgo's Bloodline — Mutation Savant
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Jūgo's Bloodline Gain two additional Shape Change ranks at no XP cost. You may change two different body regions with one Shape Change Action, and changing one region is Speed 2. The first Action after changing form that materially uses the new anatomy gains +3 Accuracy or +3 on its relevant Defensive roll, and -2 final Speed.

title: Jūgo's Bloodline — Calm Sage Blood
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Jūgo's Bloodline Increase maximum Sage Charges by 3. When Senninka would force Bloodlust because you reached 0 WP, spend 2 SC instead to remain fully self-directed for 20 IC. When you gain SC, restore RES Vitality and reduce Stun by 1. Once per battle when you would lose control while you still have SC, spend all remaining SC to remain self-directed until the end of your next Action.

title: Karashi (Puppets) — Master Strings
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Karashi (Puppets) Once per IC, after your Primary fully hits or successfully defends, you may exchange it with an Active Support within legal Frame Range without increasing your IC. Your new Primary's next Puppet Action gains -2 Final Speed, to its normal minimum, provided it is a different action from the one that triggered the exchange. While using Concentrated Control instead, you may Strain one Heavy Thread to activate one compatible Routine your Primary knows for its next Action. This does not let the Routine exceed its normal maximum.

title: Karashi (Puppets) — Hidden Arsenal
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Karashi (Puppets) During construction, designate two installed Weapon Mounts, Mechanisms or compatible Attachments as concealed systems. The first Attack made by each concealed weapon or Mechanism after its reveal gains +3 Accuracy and -2 Final Speed. Once per battle, when your Primary fully defends an Attack, you may immediately reveal and activate one unspent concealed defensive Attachment as a Speed 0 Interrupt, paying all its normal resource costs. This attack uses its base speed for its damage calculations, and is considered a surprise attack.

title: Uchiha — Mirror-Eyed Prodigy
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Uchiha While Sharingan is active, increase maximum Reads on a creature by 2. After gaining a Read, choose +2 Accuracy on your next Attack against that creature, +2 on your next Defensive roll against it, or -2 final Speed on your next Observe or copied technique involving it. At 3+ Reads, a successful Defense against that creature restores 1 Read if you spent any during that exchange.

title: Uchiha — Flameheart
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Uchiha Improve the Chakra cost reduction from Uchiha Fire Doctrine by 1 per Sharingan Stage. At Stage 3, damaging Katon gains +10% Final Damage. When Katon fully hits a creature with at least 2 Reads, increase Ignite or Burn by 2. When a creature with 3+ Reads Dodges one of your Katon projectiles or lines, bend or redirect the effect by up to 45 degrees if its geometry allows it; this cannot hit the same creature twice.

title: Bakuton — Blast-Rider
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Bakuton Blast Step may move up to 10 yards and its Recoil may be redirected once by up to 180 degrees. Reduce Stun or self-inflicted forced movement caused by your own Bakuton by 2. After Recoil or Blast Step moves you at least 5 yards, your next Bakuton melee Attack gains +3 Accuracy, +15% Final Damage, and -2 final Speed. On a full hit, Recoil up to 3 yards without increasing IC.

title: Bakuton — Shaped-Charge Savant
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Bakuton Controlled Demolition: Shaped Charge deals another +50% Final Damage to structures, terrain, created barriers, and unattended objects. Increase total Detonation Mark limit by 2. Detonation Marks on one target may be detonated as part of declaring a Bakuton Attack against it, adding their damage after that Attack resolves. When two or more Marks detonate together, choose +2 Accuracy for the triggering Attack, +2 Knockback per Mark, or +15% Wounding for the combined detonation.

title: Kaguya — War Skeleton
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kaguya Begin each combat with 3 additional Skeletal Modifications beyond Battle-Born Skeleton's normal amount. When you suffer a Wound, gain one additional Modification beyond the lineage's normal Wound trigger and +3 on your next Resistance or Defensive roll. While you have at least 3 Ossification ranks, gain another RES/10 DR. Once per battle when a Wound reduces you below half HP, immediately perform Skeletal Realignment after that Wound resolves, paying its normal Modification cost.

title: Kaguya — Dance-Born
text: Requires: Primary Heritage: Kaguya Kaguya Clan Jutsu with “Dance” in the technique's name cost 4 less Chakra or Stamina, minimum 1, and gain +2 Accuracy. When a Dance expends 3+ Skeletal Modifications, regain one Modification of a different type and reduce final Speed of your next Dance by 3. After a Dance fully hits or fully defends, immediately transition into a different known Kaguya Dance of final Speed 6 or less by paying its normal Chakra or Stamina. Instead of taking that Action's Speed now, add half its final Speed to your next non-Interrupt Action.

title: Alert
text: You notice the things other hunters miss. Increase your maximum Awareness ranks by 2, gain +3 Espionage when noticing concealment or deception, and treat your Blind Fighting and Keen Senses abilities as one rank higher than you actually possess, even above their normal limits. Search is Speed 3 for you.

title: Blur
text: You are difficult to follow once you start moving. Increase Movement by 10%. Shunshin does not require a Chakra Exhaustion roll from you, though its Speed is unchanged. Whenever you fully succeed on a Dodge, you may immediately move the distance you would normally cover with a Speed 4 Move. Upgrades Into: Exceptionally Fast

title: Close Ties
text: You draw strength from the people beside you. Allies fighting alongside you gain +3 on Stamina and Chakra Exhaustion rolls; a creature can benefit from only one Close Ties at a time. You gain +1 to those rolls for each ally present, maximum +3. When an ally you can perceive spends Willpower, you may spend one of your Willpower in their place. Upgrades Into: Leader, Protector

title: Chemist
text: You know exactly how much trouble can fit in a bottle. Increase your maximum Toxicology and Artisan (Craftsman) ranks by 3. When a Downtime Action creates Exploding Tags, smoke bombs, flash bombs, antidotes, poisons, or ordinary pharmaceuticals, produce twice the normal number of doses. Soldier Pills you personally craft grant +15 to their Stamina and Chakra Exhaustion benefit instead of +10. Whenever you successfully craft poison, you also produce one matching antidote.

title: Elementally Gifted
text: Elemental chakra came naturally to you long before it did to most hunters. Choose one basic element. You may use it as though you possessed one rank of Elemental Aptitude without spending a rank, and Elemental Affinity may apply to that element in addition to its normal choice. Upgrades Into: Elementalist

title: Expansive Chakra
text: Chakra comes easily and in large quantities. When you use a Jutsu, gain +1 on its Chakra Exhaustion roll per Rank of the technique, from +1 for E-rank to +5 for A-rank. Your Ninjutsu Damage Bonus is increased by half that amount. An Action Chain receives this benefit only once, using the Rank of its base Action. Upgrades Into: Boundless Chakra

title: Full Pockets
text: You are rarely without something useful. Gain twice the normal value when an effect, occupation, or Downtime Action awards ordinary Ryo, and gain +5 on Espionage or Diplomacy rolls made to bribe someone. Once per mission, you may reveal that you packed an ordinary piece of equipment you could legally have purchased before leaving; pay its normal Ryo cost when you do so. In combat this is a Speed 5 Action.

title: Hidden Potential
text: Whatever your ceiling is, you have not reached it yet. Increase maximum Willpower by 3. Upgrades Into: Any 2 Point or 3 Point Unique

title: Indefatigable
text: You can keep working long after most people have started dragging their feet. Gain +1 on Stamina rolls, plus another +1 per Rank of the Jutsu involved; basic attacks receive +2. Whenever you Rest, reduce Stamina Penalty by 1 additional point. Upgrades Into: Endless Energy

title: Killing Intent
text: Something about you makes it obvious that you know how to hurt people. Whenever you inflict a Wound, you and the victim make opposed rolls of 1d20 + twice current Willpower. You gain +1 for each previous Wound you have inflicted during the battle. If you win, the target suffers Stun equal to the margin, capped at 5 for a Minor Wound, 10 for Major, 20 for Severe, with no cap for Critical.

title: Lightfoot
text: You know how to disappear without making a production of it. Gain +3 Stealth and reduce Hide Speed by 3. You may move while at Stealth 2 without lowering your Stealth level. Upgrades Into: Skirmisher

title: Martial Prowess
text: You fight best when the pressure never stops. Changing targets no longer ends a Combo; instead reduce your Combo Counter by 1 when you switch targets. Gain +3 on Counter Combo opposed rolls, and damaging Combo Jutsu gain Stun 1, or +1 Stun if they already inflict it. A Stun lower than Combo Counter + 2 does not break your Combo. Upgrades Into: Bruiser

title: Quick Draw
text: Your hands are usually moving before anyone else realizes you need something. You may throw up to DEX/8 weapons with a Multi-Throw, reduce the final Speed of Ranged Weapon Attacks by 2, and reduce Seal Speed by 1. Drawing a weapon is Speed 0 for you. When an Attack is declared against you, you may draw an item that grants a valid Interrupt as part of declaring that Interrupt. Upgrades Into: Fan of Knives, Single-Handed Seals

title: Restrained
text: You are very good at knowing exactly how hard you are hitting. If one of your Attacks would kill a creature, you may leave it at 0 HP instead; any Wound caused by that Attack still occurs normally. Upgrades Into: Protector

title: Scheduled
text: You are almost offensively organized. Gain two additional Downtime Actions each cycle. Upgrades Into: Fixer

title: Seal Master
text: Handseals are second nature to you. Use DEX/8 instead of DEX/10 when reducing Seal Speed. For every 4 points by which your normal Seal Speed reduction exceeds the Seal Speed of a Jutsu, reduce that Jutsu's final Speed by 1, to a maximum reduction equal to its Rank and never below the normal minimum final Speed. Upgrades Into: Jutsu Master, Single-Handed Seals

title: Silver Tongued
text: You can make a calm person furious in under a minute, and in combat you usually need much less time than that. Mock — Speed 6 Interrupt: when a creature that can hear you makes an Attack or Defense roll, make Diplomacy opposed by Resistance. On success, it rolls twice and keeps the lower d20. Each further Mock against the same creature that day is +2 Speed. Jeer — Speed 3 Interrupt: when a creature that can hear you makes a Skill roll, give it -5 to the roll. Further uses against the same creature that day are -3, then -1, then have no effect. Increase maximum Diplomacy ranks by 1. Upgrades Into: Imposing Presence

title: Weapon Trained
text: Weapons are tools to you, not identities. At the start of combat, you may reassign any weapon-specific Melee Ability you possess to another weapon shape it could legally apply to. Drawing and sheathing weapons are Speed 0. Weapon Focus need only be purchased once; when you draw a weapon, it may apply to that weapon until you change weapons again. If Weapon Focus increases Stamina cost per rank, reduce that increase by 1. Upgrades Into: Weapon Master

title: Weight Trainer
text: You train under a burden so that fighting without it feels effortless. If you begin a battle wearing your weights, create a Weight AP pool with the same maximum as your normal AP pool. Every 20 IC, when your normal passive AP recovery would give you AP, place half that amount, rounded down, into Weight AP instead and gain the remainder as normal AP. Removing the weights is Speed 6, Delay 6, and may be done once per battle. After removing them, spend Weight AP exactly like normal AP before spending your normal pool. For every 5 Weight AP you had when the weights came off, choose one benefit: +1 Taijutsu Accuracy, +1 Dodge, or +10% Movement. Keep the three choices within one rank of one another. Lose 1 Weight AP every 3 IC; every 5 lost removes one chosen benefit. Increase maximum Athletics ranks by 1.

title: Wrestling Prowess
text: Once you get your hands on someone, leaving is the difficult part. When you enter a Clinch, immediately use a known Grapple Jutsu with the Trapping tag without increasing IC. While Grappling, gain DR equal to Control × 3 and +3 on Grapple rolls and Reversal TNs. Upgrades Into: Bruiser

title: Applied Knowledge
text: You solve practical problems by knowing more than anyone reasonably should. Add Research ranks/5, max 10, to non-Research Skill rolls as a bonus. When you take this Unique, choose one non-Research skill as your field of profession; that skill can no longer have Ranks added to it and instead uses the same Skill ranks as you've bought in Research. Additionally, all non-Research and non-profession skills gain Research/10, max 10, to their maximum ranks. Finally, as Speed 4, or by adding +4 Speed to an existing Action, you can replace any skill roll, or a skill roll using your field of profession, with a Research roll instead; applying your knowledge to a vast spread of situations. Upgrades From: Analyst

title: Avenger
text: Choose a person or group that has given you a reason not to forgive. Against a Hidden Village-sized group, gain +2 Accuracy and d20 rolls. A single clan or organization raises this to +3. A group of ten or fewer, or one named person, raises it to +5. Against one named person, gain another +1 for each full 1,000 XP they have over you. You also gain Killing Intent while confronting your chosen enemy. Upgrades From: Any 1 Point Unique

title: Boundless Chakra
text: Your reserves are enormous even by hunters standards. Gain +3 on Chakra Exhaustion rolls. Whenever a Jutsu increases Chakra Exhaustion penalty, reduce that increase by 1, minimum 1 if it would increase at all. Reduce the Upkeep of Jutsu you personally maintain by 1. When you Rest, reduce Chakra Exhaustion penalty by the same amount as Stamina Penalty. Upgrades From: Expansive Chakra Upgrades Into: Regenerative Chakra, Surging Power

title: Bruiser
text: You know how to turn weight, impact, and positioning into violence. Add RES/30 to Physical Damage Bonus. Gain DR equal to STR/5. Damaging Unarmed Attacks gain Stun 2, or increase existing Stun by 2. Grapple Jutsu that successfully establish or improve Control increase the opponent's Stamina Penalty by 1. Upgrades From: Martial Prowess, Wrestling Prowess Upgrades Into: Relentless

title: Chakra Sensor
text: You can feel chakra moving through the world around you. Increase maximum Chakra Control ranks by 3 and gain +3 Genjutsu Defense. Your sensing range is CHA × 5 yards. Within that range you can identify familiar chakra signatures, tell when someone enters HP, sense their current Fatigue category when they make Chakra Exhaustion, and notice active Upkeep. Scan — Speed 6: make Chakra Control opposed by Chakra Control or Espionage against any creatures you choose in range. A target suffers a penalty equal to the total Upkeep it is maintaining. On success you know its exact location and broad chakra nature. A sensed creature is not Hidden from you unless an effect specifically conceals chakra sensing. Upgrades From: Chakra Sensitive Upgrades Into: All-Seer

title: Combat Medic
text: Requires: Medicine 8 You have learned to work while people are moving, bleeding, and trying not to die. Increase maximum Medicine ranks by 3. Gain +4 Medicine to diagnose, stabilize, or treat Wounds. Non-damaging Medical Jutsu targeting another creature reduce final Speed by 2, and healing you provide to another creature restores 25% more HP or Vitality. Emergency Treatment — Speed 7: make Medicine TN 20 against an adjacent ally. On success suppress the penalties of one Major Wound for 20 IC. A Severe Wound raises the TN to 25 and may be stabilized but not fully suppressed unless a technique already allows it. Upgrades From: Surgeon Upgrades Into: Master Surgeon

title: Cunning
text: You understand how people think well enough to make that knowledge dangerous. Ignore combined Diplomacy and Research prerequisites used only to learn ordinary Genjutsu. Gain +2 on Genjutsu rolls and TNs. The normal defense bonus for seeing the same Genjutsu repeatedly does not begin until its third use against a creature. Reduce the Upkeep of one Genjutsu you maintain by CHA/25, minimum 0; change which Genjutsu receives this benefit whenever you establish another. Upgrades Into: False World

title: Elementalist
text: Most hunters have one or two comfortable elements. You have several. Choose two basic elements; you may use them as if you possessed one rank of Elemental Aptitude, though these are not actual purchased ranks. Your Elemental Affinity may apply to every basic element you can use. Status Effects inflicted by your basic Elemental Ninjutsu increase by 1, or by 2 when applied through a Status roll. Upgrades From: Elementally Gifted Upgrades Into: Elemental Mastery

title: Endless Energy
text: You simply do not tire at the rate other people do. Whenever Stamina Penalty increases, reduce that increase by 1, minimum 1 if it would increase at all. The first time each battle you fail a Stamina roll, advance one fewer Fatigue category. Gain RES/40 on Stamina rolls. Every 15 IC, reduce Stamina Penalty by 1. Upgrades From: Indefatigable Upgrades Into: Surging Power

title: Exceptionally Fast
text: You move before other people have properly decided what they are doing. Reduce the Base Speed of all Actions by 10%, rounded up, without reducing an Action to Speed 0 - This can cause attacks and actions to be reduced below their minimum speed, if they have any - regardless of what the ability itself says. Increase Movement by 20%. On a Partial Success with Dodge, you suffer no secondary effects from the Attack other than damage. Upgrades From: Blur Upgrades Into: Vanishing Point

title: Fan of Knives
text: You control the fight with well-placed throws. Increase the Range of Ranged Taijutsu by DEX/20 yards. Those Attacks gain +1% Final Damage per yard to the target, maximum 15 + DEX/10%. When you hit with a Ranged Taijutsu Attack, treat it as having hit by 1 point more than it actually did for Partial Success and any effect based on how much the Attack hit by. Multi-Throw may include DEX/40 additional weapons without increasing its normal Speed or cost. You may Parry a non-AoE ranged Attack with thrown weapons. On a successful Parry, immediately make a basic throw or Multi-Throw with those same weapons as an Interrupt, using the Parry result as its Accuracy. This counterthrow cannot further modify that Accuracy. Upgrades From: Quick Draw

title: Fixer
text: You know people who know people, and you rarely pay full price for anything. Gain +3 Diplomacy and +3 on Artisan rolls made through Downtime. Ordinary equipment and crafting costs are reduced by 30%. You also gain the benefits of Scheduled. Upgrades From: Scheduled

title: Imposing Presence
text: Your mouth is no longer just irritating; it can control the shape of a fight. Increase maximum Diplomacy ranks by 2 and gain Silver Tongued. Goad — Speed 8: choose any number of creatures that can hear you and roll Diplomacy against each target's Resistance or Espionage, with -2 to your roll per target after the first. For every 2 points you win by, that creature suffers -1 Accuracy when targeting anyone but you, maximum -3, for 5 IC per point of margin, maximum 30 IC. Each repeated Goad against the same creature gives it +2 on its opposed roll. Upgrades From: Silver Tongued

title: Jutsu Master
text: You learn techniques quickly and keep an absurd number of them straight in your head. Reduce the XP cost of Jutsu by 25%, applied multiplicatively with other reductions and retroactively. Increase maximum Chakra Control ranks by 3. Gain +1 Accuracy with Jutsu, or +1 on the relevant Genjutsu offense roll; double this bonus for a technique with an inherent Accuracy penalty. Jutsu deal +5% Final Damage. You also gain the Seal Speed calculation of Seal Master. Upgrades From: Seal Master Upgrades Into: Perfect Technique

title: Leader
text: People fight better when you are keeping everyone pointed in the same direction. Whenever an ally gains AP from a source other than Leader, you gain half as much, rounded down. AP gained from Leader cannot trigger another Leader. You may spend your normal AP on an ally's declared Action as though it were theirs, even against a Surprise or Sneak Attack; all normal AP limits still apply. Spend 15 AP before an ally rolls Accuracy to let that ally roll 2d20 and keep the higher result instead of 1d20. You also gain Close Ties, and may designate willing creatures in the current battle as allies for its purposes. Upgrades From: Close Ties Upgrades Into: Tactician

title: Protector
text: You will get there in time. Add RES once more to maximum Vitality and maximum HP. If you have enough movement to reach a willing creature, your Take the Hit automatically succeeds. While using Take the Hit, you are considered to be Blocking and may use any valid non-Dodge Defensive Interrupt against the intercepted Attack. You also gain the benefits of Close Ties and may designate any willing creature as an ally for its purposes. Upgrades From: Close Ties, Restrained Upgrades Into: Living Fortress

title: Single-Handed Seals
text: You can form handseals with one free hand. Use DEX/7 instead of DEX/10 when reducing Seal Speed and increase current and maximum Chakra Control ranks by 2. When using both hands, reduce the Seal Speed of Ninjutsu by an additional Chakra Control/10. Seal Speed cannot be reduced below 0, and this never bypasses a technique's special handseal requirements. Upgrades From: Seal Master, Quick Draw Upgrades Into: Perfect Technique

title: Skirmisher
text: Your preferred fight is one where the opponent never gets a clean look at you. Increase maximum Stealth ranks by 3. While Hidden, add DEX/30 to Damage Bonus on ordinary Surprise Attacks and DEX/20 on Sneak Attacks. You may take Hide even while directly observed; normal Visibility and repeated-Hide penalties still apply, but the repeated penalty begins one use later. You also gain Lightfoot. Upgrades From: Lightfoot Upgrades Into: Vanishing Point

title: Tenacious
text: Failure gives you something to push against. Increase maximum Resistance ranks by 3 and gain Hidden Potential. Whenever Fatigue increases because you failed Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion, gain 1 temporary Willpower until Fatigue next increases. If that temporary Willpower is spent to reroll a roll, you may reroll the reroll once more, but must keep the third result. Upgrades From: Hidden Potential Upgrades Into: Super Novice, Surging Power

title: Weapon Master
text: You have stopped thinking of weapons as separate disciplines. Whenever you draw a weapon, reassign any weapon-specific Melee Abilities you possess to that weapon if they could legally apply. Weapon Focus applies to every weapon you wield and needs to be purchased only once. Reduce any Stamina-cost increase caused by Weapon Focus by 2 per rank. You also gain the draw and sheathe benefits of Weapon Trained. Upgrades From: Weapon Trained Upgrades Into: Arsenal Incarnate

title: All-Seer
text: Your chakra sense is closer to another set of eyes. Increase Chakra Sensing range to CHA × 10 yards and remember a number of signatures equal to CHA/10. Any creature in range that spends Chakra, pays Upkeep, or rolls Chakra Exhaustion reveals its exact location to you until the Action ends unless its effect explicitly defeats sensing. Scan is Speed 3 and may target everyone in range without penalty. When a sensed creature declares a Chakra-based hostile Action, you may spend 3 AP to identify its Rank and broad type; you and up to CHA/20 allies gain +2 on Defensive rolls against that Action. Upgrades From: Chakra Sensor

title: Arsenal Incarnate
text: There is no wrong weapon in your hands. Gain +2 Accuracy and +2 Parry with any weapon you can legally wield, and drawing, sheathing, or switching weapons is Speed 0 which may be performed as an interrupt. After changing weapon shapes, choose two for the next Attack: +2 Accuracy, -2 final Speed, +15% Final Damage, or ignore 10 DR. Perfect Arsenal — Speed 3, lasts 20 IC: at the start of each Action, you may reassign one weapon Ability or Weapon Focus you possess to the weapon currently in hand. Once during Perfect Arsenal, after fully defending with Parry, immediately make a basic weapon Attack at half its normal final Speed, rounded up - this attack does not increase your IC for the purposes of determining when you act next, and any Delay it has is reduced to 0. Each time you reactivate Perfect Arsenal each combat, it’s final speed is increased by +1. Activating it while it is already active instead replaces the duration, and increases it’s speed. Upgrades From: Weapon Master

title: Elemental Mastery
text: Your control of elemental chakra has passed the point where ordinary categories are especially useful. Choose two basic elements; you may use them as if you possessed one rank of Elemental Aptitude, and Elemental Affinity applies to every basic element you can use. Your Elemental Shaping equals 1 for each basic element you can use, plus 1 for each Jutsu Rank (E, D, C, B, A) in which you know at least one Jutsu of that element. Count each Rank separately for each element. When you declare a damaging basic Elemental Ninjutsu, choose any combination of the following whose total cost does not exceed your Elemental Shaping: - 2 — +2 yards Range; - 3 — +1 Area or Radius; - 5 — -1 Seal Speed; - 6 — +1 Accuracy; - 8 — +1 Damage Bonus; - 10 — add one elemental rider associated with a basic element you can use: - Katon, Ignite 1; Doton, Immobilization 1; Raiton, Paralysis 1; Suiton, Stun 1; Fūton, +5% Wounding. Status riders added this way apply on a hit and do not require a Status roll. The same option may be chosen more than once. Area and Range cannot increase by more than half the technique's printed value. Shaping never changes an element into an advanced element. Upgrades From: Elementalist

title: False World
text: Once your Genjutsu gets a foothold, reality becomes negotiable. Whenever a creature fails Genjutsu Defense against you, place 1 Thread on it, maximum 5. Before another Genjutsu roll against that creature, spend up to 3 Threads; each gives +1 to your roll or -1 Seal Speed. When a creature successfully Realizes or releases one of your Genjutsu, keep 1 Thread on it. Once per battle, when a creature with 4+ Threads fails Genjutsu Defense, spend 4 Threads and 1 Willpower to immediately establish a different C-rank or lower Genjutsu you know against it. Pay all Chakra and Upkeep, but not the second technique's Action or Seal Speed. Add +10 final Speed to your next non-Interrupt Action. Upgrades From: Cunning

title: Living Fortress
text: Hitting you is frequently the least productive choice available. Gain DR equal to RES/4 and increase Block's damage reduction by 10%. Take the Hit reduces its final Speed by 3 and may include up to 3 yards of movement to reach the protected creature. When you successfully Take the Hit, reduce Final Damage to you by 20%; if you suffer a Wound, ignore that Wound's penalties until the battle ends. While you are Prepare Blocking, adjacent allies improve their own Block damage reduction by 10%. Upgrades From: Protector

title: Master Surgeon
text: Requires: Medicine 15 You can keep someone alive through injuries that should have ended the fight. Increase healing you provide to others by 35%, and reduce final Speed of non-damaging Medical Jutsu targeting others by 4. Resuscitate — Speed 0 Interrupt, once per battle: when an adjacent ally would be incapacitated but not killed, spend 1 Willpower and 25 Chakra and make Medicine TN 30. On success the ally remains conscious at 1 HP and one Wound's penalties are suppressed for 20 IC. This cannot restore a dead creature or undo destruction incompatible with survival. Upgrades From: Combat Medic

title: Perfect Technique
text: At the start of each in-character day, choose three B-rank or lower Jutsu you know as Signature Techniques. When using one, pay 5 additional Chakra or Stamina and choose one: -3 final Speed, +3 Accuracy, +15% Final Damage, or +4 on its Stamina/Chakra Exhaustion roll. Once per battle, pay 10 additional cost to choose two different options instead. If the Signature Technique requires handseals, you may perform them one-handed. Upgrades From: Jutsu Master, Single-Handed Seals

title: Pinnacle
text: Choose Taijutsu, Ninjutsu, or Genjutsu as your Pinnacle Specialty. If you reached Pinnacle by upgrading Specialist, use the same Specialty. Your Pinnacle Specialty gains +1 Accuracy, or +1 to Genjutsu offense, and +2 on its relevant Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion rolls. At the start of each Specialty Action choose one Form: - Precision, +3 Accuracy - Power, +15% Final Damage and +2 final Speed - Economy, +4 on the Exhaustion roll, -2 to the Final Cost - Guard, +3 on your next Defensive roll before your following Action. Once per battle, spend 1 Willpower to enter Pinnacle State for 20 IC. While it lasts, choose two different Forms for each Specialty Action. Upgrades From: Specialist

title: Regenerative Chakra
text: Your chakra recovers almost as quickly as you spend it. Gain +5 on Chakra Exhaustion rolls. Every 10 IC, reduce Chakra Exhaustion penalty by 1. Reduce total Upkeep you personally pay by 1 + CHA/30. Once per battle, after failing Chakra Exhaustion, advance one fewer Fatigue category. Increase Ninjutsu Damage Bonus by current Fatigue level. At the start of battle, gain Chakra Points equal to maximum Willpower. After a Chakra Exhaustion roll, spend any number of Chakra Points; each adds current Fatigue + 1 to the result. Chakra Points refresh at the start of the next battle. Upgrades From: Boundless Chakra

title: Relentless
text: Momentum is the only defense you care about. Each time you hit with a damaging Attack, gain +2 Damage Bonus on your next damaging Attack, up to half your normal Damage Bonus. Missing resets this bonus. Whenever you miss with a damaging Attack, determine when you next act as though the missed Attack had half its final Speed, rounded up. This does not change the Attack's damage or any other effect based on its Speed. Each consecutive miss also gives +1 Accuracy to your next damaging Attack, maximum +5; hitting resets it. Upgrades From: Bruiser

title: Super Novice
text: You never settled into one specialty, so you learned to make that everyone else's problem. Gain a 10% XP bonus. Whenever you are Wounded, gain 1 temporary Willpower. This temporary Willpower lasts until the next time you are Wounded; if you have not spent it, it is replaced, and if you have spent it, you gain a new point. Upgrades From: Any 1 Point or 2 Point Unique except Elementally Gifted or Elementalist

title: Surging Power
text: The worse your condition becomes, the harder you are to shut down. Whenever you spend Willpower, halve current Stamina and Chakra Exhaustion penalties; instead, you may spend Willpower specifically to remove one of those penalties entirely. Spend 1 Willpower to ignore all penalties from one Wound until the battle ends. Reduce Fatigue penalties to Accuracy and Defensive rolls by half maximum Willpower, rounded down. Upgrades From: Boundless Chakra, Endless Energy, Tenacious

title: Tactician
text: You win by deciding what the fight is going to look like before anyone else notices there was a choice. The first time you use a specific Action in a battle, it gains +2 Accuracy or +2 to its relevant d20 roll. If that Action is an Attack and hits, gain half its final Speed in AP, without exceeding your maximum. Spend 10 AP before one of your Actions rolls Accuracy to roll 2d20 and keep the higher result. As Speed 0, exchange your next scheduled IC with the next scheduled IC of a willing, unstunned ally. Pay 2 AP per IC between those counts, or 1 AP per IC if you also spend 1 Willpower. You may not use this after either of those scheduled Actions has been declared. Upgrades From: Leader

title: Vanishing Point
text: You do not so much escape notice as leave the part of the fight where attention can find you. Gain +3 Dodge and +4 Stealth. After a full Dodge or successful Hide, immediately move the distance you normally cover in 5 IC. At the end of that movement you may draw, sheathe, or Hide at Speed 0 if legal. Your first Attack within 10 IC gains +3 Accuracy and -2 final Speed. Upgrades From: Exceptionally Fast, Skirmisher

title: Wounds
text: CORE RULES / QUICK REFERENCE Wounds A dedicated reference for wound severity, damage types, locations, recovery, and every wound result. Use the links below to jump straight to the table you need. Wound Rules Blunt Slashing Piercing Energy

title: Explanation
text: Chakra conditioning lets Hunters survive blows that would kill ordinary people. Wounds represent injuries severe enough to impair their abilities after the hit has resolved.

title: Wound Categories
text: A single source of damage can inflict a Minor, Major, Severe or Critical Wound. Compare the damage taken against the relevant maximum pool: Severity Vitality damage HP damage :--- ---: ---: Minor 10% 20% Major 25% 45% Severe 50% 65% Critical 75% 80% Meeting a threshold inflicts that category; use the highest threshold reached. Apply Wounding modifiers to the damage used for this comparison, without increasing actual damage taken. For a Hunter with 600 maximum Vitality and 200 maximum HP, 100 Vitality damage causes a Minor Wound; 100 HP damage causes a Major Wound. If that hit instead removes the last 60 Vitality and then 40 HP, each pool reaches its Minor threshold, causing two Minor Wounds.

title: Damage Types
text: Use the attack’s listed damage type to select the Wound table. A weapon with several damage types lets the attacker choose one after severity is confirmed but before location is determined. If a technique requires a specific weapon damage type, use that type. Blunt, Slashing, Piercing and Energy each have their own tables. Use an explicit damage type in a technique’s rules where one is printed. Otherwise, unarmed attacks inflict Blunt; Katon and Raiton inflict Energy; Doton and Suiton inflict Blunt; Fūton inflicts Slashing. An attack made through a created or enhanced weapon uses that weapon’s damage type instead of its element.

title: Location
text: Roll 1d100 on the table for the damage type and severity. For an arm or leg result, odd rolls affect the right limb and even rolls the left. If the defender Blocks, they choose the Wound location instead, including against a Called Shot. Wounds stack, including repeated injuries in one location. A Critical Wound replaces lesser Wounds at that location; multiple Critical Wounds can still apply. Resolve simultaneous Wounds from highest to lowest severity. If severity and location are identical, the attacker chooses their order before the defender applies mitigation.

title: Called Shots
text: A called shot is an attack specifically targeting a certain location. After checking your attack's damage type, choose any of the locations which can be Wounded by damage of that type. You declare that when you make your attack, for example, "Hinotama, Called Shot: Arm". The attack has a -4 Accuracy penalty. However, if it hits any wounds it inflicts will automatically be dealt to that location.

title: Holding Back
text: You may restrain a lethal blow or reduce a Wound when using an E-, D- or C-Rank Jutsu, or an ordinary attack. B-, A- and S-Rank Jutsu cannot benefit from Holding Back. If an eligible attack would reduce a target below 0 HP, you may leave it at 0 HP instead. This is not available if the attack would reduce it to -100% of maximum HP or lower. The target is Incapacitated and still suffers any Wounds. You may also reduce a Major or higher Wound you inflict by one category. Declare this before its location is determined, and before the defender applies Wound mitigation.

title: Recovery
text: Use the following OOC recovery times unless a Wound gives a specific exception: Severity Normal recovery Hospital recovery :--- ---: ---: Minor End of the scene or day End of the scene or day Major 7 days 3.5 days Severe 10.5 days 7 days Critical 21 days 14 days For several Wounds, take the full recovery time of one Wound of the highest severity, then add one quarter of each other Wound’s recovery time. Medical Attention can accelerate either recovery rate. If a Wound’s text says an activity interrupts recovery, retain completed progress but do not count the period of interruption.

title: Medical Attention
text: An attending Hunter or NPC must actively provide care, such as through the Doctor Downtime action. Wounds recover at twice their normal or hospital rate while that care continues. Only time actually spent under care receives this benefit.

title: - (1 - 20) Ringing Noise (Head)
text: - (1 - 20) Ringing Noise (Head) For 25 IC you get a -1 penalty to all d20 rolls, aside from Genjutsu defenses; it's -2. Multiple applications stack and the duration applied by this Wound increases by 5 IC per every time this Wound is applied after the first time.

title: - (21 - 40) Bruised Ribs (Torso)
text: - (21 - 40) Bruised Ribs (Torso) This increases the Speed of all your actions by 1, similar to Paralysis, however this does increase the speed of the Rest action. This speed is increased by 1 per every time this Wound is applied after the first time. The next time you take the rest action instead of reducing your stamina penalties you may reduce the effects of this wound by the amount you would reduce your stamina penalty.

title: - (41 - 60) Winded (Abdomen)
text: - (41 - 60) Winded (Abdomen) A good shot to the gut hit your solar plexus or compressed your diaphragm, or both, knocking the wind out of you. You'll be fine, definitely, but this increases your Stamina penalty by 4 and applies a Stun 4.

title: - (61 - 80) Bruised (Arm)
text: - (61 - 80) Bruised (Arm) This gives a -1 Accuracy penalty (because of the pain being distracting, if you're attacking without using the arm) and increases your Seal Speeds by 1. This penalty lasts until the next time you make an attack. Multiple applications of this wound stack and the effect lasts for 1 additional attack per every time this Wound is applied after the first time.

title: - (81 - 100) Bruised (Leg)
text: - (81 - 100) Bruised (Leg) Something hit your leg and now it hurts! You'll feel better after you walk it off (or just sit down and let the pain fade). Until the end of battle this reduces your base movement speed by 10% and applies a -1 penalty to dodge rolls. This penalty lasts until the next time you make a dodge roll. Multiple applications of this wound stack and the effect lasts for 1 additional dodge per every time this Wound is applied after the first time.

title: - (1 - 20) Dazed (Head)
text: - (1 - 20) Dazed (Head) That one left you reeling. Once you're done seeing stars, you'll be... mostly okay. Everything seems just a little bit... off, about the world, though you can't quite place what. Sounds are muffled, colors muted, and things keep moving at the edge of your vision. You lose any AP you currently have, and all effects with Upkeeps (other than Doujutsu) end as you lose your concentration. If you're standing on water or a wall, you'll fall, too. This distraction provides a -1 penalty to all D20 Rolls.

title: - (21 - 40) Collapsed Lung (Torso)
text: - (21 - 40) Collapsed Lung (Torso) Your Fatigue rolls have a -3 penalty; you can live with both lungs collapsed, though that raises the penalty to -9 (rather than just -6).

title: - (41 - 60) Groin Shot (Abdomen)
text: - (41 - 60) Groin Shot (Abdomen) It's a Stun 8, and you probably feel more than a little nauseous. Don't be ashamed about doubling over and whimpering, either! Until it's healed your Agility stat is considered 10% lower for all purposes. On top of that, you have a -4 penalty to Resistance rolls until your recovery is complete.

title: - (61 - 80) Sprained Arm (Arm)
text: - (61 - 80) Sprained Arm (Arm) Your elbow or wrist was forced to bend in a way it's not meant to by the blow, and sprained in the process. This gives a -2 penalty to rolls, and Accuracy of attacks, using that arm (such as grapple rolls, grapple TNs, and all two handed weapons). Single-handed weapons held in the other hand, ninjutsu, and taijutsu jutsu which specify they're only kicks suffer only a -1. It also reduces your Seal Speed by 5.

title: - (81 - 100) Sprained Leg (Leg)
text: - (81 - 100) Sprained Leg (Leg) The muscles and ligaments in your knee or ankle were stretched beyond their capacity. Any time you move, including dodging, the pain leaves your Accuracy and d20 rolls at a -2 penalty for the next 15 IC.

title: - (1 - 20) Concussion (Head)
text: - (1 - 20) Concussion (Head) This imposes a -5 penalty on all d20 rolls, and halves (round down) your Current and Maximum AP, and the amount of AP you gain from any source. Whenever you suffer a head wound, you have a 20% chance per level of the wound to be knocked unconscious. Any time this happens, your recovery time is reset.

title: - (21 - 40) Broken Ribs
text: - (21 - 40) Broken Ribs The effectiveness of blocking is reduced by 30% (from 50% to 20% for most attacks, and 25% to ineffective against weapons), and you have a -4 penalty to Accuracy and d20 rolls. The Speed of all actions you take is increased by 2.

title: - (41 - 60) Crushed Organ (Abdomen)
text: - (41 - 60) Crushed Organ (Abdomen) It's not as bad as it sounds, honestly. There's some severe bleeding and bruising inside the organ itself, and it hurts horrendously, but it's not bleeding out into other parts of your body--meaning it can only possibly get so bad. You receive a Bleed of Severity 8 that resets every time you perform a Stamina or Chakra Check. Your max HP and Vitality are reduced by 20% (and your current values of both by 10% of your maximum), which also affects Wound Thresholds. And you also have a -5 penalty to Resistance and Athletics rolls.

title: - (61 - 80) Broken Arm (Arm)
text: - (61 - 80) Broken Arm (Arm) Your arm can't be used in grapples, and you have a -5 penalty to grapple rolls and grapple TNs. It can't be used to hold two-handed weapons, and attempting to use it for any other sort of taijutsu (unarmed or weapon) incurs a -5 Accuracy penalty and denies you your damage bonus for that action. You can still form hand seals, though at a +5 increase to all Seal Speeds. And when you finish doing so make a Resistance roll with a -10 penalty against the total Seal Speed; failure means you flinch and fail to perform the Jutsu, you don’t pay the Chakra Cost associated with the Jutsu, but still pay any AP you invested into the Action and move your IC by its Final Speed.

title: - (81 - 100) Broken Leg (Leg)
text: - (81 - 100) Broken Leg (Leg) Severe damage to your leg has left you with a reduced ability to locomote around the battlefield! If worst comes to worst, you can still power-hobble on it; it doesn't directly penalize your movement, but moving has a Stun 4 added to it (even moving as part of an attack). Since normal movement is handled IC by IC, this means that the Move Action applies this Stun every IC of movement, and that you can only move 1 IC at a time before receiving a new Stun 4. So long as your leg is broken, you can't use any Jutsu or abilities that move you or increase your movement speed and such effects or Jutsu end immediately. Knockback effects are, obviously enough, an exception. This doesn’t apply to effects or Jutsus that grant you flight and you may still use those. Your leg won't get better if you're walking around on it. If you walk with crutches (or a cane, or something of the sort) you can move at only half speed, but it counts as 'rest' for the purpose of recovering from this wound.

title: - (1 - 20) Fractured Skull (Head)
text: - (1 - 20) Fractured Skull (Head) Aside from a Stun 15, you suffer a -8 penalty to accuracy and all d20 rolls, doubled for skill checks. And your maximum AP pool becomes 0. Until this heals any time you suffer a Head Wound, of any type or severity, roll 1d20. On 1 - 10, you suffer the wound normally. On a roll of 11 - 20, you're unconscious and comatose until that wound fully heals (even if that takes longer than it does for your Fractured Skull to finish healing). You'll always be comatose for a minimum of 24 hours, even for a Minor head wound.

title: - (21 - 40) Sternal Fracture (Torso)
text: - (21 - 40) Sternal Fracture (Torso) This in itself isn't terribly bad, but whatever hit you with enough force to do that off also managed to break several ribs and cause some significant internal damage. It's pretty easy to tell your chest is just about ruined: there's a grinding sound of bone on bone whenever you breathe or try to move too much, for one thing; the agonizing pain's a pretty good hint, too. This imposes a -15 penalty on all Fatigue checks, and reduces your Damage Bonuses by half. It also imposes a -8 penalty on all Defensive rolls.

title: - (41 - 60) Rupture (Abdomen)
text: - (41 - 60) Rupture (Abdomen) Every time you act, including movement, you lose HP (not Vitality) equal to twice the Speed of the action, and an additional 1 HP every 2 IC. In theory, this could even Wound you again. Treating this with First Aid requires a Medicine Check of a TN of 40, and generally involves cutting open the victim's abdomen and letting it drain (or, in rare cases, ventilate) before figuring out what's actually bleeding and making it stop. It's a Speed 25 action to treat this Wound, but it stops the persistent HP loss. Any time you take an action, you have a 5(action's Speed)% chance of causing the injury to act up again, bringing back all its lovely effects and requiring treatment (via First Aid or actual medical treatment) to bring it back under control again.

title: - (61 - 80) Shattered Arm (Arm)
text: - (61 - 80) Shattered Arm (Arm) Your arm is so broken that the breaks have breaks. It's useless. You can't perform handseals, hold weapons or use items with it, and so forth. The pain is horrible and makes it virtually impossible to concentrate, imposing a -8 penalty to d20 rolls and Accuracy, and a -4 penalty to Fatigue checks.

title: - (81 - 100) Shattered Leg (Leg)
text: - (81 - 100) Shattered Leg (Leg) There are broken legs, there are severely broken legs, and then there's your leg. You can't stand without something to prop you up, but because you're a tough-as-nails and super resourceful hunter you can still move, though the distance you move is divided by 4. You have a -10 penalty to Dodge, and -5 to other d20 rolls. Also forget about using any Jutsu or powers that move you or allow you to move, you plainly cannot. Once you've had two weeks of medical treatment and been put in a splint, you can walk. So long as you carry a crutch, cane, or walking stick (which does occupy a hand), you can move at half speed, and suffer only halve the above penalties. You can do so without out, though each time you take any action which requires you to move (including dodging), or are hit, you have a 50% chance of your leg giving out, and suffering all the regular penalties.

title: - (1 - 20) Profuse Bleeding (Head)
text: - (1 - 20) Profuse Bleeding (Head) You got a gash on your face, maybe a slice into your cheek. You’re bleeding a lot! Head injuries are like that. The blood loss isn’t the issue; the fact that that blood is running over your face and getting in your mouth is. As your mouth fills with blood, it becomes progressively harder to breathe (and not vomit). You’re inflicted with a Bleed 2 and a Suffocate 1 until the Bleed ends. Every time you gain this Wound again after the first time during this Combat encounter, the Bleed increases by +2 and the suffocate increases by +1 (Bleed 4, Suffocate 2 the second time, Bleed 6, Suffocate 3 the third time, etc).

title: - (21 - 40) Pulmonary Gnash (Torso)
text: - (21 - 40) Pulmonary Gnash (Torso) Something managed to cut through your pectoral muscle and between your ribs to nick your lung. A pretty impressive feat, but if they were a real badass they would get your heart (be sure to taunt them about that). This inflicts a Bleed effect of 3Fatigue Level at the time of acquiring this Wound, minimum 3. Luckily it’s a deep but narrow injury, so it tends to heal fairly quickly.

title: - (41 - 60) Sliced Stomach (Abdomen)
text: - (41 - 60) Sliced Stomach (Abdomen) This is what happens when you can't make your body concave enough. You get cut right across the belly. Fortunately it isn't that bad, it's just in a bad spot. You take a Bleed 2, and have a -2 to all Fatigue rolls until the Bleed ends. Every time you gain this Wound again after the first time during this Combat encounter, the Bleed increases by +2 and the Fatigue penalty increases by +1 (Bleed 4, -3 Fatigue penalty the second time, Bleed 6, -4 Fatigue penalty the third time, etc).

title: - (61 - 80) Lacerated (Arm)
text: - (61 - 80) Lacerated (Arm) You got a nasty gash running along your arm. It didn't cut anything vital, but blood is seeping down your arm and off your fingertips. You’re inflicted with a Bleed 2, and have -1 to Accuracy and +2 to all Seal Speeds until the Bleed ends. Every time you gain this Wound again after the first time during this Combat encounter, the Bleed increases by +2 and the Accuracy and Seal Speed penalties increase by +1 (Bleed 4, -2 Accuracy and +3 Seal Speeds penalty the second time, Bleed 6, -3 Accuracy and +4 Seal Speeds penalty the third time, etc).

title: - (81 - 100) Lacerated (Leg)
text: - (81 - 100) Lacerated (Leg) You got a nasty gash running along your leg. It's not life threatening, but it is staining your clothes and oozing down your leg. You’re inflicted with a Bleed 2, and have -1 to Defensive Rolls until the Bleed ends. Every time you gain this Wound again after the first time during this Combat encounter, the Bleed increases by +2 and the Defensive Rolls penalty increases by +1 (Bleed 4, -2 Defensive rolls penalty the second time, Bleed 6, -3 Defensive Rolls penalty the third time, etc).

title: - (1 - 20) Blood in the Eyes (Head)
text: - (1 - 20) Blood in the Eyes (Head) Oh no you’re bleeding from the face! Because fights must be dramatic, the attack has cut in such a way (maybe right across your eyelid, maybe over the forehead) that blood is now dripping into one of your eyes, causing a continual distraction. You take a Bleed 1 and -1 Visibility Penalty and every 20 ICs in combat you gain it again but increasing both by 1, stacking up to Bleed 4 and -4 Visibility. After reaching Bleed 4 it stops reapplying but you retain the -4 visibility penalty. You can take a Speed 5 Action to wipe away the blood, resetting the Visibility penalties (which will return as normal in 15 IC). Using a first aid kit prevents you from accruing any Visibility Penalty from this wound in combat, but applies its own -2 Visibility Penalty as you have to cover the eye.

title: - (21 - 40) Armor Tear (Torso)
text: - (21 - 40) Armor Tear (Torso) Something managed to slice right across your chest, hacking chunks of your flesh and armor right off your body. On top of being a fairly nasty gash which is likely to scar if not given stitches, you’re inflicted with a Bleed 4, and your DR is reduced by 10. This can potentially take you down to negative values, in which case, the negative DR acts as a static Damage boost any Attack against you will receive. Your Torso armor also takes a -25% of its maximum Durability to its Current Durability, though your clothing beneath is still intact (Gotta keep things PG 13).

title: - (41 - 60) Open Cavity (Abdomen)
text: - (41 - 60) Open Cavity (Abdomen) You can no longer Rest and gain an irreducible upkeep 2. Additionally the penalty you incur from passing a Stamina or Chakra Exhaustion roll is increased by 1.

title: - (61 - 80) Muscle Tear (Arm)
text: - (61 - 80) Muscle Tear (Arm) You take Bleed 4, and Your STR is reduced by 10%. This affects everything derived from your STR score you're hoping it doesn't (Vitality, Damage Bonus, damage dice with taijutsu, etc).

title: - (81 - 100) Muscle Tear (Leg)
text: - (81 - 100) Muscle Tear (Leg) You take Bleed 4, and your AGI is reduced by 10%. This affects everything derived from your AGI score you're hoping it doesn't (Dodge, Initiative, max AP, movement speed).

title: - (1 - 20) Avulsed Ear (Head)
text: - (1 - 20) Avulsed Ear (Head) If you have the Enhanced Hearing ability, you lose all benefits from it, as well as any abilities which depend on it (such as Blind Fighting). With blood pooling in the ear making it difficult to keep your sense of balance, the highest level of Taijutsu you can perform is reduced by one (From A to B, B to C, C to D/etc). You're also treated as being in the Fatigue category higher than you actually are for the purpose of penalties (but not benefits), meaning that if you're at Fatigue 1, you have a -2 to Accuracy and -4 to Defensive rolls, instead of the normal -1/-2. Under normal circumstances, this means you also fall unconscious at 1 fatigue less than normal. The blood can be drained from the ear easily with medical attention, but can't be treated in battle. - (21 - 40) Clavicle Cut (Torso) The horizontal bone that connects your sternum to your scapula has been fractured. More than likely, it's possible you can even feel part of the bone that's jutting out from the skin, if you try to look down at it. The worst part of it is the pain, which can't really be avoided because of how the clavicle helps the scapula keep in position to let the arm hang. This inflicts a -5 to Accuracy and d20 rolls, and a Paralysis 4. Any time you perform an action with a Stamina cost or a Seal Speed, you take four times that amount in damage, which bypasses reductions (such as DR). Crash course in anatomy, you have two clavicles. If the result was odd, it's your right; even, your left. With proper medical attention (a trip to a doctor, or a Medicine roll of 20 or higher using a First Aid kit, you or someone else) you can get the arm completely immobilized against your body. This reduces the Paralysis to 2, and halves the damage taken when you make Stamina rolls, but means you cannot use that arm or hand at all.

title: - (41 - 60) Chopped Liver (Abdomen)
text: - (41 - 60) Chopped Liver (Abdomen) This applies a Bleed 10 effect. Whenever you take an action with a Speed greater than the severity of your current Bleed from this wound (even if it's gone down to Bleed 0), the Bleed's severity increases by 5. This also impedes your body's ability to process chemicals properly. The Severity (And not any other of the Poison’s effects) of any Poisons you're suffering from are doubled. And If you're under the effects of a Soldier or Blood Pill, they end immediately (including the reduction of a Fatigue level, which can knock you unconscious). Taking either pill or any Antidotes with this wound results in no beneficial effect taking place. The Akimichi Clan's Pills and pharmacist Clan's Chemicals and other similar products do not work either.

title: - (61 - 80) Hand of Benediction (Arm)
text: - (61 - 80) Hand of Benediction (Arm) Somehow, the median nerve around the elbow has been severed, resulting in a loss of proper hand function. It doesn't hurt that much since it was a nerve that was struck, but your pinky and ring fingers are no longer able to be felt or manipulated at all, and your thumb is more or less unopposable. For starters, if you had anything in your hand at the time (evens for left, odds for right), you're automatically disarmed. The same is true for any two-handed weapon you might be holding. You can not wield a weapon in that hand, and any unarmed attacks made with the affected limb only receive half your Damage Bonus. Your DEX is reduced by -25% and Seal Speeds are increased by 50%. Additionally whenever you make a Ninjutsu or Taijutsu Ranged Attack, roll a 1d6, on a roll of 1 you miss automatically as your arm spasms, ruining your aim (Even if you were using the other arm to do the Attack). You can avoid the increase in Seal Speed by performing your seals one handed, using the opposite hand--if you're able to do so.

title: - (81 - 100) Hamstrung (Leg)
text: - (81 - 100) Hamstrung (Leg) One of the major tendons of the leg, located behind the femur, have been cut. You're now unable to walk or stand properly, more or less, and running is completely out of the equation. You're automatically Prone, as if tripped (See the E-rank Taijutsu for its penalties), and your AGI bonus to Dodge is now AGI/20. You can stand up, but every time you perform a Dodge Interrupt or the “Move with an Attack” Maneuver, you fall Prone again. You can still use jutsu to increase your rate of movement, or to even move you, but the total distance moved is halved. You no longer benefit from the Active ability, and your AP cap is now AGI/4. Any Athletics rolls you make use only half of your total ranks in the skill. If you manage to survive the fight which caused this (props for that, since you're a sitting duck.)

title: - (1 - 20) Cut Throat (Head)
text: - (1 - 20) Cut Throat (Head) You start with a Suffocation 2. Every time you take an action with a Speed greater than 2, its severity is increased by 1 (notably, the "Move" action will not trigger this effect). However, instead of making a Stamina 15 roll every time your Suffocation increases (as you would with a normal Suffocation status), you make such a roll every 10 IC. This follows all other normal rules for Suffocation. Additionally, you suffer a Bleed Status with a Severity equal to triple that of the Suffocation. In the case of special abilities which reduce the effect of the Suffocation status on you, the Bleed's severity is determined before they're applied. Treatment with a First Aid kit will set the Suffocation penalty to 0; however, this will not prevent it from increasing again. In fact, nothing will at all until you've recovered from the wound! Ouch. On the bright side, you're a super implausible magic hunter. If you carefully apply pressure to your neck with both hands, you can temporarily suspend both the Suffocation rolls and the Bleed damage--though you may take no other actions while doing this, not even Speed 0 ones. This 'suspension' applies after you've been doing it for at least 10 consecutive IC. This is really just nasty business, all things considered. It won't start healing until it's received some medical treatment; after that, as long as you keep your neck bandaged and let yourself rest.

title: - (21 - 40) Injured Spine (Torso)
text: - (21 - 40) Injured Spine (Torso) Fortunately for you, your reflexes didn't seem to be that crucial anyway, since you let this happen, so you probably aren't that bad off. Well, that's a lie. Whenever you take any Action or Interrupt, two things happen. The first is that you suffer a Stun equal to its Speed. The second is that you acquire a Paralysis 1 status, or increase your existing Paralysis from this wound by 1. The Paralysis lasts until the end of the battle. This will not heal without medical treatment. - (41 - 60) Disemboweled (Abdomen) Congratulations, you've got what is potentially the most terrible injury one can receive. Your abdomen is full of all kinds of squishy organs and things which, as it turns out, are pretty important to keep you alive. Now there's a giant cut across your midriff and they're all trying to sag out of your body. You have a Bleed 20. Your Fatigue penalties are doubled (-2 to Accuracy and -4 to defensive rolls per level), and you gain no bonuses from Fatigue Levels (No +5 to Stamina and CE Checks per Fatigue Level). Any jutsu with an Upkeep cannot be used, as it's impossible to maintain the necessary level of focus. Until you've received treatment for this, any Called Shots (It has to be a Called Shot) to your abdomen automatically deal double their Damage to your HP (Not Vitality). Every time you advance a Fatigue level after receiving this wound, it takes another week to recover from.

title: - (61 - 80) Avulsed Arm (Arm)
text: - (61 - 80) Avulsed Arm (Arm) Something just cut through a good portion of your arm. It's still connected, but it's kind of flopping, and you can't really control it, and it's kind of bleeding everywhere, and.. Yeah. Firstly, the arm is useless, which means you can't hold weapons (if you are, you drop them), make handseals, use items and so forth. You have a Bleed 12 that won’t get reduced, -8 to Accuracy, and -4 to defensive rolls and Athletics. And you only benefit from half your DBs. Every time you perform an attack which deals damage, your Bleed status from this wound increases by your DB/2, to a minimum of 1.

title: - (81 - 100) Achilles Tendon Cut (Leg)
text: - (81 - 100) Achilles Tendon Cut (Leg) Named after a mythic, nigh-invincible man who supposedly had a single tendon as his weak spot. As it turns out, that's actually a weak spot of everybody, and yours just got cut. The pain isn't quite as bad as the sight of your foot dragging along unresponsively. For starters, you take a Bleed 15 that won’t get reduced and you're unable to really stand properly, so you take a -8 to your Dodge rolls and Athletics, and a -4 to Accuracy. The worst part is that you really just can't move. You can't move as part of an attack or use jutsu that affects movement (like Shunshin). You can still take a move action, but at that point you're more so just rolling and crawling, so the total distance moved is divided by 4, after all other factors are applied to it. You can still 'move' to get out of the way of Area of Effect attacks (determine AoE dodge penalties), but it suffers the same /4 as regular movement.

title: Needling
text: Needling is a status effect unique to Piercing Wounds. Every Piercing Wound will inflict some amount of Needling, which represents the slow, steady pain and debilitating effect of being stabbed full of holes. Needling, accordingly, fully stacks with itself. One or two you can typically bear without too much trouble (assuming they don’t go through you), but the more puncture wounds you take, the harder it becomes to have those bursts of energy that hunter depend upon to get an edge on their opponents. Needling reduces the maximum size of your AP pool by its severity (other sources of AP gain, such as Gates, are unaffected by this), and will cause you to lose any AP you might have had if your maximum AP cap is brought below your current AP. Every time you gain AP, you first reduce it by your Needling Status (Potentially to 0), then reduce your Needling Severity by the amount the AP gain was reduced by: If you had a Needling 6 status effect, and gained 8 APs, you would reduce your Needling status to 0 (returning your AP pool to its normal maximum) and then gain 2 AP (rather than 8).

title: - (1 - 30) Incision (Torso)
text: - (1 - 30) Incision (Torso) You've got a small but fairly deep incision from what struck you. The initial shock of pain was worse than the wound really is, though. You take a Stun 3, which increases by 2 for every time you take this wound in the same battle. And gain Needling 2.

title: - (31 - 60) Flesh Wound (Abdomen)
text: - (31 - 60) Flesh Wound (Abdomen) You've been shanked in the gut. It managed to miss your vitals, but it's still going to cause blood to trickle out of you. You take a Needling 4 and a -1 to Fatigue Checks for so long as you have any Needling Status.

title: - (61 - 80) Reflexive Flinch (Arm)
text: - (61 - 80) Reflexive Flinch (Arm) The back of your hand was hit, causing your fingers to spasm momentarily. Any weapons you're holding are dropped, and any seals you're forming are automatically aborted. You take Needling 3 and a -1 to Accuracy for so long as you have any Needling Status. The Accuracy penalty applied by this Wound increases by -1 per every time this Wound is applied after the first time.

title: - (81 - 100) Muscle Stab (Leg)
text: - (81 - 100) Muscle Stab (Leg) They struck your quadricep, which is a fairly easy target, all things considered. If you've moved in the past 15 ICs before receiving this Wound, then you receive a Stun 8; whether you were moving or not, though, you take Needling 3 and a -1 to Defensive rolls for so long as you have any Needling Status. The Defensive rolls penalty applied by this Wound increases by -1 per every time this Wound is applied after the first time.

title: - (1 - 30) Punctured Cavity (Torso)
text: - (1 - 30) Punctured Cavity (Torso) The body has several cavities, areas where specific internal organs are housed and kept together. One of them has been pierced and now has a hole in it, inflicting Needling 5. What’s worse is that every injury you take afterward causes your body to naturally tense up, aggravating the injury and causing noticeable pain, causing any future Needling status effect gained while you have this wound to also inflict an equivalent amount of Stun.

title: - (31 - 60) Organ Hemorrhage (Abdomen)
